local local_class = newclass('NightmareSteampunkMainSection6')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = NightmareSteampunkMain @
		Comment = 왕자를 잡아가고 클리어 @
		Index = 5 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.get_ishya = controller.get_ishya
	self.ishya_portrait_name = 'steam_princess.png'
	self.shyapira_portrait_name = 'steam_knight.png'
	self.redhood_portrait_name = 'villain_redhood.png'

	self.stage_name = 'nightmare_steampunk_6'

	self.section_progress = {
		-- 초기값
		none = 0,
		-- 왕자를 수감함
		arrest_prince = 1,
		-- 거지를 안전가옥으로 보냄
		safe_house = 2
	}

	self.current_progress = self.section_progress.none

	self.is_scrap_shake = false

	self.center_sfx = nil
	self.crowd_faker_sfx = nil
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	self:set_environment()

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		self.controller:set_default_quest_marker()
	else
		CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('nightmare_steampunk_main', self.quest_spec.QuestId,
				self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, get_character('steam_knight'))
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:RemoveQuestMarker('nightmare_steampunk_main')

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	local steam_knight = get_character('steam_knight')
	if steam_knight ~= nil then
		character_util.remove_relate_event(steam_knight, self.controller.cs_controller)
	end

	local faker = get_character('fake_red_hood')
	if faker ~= nil then
		character_util.remove_relate_event(faker, self.controller.cs_controller)
	end

	if self.center_sfx ~= nil then
		self.center_sfx:Stop()
		self.center_sfx = nil
	end

	if self.crowd_faker_sfx ~= nil then
		self.crowd_faker_sfx:Stop()
		self.crowd_faker_sfx = nil
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	end

--region on event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_character('steam_knight')) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.meet_steam_knight, self)
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_character('fake_red_hood')) then
		if self.current_progress == self.section_progress.none then
			self.current_progress = self.section_progress.arrest_prince
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interrogation, self)
		elseif self.current_progress == self.section_progress.arrest_prince then
			self.current_progress = self.section_progress.safe_house
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.real_interrogation, self)
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then return false end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return false end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == 'section_6_sound' and self.center_sfx == nil and self.current_progress == self.section_progress.none then
		self.center_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_amb_mining_01', loop = true,
													   play_pos = get_character('sub_refugee_2').Position })
	end

	return false
end

--endregion

function local_class:set_environment()
	local steam_knight = get_character('steam_knight')
	character_util.set_with_marker(steam_knight, field:GetMarker('s6_' .. steam_knight.Name))
	character_util.set_anim(steam_knight, {name = 'question', loop = false})
	character_util.add_listener(steam_knight, self.controller.cs_controller)

	for i = 1, 8 do
		local npc = get_character('sub_refugee_' .. i)
		character_util.set_with_marker(npc, field:GetMarker('s6_' .. npc.Name))
		npc.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'pickaxe_bronze_sword')
		character_util.set_anim(npc, {name = 'twohand_attack'})
	end

	local faker = get_character('fake_red_hood')
	character_util.set_direction(faker, 'right')
	character_util.set_emotion(faker, {name = 'scared'})
	character_util.shake(faker, 0.04, 99999)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.scrap_shake, self))
end

function local_class:meet_steam_knight()
	local steam_knight = get_character('steam_knight')
	local faker = get_character('fake_red_hood')
	local ishya = self.get_ishya()
	local leader = user_party_leader

	self.center_sfx:FadeOut(2)

	CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:RemoveQuestMarker('nightmare_steampunk_main')
	character_util.remove_relate_event(steam_knight, self.controller.cs_controller)

	character_util.set_direction(steam_knight, 'left')

	character_util.convert_to_npc(ishya)
	character_util.move_waypoint(ishya, steam_knight.Position + vector(-1, 0, -1), 4, false, nil, nil, 'right')

	character_util.remove_anim(steam_knight)
	party_util.align_to_target(steam_knight.Position, 'left')

	character_util.normal_jump(steam_knight, '01_player_jump_01')

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(steam_knight, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s6_1', skip = true,
														portraitname = self.shyapira_portrait_name})
	--아이샤 님! 수사는 어떻게…

	choose_util.play_choose_event(
			{{'nightmare_steampunk_main_s6_2'}})
	--그 동안의 일을 설명해준다.

	character_util.set_emotion(leader, {name = 'attack'})
	character_util.set_anim(leader, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'})
	wait_for_sec(1.5)
	character_util.remove_anim(leader)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(leader, {name = 'greed'})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_drop_gold_01')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(leader, nil, 'gold')
	character_util.remove_emotion(leader)
	character_util.nod_twice(leader)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.set_emotion(steam_knight, {name = 'surprise'})
	character_util.normal_jump(steam_knight, '01_jump_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(steam_knight, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s6_3', skip = true,
															   portraitname = self.shyapira_portrait_name})
	--네에?! 그 조직을 소탕하지 않고, 손을 잡으셨다고요?!
	character_util.remove_emotion(steam_knight)

	character_util.play_speech_action(steam_knight, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'}, {name = 'tired'},
			{key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s6_4', skip = true, portraitname = self.shyapira_portrait_name})
	--아무리 돈이면 다 한다지만, 정말 순순히 자기 조직원을 자수시킬 리가…
	--]]

	--- 캐릭터 세팅
	local mover = {}
	local reporters = {}
	local prince_group = {get_character('prince'), get_character('prince_guard_1'), get_character('prince_guard_2')}

	for i = 1, 6 do
		local reporter = get_character('reporter_' .. i)
		mover[i] = reporter
		reporters[i] = reporter
	end

	for i = 1, #prince_group do
		table.insert(mover, prince_group[i])
	end

	for i = 1, #mover do
		character_util.set_with_marker(mover[i], field:GetMarker('s6_' .. mover[i].Name))
		character_util.move_waypoint(mover[i], mover[i].Position + vector(0, 0, 6), 3, false)
	end
	------------

	local center_pos = field:GetMarker('s6_center').position

	camera_util.move(center_pos + vector(0, 0, 0), 2)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_boss_intro', state = 'event', mix = 2 })
	local crowd_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_crowd_buzz_01', loop = true, fade_in_time = 2 })

	character_util.set_direction(ishya, 'left')
	character_util.move_waypoint(steam_knight, {steam_knight.Position + vector(0, 0, 1),
												steam_knight.Position + vector(-1, 0, 1)}, 4, false)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		party_util.align_to_target(leader.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0), 'right')
	end))

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function ()
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(prince_group[1], {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s6_5', skip = true})
			--아~ 이곳이 제 사랑하는 여동생 아이샤가 관리하는 캔터베리 수용소입니다.
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function ()
			wait_for_sec(1)

			character_util.move_waypoint(prince_group[1], {prince_group[1].Position + vector(-2, 0, 0),
														   prince_group[1].Position + vector(-2, 0, 2.5)}, 3, false, nil, nil, 'right')

			character_util.move_waypoint(prince_group[2], {prince_group[2].Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0),
														   prince_group[2].Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 4)}, 3, false, nil, nil, 'right')

			character_util.move_waypoint(prince_group[3], {prince_group[3].Position + vector(-3.5, 0, 0),
														   prince_group[3].Position + vector(-3.5, 0, 2)}, 3.6, false, nil, nil, 'right')

			wait_for_sec(1)

			for i = 1, #reporters do
				character_util.move_waypoint(reporters[i], reporters[i].Position + vector(0, 0, 1.5), 3, false)
			end
		end)
	})

	character_util.set_with_marker(faker, field:GetMarker('s6_' .. faker.Name))

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.play_speech_action(prince_group[1], {name = 'question', loop = false}, {name = 'doyagao'},
			{key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s6_6', skip = true})
	--작고 귀엽고 하찮다고 얕보면 큰일납니다, 여러분…

	character_util.set_position(faker, faker.Position + vector(0, 0, 1))

	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.4)
	character_util.set_direction(prince_group[1], 'down')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_01')
	character_util.play_speech_action(prince_group[1], {name = 'taunt', loop = false}, {name = 'attack'},
			{key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s6_7', skip = true})
	--여기 캔터베리 수용민들은 복수를 위해 제국인들을 호시탐탐 노리고 있으니까요!

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function ()
			character_util.set_direction(prince_group[1], 'right')
			character_util.set_emotion(prince_group[1], {name = 'smile'})
			character_util.set_anim(prince_group[1], {name = 'sing'})

			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(prince_group[1], {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s6_8', skip = true})
			--일전에 바로 이곳에서 살인 사건이 일어났죠.

		end),
		util.cs_generator(function ()
			character_util.move_waypoint_async(faker, faker.Position + vector(0, 0, 3), 2, false)
		end)
	})

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function ()
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(prince_group[1], {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s6_8_1', skip = true})
			--소중한 우리 제국민을 노린 잔혹한 캔터버리인의 혐오 범죄!

			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(prince_group[1])

			character_util.normal_double_jump(reporters[1], '01_small_jump_01')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(reporters[1], {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s6_9', skip = true})
			--해당 사건은 아직 수사가 끝나지 않은 것으로 알고 있는데요!
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function ()
			character_util.move_waypoint_async(faker, {faker.Position + vector(0.8, 0, 0),
													   faker.Position + vector(0.8, 0, 1)}, 1, false)

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(faker, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s6_10', skip = true})
			--저… 저기…
		end)
	})

	character_util.set_direction(prince_group[1], 'down')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(prince_group[1], {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s6_11', skip = true})
	--뻔한 결과에 시간을 들이는건 관료주의적 폐해일 뿐이죠.

	character_util.set_anim(prince_group[1], {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(prince_group[1], {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s6_11_1', skip = true})
	--캔터베리인들이 폭력성은 제국민들 모두 익히 알고 계시지 않습니까?
	character_util.remove_anim(prince_group[1])

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function ()
			character_util.move_waypoint_async(faker, {faker.Position + vector(0, 0, 1),
												 faker.Position + vector(-0.8, 0, 1)}, 1, false,
					nil, nil, 'up')
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(faker, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s6_11_2', skip = true})
			--저기요…
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function ()
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
			character_util.set_anim(reporters[2], {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'})
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(reporters[2], {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s6_11_3', skip = true})
			--아이샤 님, 수사를 직접 진행하신다던데 공정성에 문제는 없는 건가요?!
			character_util.remove_anim(reporters[2])
		end)
	})

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function ()
			wait_for_sec(0.5)

			character_util.set_emotion(prince_group[1], {name = 'attack'})
			character_util.set_direction(prince_group[1], 'right')
			character_util.normal_double_jump(prince_group[1], '01_jump_01')
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(prince_group[1], {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s6_11_4', skip = true})
			--아이, 이건 뭐야! 지금 기자 분들 질문하시는데!
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function ()
			character_util.move_waypoint_async(faker, {faker.Position + vector(0, 0, 1.5)}, 1,
					false, nil, nil, 'right')
		end)
	})

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(faker, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s6_11_5', skip = true})
	--자수하러… 왔는데요…

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_final_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_shout_05')
	crowd_sfx:FadeOut(1.5)
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'muted', mix = 2})
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.5)

	--- 모두가 ! 띄움
	for i = 1, #prince_group do
		character_util.show_emoticon(prince_group[i], nil, 'notice')
	end

	for i = 1, #reporters do
		character_util.show_emoticon(reporters[i], nil, 'notice')
	end

	for i = 1, #prince_group do
		character_util.show_emoticon(prince_group[i], nil, 'notice')
	end

	self.is_scrap_shake = false
	local refugees = {}
	for i = 1, 8 do
		local refugee = get_character('sub_refugee_' .. i)
		character_util.show_emoticon(refugee, nil, 'notice')

		character_util.set_emotion(refugee, {name = 'surprise'})
		character_util.remove_anim(refugee)

		local clms = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerLookAtState.Create(refugee, faker)
		refugee:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(clms))

		refugees[i] = refugee
	end

	character_util.show_emoticon(ishya, nil, 'notice')
	character_util.show_emoticon(steam_knight, nil, 'notice')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(leader, nil, 'notice')

	self.crowd_faker_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_amb_interview_01', loop = true, fade_in_time = 2 })
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.flash_light, self))

	character_util.set_emotion(prince_group[1], {name = 'attack'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(prince_group[1], {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s6_11_5_1', skip = true})
	--…뭐라고?!

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(reporters[4], {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s6_11_5_2', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout'})
	--자수라고!

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(reporters[5], {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s6_11_5_3', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout'})
	--진범이다!

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(faker, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s6_11_6', skip = true})
	--제가… 살인을 했습니다…

	character_util.set_emotion(prince_group[1], {name = 'tired'})

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(steam_knight)
	party_util.remove_emotion()
	party_util.remove_animation()

	character_util.normal_double_jump(refugees[1], '01_small_jump_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(refugees[1], {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s6_12', skip = true})
	--부, 붉은 두건! 나, 저 사람 뒷골목에서 봤어!

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(refugees[7], {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s6_13', skip = true})
	--캔터베리인이 범인이 아니었잖아!

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(refugees[4], {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s6_14', skip = true})
	--제국인이었어!

	character_util.set_emotion(prince_group[1], {name = 'smile'})
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(prince_group[1], nil, 'sweat')
	character_util.set_emotion(prince_group[1], {name = 'tired'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(prince_group[1], {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s6_15', skip = true})
	--너, 넌 대체…

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(prince_group[1], {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s6_16', skip = true})
	--약속이 다르잖아 이건…!

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_anim(ishya, {name = 'nod', loop = false, scale = 0.5})
	wait_for_sec(1)
	character_util.set_anim(ishya, {name = 'cross_arm'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ishya, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s6_17', skip = true,
														portraitname = self.ishya_portrait_name})
	--네가… 붉은 두건을 쓴 진범이란 말이지…

	character_util.nod_twice(faker)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(faker, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s6_18', skip = true})
	--네… 맞습니다…!

	character_util.remove_anim(ishya)
	character_util.set_direction(ishya, 'up')
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'down')

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ishya, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s6_20', skip = true,
														portraitname = self.ishya_portrait_name})
	--부소장, 자수한 용의자를 심문하도록.

	character_util.nod_twice(leader)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('nightmare_steampunk_main', self.quest_spec.QuestId,
			self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, faker)

	character_util.convert_to_party_member(ishya, user_party, true)

	character_util.convert_to_party_member(steam_knight, user_party, true)

	character_util.add_listener(faker, self.controller.cs_controller)

	for i = 1, #refugees do
		character_util.stop(refugees[i])
	end
end

-- 가짜를 심문

	end

function local_class:scrap_shake()
	local timer = 0.35
	local duration = 0.75

	self.is_scrap_shake = true
	while self.is_scrap_shake do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if timer >= duration then
			timer = 0
			for i = 1, 4 do
				get_field_object('event_scrap_' .. i):Shake(0.04, 0.5)
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(train_master, { key = 'nightmare_steampunk_rail_connect_12', bubble_direction = 'lt', skip = true })

	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(train_master, { name = 'eat', loop = true }, { name = 'attack' })

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

end

	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

local local_class = newclass('NightmareSteampunkRailConnectSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = NightmareSteampunkRailConnect @
		Comment = 나이트메어 라제국 선로조작 퀘스트 @
		Index = 0 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	-- 퀘스트 마커 이름
	self.quest_marker_name = 'rail_connect'

	-- 미니게임 이름
	self.game_name = 'pipe_game'

	-- 열차장과 첫 대화를 했는가?
	self.is_talk_train_master = false

	-- 곡괭이 ItemSpec Id
	self.pickaxe_item_id = 20133

	-- 수용소 병사에게 맞는 이팩트 이름
	self.hit_effect = 'FX_hit'

	-- 열차장 최초 좌표
	self.train_master_origin_pos = nil

	-- 스타피스 가져오는 함수
	self.get_star_piece = function() return get_field_object('rail_connect_star_piece') end

	-- 수용소 군인 캐릭터 가져오는 함수
	self.get_camp_soldier = function(num) return get_character('camp_soldier_' .. num) end

	-- 일반 군인 캐릭터 가져오는 함수
	self.get_soldier = function(num) return get_character('rail_connect_soldier_' .. num) end

	-- marker
	self.get_tourist_end_marker = function(num) return field:GetMarker('tourist_end_' .. num) end
	self.get_tourist_drop_point = function() return field:GetMarker('tourist_drop_point') end
	self.get_pickaxe_pos = function(num) return field:GetMarker('pickaxe_pos_' .. num) end

	-- 관광객들이랑 대화중인지 체크용 bool
	self.is_talk_tourist = { false, false, false, false }

	-- 관광객 대화 string key
	self.interact_tourist_talk_key = 'nightmare_steampunk_rail_connect_tourist_'

	-- 미니게임을 진행 했었는가?
	self.is_active_mini_game = false

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadActivityClear()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent), 'on_mini_game_end_event')
	-- 열차장 세팅
	local train_master = self.controller.get_train_master()
	character_util.set_active_state(train_master, 'enabled')
	character_util.add_listener(train_master, self.controller)
	character_util.set_direction(train_master, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim(train_master, { name = 'eat', loop = true })
	self.train_master_origin_pos = train_master.Position

	local tourist_emotion_name = { 'smile', 'mad', 'smile', 'tired' }
	-- 관광객들 세팅
	for i = 1, 4 do
		local tourist = self.controller.get_tourist(i)
		local marker = self.controller.get_tourist_start_marker(i)

		character_util.add_listener(tourist, self.controller)
		character_util.set_active_state(tourist, 'enabled')
		character_util.set_direction(tourist, i <= 2 and 'right' or 'left')
		character_util.set_emotion(tourist, { name = tourist_emotion_name[i] })
		character_util.set_position(tourist, marker.position)
	end

	-- 열차 위치 세팅
	local train = self.controller.get_train()
	character_util.set_active_state(train, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_direction(train, 'up')
	character_util.set_position(train, self.controller.get_train_pos(1).position)

	-- 열차장에게 퀘스트 마커를 달아준다.
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, train_master)

	-- 이팩트를 PreLoad
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect)

	yield_return(unity_object_pool, 'WaitAll')

	return true
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil

	self.is_talk_tourist = nil
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent))
	local train_master = self.controller.get_train_master()
	character_util.remove_relate_event(train_master, self.cs_controller)

	for i = 1, 4 do
		local tourist = self.controller.get_tourist(i)
		character_util.remove_relate_event(tourist, self.cs_controller)
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local train_master = self.controller.get_train_master()

	-- 열차장 대화후 퀘스트 시작
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, train_master) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.quest_start, self))
		return true
	end

	for i = 1, 4 do
		local tourist = self.controller.get_tourist(i)
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, tourist) and not self.is_talk_tourist[i] then
			self.is_talk_tourist[i] = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_tourist, self, tourist, i))
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

-- 기차레일이 연결되지 않아 대기중인 관광객들과 상호작용시
function local_class:interact_tourist(tourist, index)
	local key = self.interact_tourist_talk_key .. index .. '_' .. (self.is_active_mini_game == false and 1 or 2)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(tourist, { key = key, life_time = 1 })
	wait_for_sec(2)
	self.is_talk_tourist[index] = false
end

function local_class:on_mini_game_end_event(e)
	if e.Name == self.game_name then
		if e.Success then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.mini_game_success, self)
		else
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.mini_game_fail, self)
		end
		return true
	end
end


-- 기차장에게 말을 걸어서 퀘스트를 시작
function local_class:quest_start()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	local train_master = self.controller.get_train_master()

	-- Directing) 파티원들이 열차장 앞으로 정렬
	party_util.align_party(train_master.Position, 'right', 0.5, 'linear')

	-- Directing) 왼쪽으로 돌아보고 있을 때만 딜레이를 준다.
	local tm_direction = CS.Oak.IFieldObjectExtensions.GetLookDirection(train_master)
	if tm_direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		wait_for_sec(0.15)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(train_master)
		wait_for_sec(0.35)
	end

	character_util.set_direction(train_master, 'right')

	if not self.is_talk_train_master then
		self:first_quest_talk(train_master)
	else
		-- 선로 연결을 도와주시겠어요?
		character_util.set_emotion(train_master, { name = 'tired' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(train_master, { key = 'nightmare_steampunk_rail_connect_22', skip = true })
	end
	self.is_talk_train_master = true

	local is_accepted = quest_util.process_quest_request(self.quest_spec.QuestId, false)
	if is_accepted then
		-- Directing) 리더 고개 두번 끄덕임
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party_leader, { name = 'smile' })
		character_util.nod_twice(user_party_leader)
		character_util.remove_emotion(user_party_leader)

		-- 감사합니다!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(train_master)
		character_util.set_emotion(train_master, { name = 'smile' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(train_master, { key = 'nightmare_steampunk_rail_connect_19', skip = true })

		if not self.is_active_mini_game then
			-- Directing) 열차장 관광객들 앞으로 이동
			character_util.remove_emotion(train_master)
			local way_point_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
			way_point_list:Add(self.train_master_origin_pos + vector(0, 0, -0.8))
			way_point_list:Add(self.train_master_origin_pos + vector(2.5, 0, -0.8))
			character_util.move_waypoint_async(train_master, way_point_list, 4)

			-- 열차 곧 출발합니다. 탑승하세요!
			character_util.set_animation_n_times(train_master, { name = 'release', sfx = '01_swing_01', count = 2 })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(train_master, { key = 'nightmare_steampunk_rail_connect_20', bubble_direction = 'lt', skip = true })
			character_util.remove_anim(train_master)
		end
		self.is_active_mini_game = true

		-- 퀘스트 마커 제거
		quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_name)

		-- 페이드 아웃
		screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		-- 관광객들 Disabled
		for i = 1, 4 do
			local tourist = self.controller.get_tourist(i)
			character_util.set_active_state(tourist, 'disabled')
		end

		-- 미니게임 준비
		-- 미니 게임이 로드 될 때 까지 기다림.
		local is_mini_game_load_complete = false
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.MiniGameLoadEvent.Create(self.game_name, 'nightmare_steampunk_3', function()
			is_mini_game_load_complete = true
		end))

		while not is_mini_game_load_complete do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		-- 카메라 세팅
		local pos = field:GetMarker('pipe_game_camera_position')
		local camera_size = CS.Oak.StageCamera.DefaultCameraSize > 4 and 8.5 or 7.5
		camera_util.resize_to(camera_size, 0)
		camera_util.move_async(pos.position, 0)

		-- 페이드 인
		screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		-- 좌측 아래쪽으로 선로를 연결하면 됩니다.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(train_master, { key = 'nightmare_steampunk_rail_connect_start_1', screen_pos = vector(180, -10), scale = 1.6, skip = true })

		-- 열차 속도는 점점 빨라지니 주의하세요.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(train_master, { key = 'nightmare_steampunk_rail_connect_start_2', screen_pos = vector(180, -10), scale = 1.6, skip = true })

		-- 이제 그럼 시작해보죠.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(train_master, { key = 'nightmare_steampunk_rail_connect_start_3', screen_pos = vector(180, -10), scale = 1.6, skip = true })

		-- 미니게임 시작
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.MiniGameStartEvent.Create(self.game_name))
	else
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(train_master)

		wait_for_sec(0.1)
		-- 예…바쁘시면 어쩔 수 없죠.
		character_util.set_emotion(train_master, { name = 'tired' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(train_master, { key = 'nightmare_steampunk_rail_connect_21', skip = true })

-- 미니게임 성공
function local_class:mini_game_success()
	local crowd_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_crowd_clap_03' })
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowActivityClear()
	wait_for_sec(2)

	-- Directing) Fade Out 및 카메라를 퀘스트 완료 연출시점으로 이동
	crowd_sfx:FadeOut(1.5)
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0)
	camera_util.move_async(vector(99, 0, 109.8), 0)

	-- 수용소 군인들 세팅
	local camp_soliders = {}
	for i = 1, 2 do
		local solider = self.get_camp_soldier(i)
		character_util.reset_all_state(solider)
		character_util.set_direction(camp_soliders, 'right')
		table.insert(camp_soliders, solider)
	end

	-- 관광객들 최초 위치 세팅
	local drop_point_pos = self.get_tourist_drop_point().position
	local tourists = {}
	for i = 1, 4 do
		local tourist = self.controller.get_tourist(i)
		character_util.set_active_state(tourist, 'enabled')
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(tourist)
		character_util.set_position(tourist, drop_point_pos)
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(tourist, 0, 0)
		table.insert(tourists, tourist)
	end

	-- 열차의 좌표를 도착지점으로 세팅
	local train = self.controller.get_train()
	train.SpineController:CancelDeviateLocalAngle()
	train.SpineController:CancelDeviateLocal()
	character_util.remove_anim(train)
	character_util.set_active_state(train, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_direction(train, 'left')
	character_util.set_position(train, self.controller.get_train_pos(2).position)

	-- 곡괭이들 세팅
	local pickaxes = self:get_pickaxes()

	-- Fade In
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- Directing) 열차에서 내리는 연출
	local tourists_end_pos
	for i = 1, 4 do
		tourists_end_pos = self.get_tourist_end_marker(i).position
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(tourists[i], 1, 0.6)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')
		if i == 4 then
			character_util.move_waypoint_async(tourists[i], tourists_end_pos, 5.5)
		else
			character_util.move_waypoint(tourists[i], tourists_end_pos, 5.5)
		end
		wait_for_sec(0.4)
	end

	-- Directing) 이누이트 관광객 좌,우 두리번 거림
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(tourists[4], 'right')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(tourists[4], 'left')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 어라? 다음 투어 장소, 캐츠비의 파티장이라며?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	character_util.set_emotion(tourists[4], { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(tourists[4], { key = 'nightmare_steampunk_rail_connect_23', skip = true })

	-- 입소를 환영한다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(camp_soliders[1], { key = 'nightmare_steampunk_rail_connect_24', skip = true })

	-- 이쪽 채광 라인 책임자는 나니까, 앞으로 내 지시를 잘 따르도록.
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(camp_soliders[1], { name = 'release', sfx = '01_swing_01', count = 2 })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(camp_soliders[1], { key = 'nightmare_steampunk_rail_connect_25', skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(camp_soliders[1])

	-- Directing) 티탄 남여 서로 마주보고 웃는다.
	character_util.set_direction(tourists[1], 'right')
	character_util.set_emotion(tourists[1], { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.set_emotion(tourists[3], { name = 'smile' })

	-- 여기 가이드인가 봐! 컨셉 되게 웃기다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_ghost_laugh_evil_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(tourists[1], { key = 'nightmare_steampunk_rail_connect_26', skip = true })
	character_util.remove_emotion(tourists[1])
	character_util.remove_emotion(tourists[3])
	character_util.set_direction(tourists[1], 'left')

	-- 정숙! 수용복 배급은 저녁에나 가능할 것 같으니, 금일은 사복으로 복무한다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(camp_soliders[1], { name = 'attack' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(camp_soliders[1], { key = 'nightmare_steampunk_rail_connect_27', skip = true })

	-- 각자 앞의 곡괭이를 집고 광석을 캔다. 실시!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(camp_soliders[1], { name = 'release', sfx = '01_swing_01', count = 2 })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(camp_soliders[1], { key = 'nightmare_steampunk_rail_connect_28', auto_layout = true, bubble_type = 'shout', skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(camp_soliders[1])

	-- 뭐지? 광석 캐기 체험인가? 재밌겠다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(tourists[1], { name = 'smile' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_small_jump_01')
	character_util.jump(tourists[1], 0.5, 0.3)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(tourists[1], { key = 'nightmare_steampunk_rail_connect_29', skip = true })
	character_util.remove_emotion(tourists[1])

	-- 하… 또 구질구질하게 이런 걸 관광이라고.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(tourists[2], { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(tourists[2], { key = 'nightmare_steampunk_rail_connect_30', skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(tourists[2])

	-- Directing) 설인 남자 수용소장 앞으로 이동
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(tourists[2], camp_soliders[1].Position + vector(1, 0, 0), 4, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'left', true)

	-- Directing) 노역소장, 병사 surprise
	for i = 1, #camp_soliders do
		character_util.set_emotion(camp_soliders[i], { name = 'surprise' })
	end

	-- 큰 돈 주고 투어 열차 타러 왔더니. 유령 나오는 폐가로도 모자라서 뭐, 광석 캐기?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	character_util.set_emotion(tourists[2], { name = 'mad' })
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(tourists[2], { name = 'release', sfx = '01_swing_01', count = 1 })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(tourists[2], { key = 'nightmare_steampunk_rail_connect_31', skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(tourists[2])

	-- Directing) 노역소장, 병사 idle
	for i = 1, #camp_soliders do
		character_util.remove_emotion(camp_soliders[i])
	end

	-- 돈 벌기 쉽지, 아주 그냥? 딱 기다려. 내가 쉬버링 소비자 보호원에 연락해서 너네 아주 그냥 다 묵사발을 내줄 테니까!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(tourists[2], { key = 'nightmare_steampunk_rail_connect_32', type_speed = 0.0325, force_sfx = true })
	wait_for_sec(2.15)

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(tourists[2])
	character_util.remove_anim(tourists[2])
	character_util.set_emotion(tourists[2], { name = 'damaged' })

	-- Directing) 수용소 군인1이 설인 관광객을 친다
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
	character_util.spine_deviate_local(camp_soliders[1], vector(1, 0, 0), 0.1, 0.1)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(camp_soliders[1], { name = 'bomb_attack', loop = false, scale = 1.2, next_anim = 'idle' }, { name = 'damaged' })

	camera_util.shake(0.4, 0.2)

	-- Directing) 티탄 1,2 관광객, 이누이트 관광객 놀라며 점프
	for i = 1, 4 do
		if i ~= 2 then
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(tourists[i])
			character_util.set_emotion(tourists[i], { name = 'surprise' })
			character_util.jump(tourists[i], 0.5, 0.3)
		end
	end

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect):Instantiate(tourists[2].Position)
	character_util.set_direction(tourists[2], 'left')
	character_util.set_anim(tourists[2], { name = 'prostrate' })
	character_util.jump(tourists[2], 1, 0.4)

	-- 으악!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_trip_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(tourists[2], { key = 'nightmare_steampunk_rail_connect_33', skip = true })
	character_util.move_to_async(tourists[2], tourists[2].Position + unity_class.vector3.right, 0.4, nil, false)
	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.shake(tourists[2], 0.06, 0.8)
	wait_for_sec(2)

	-- 아오... 하여간에 말 안 듣는 자식들 꼭 한 두명씩 있다니까.
	character_util.remove_emotion(camp_soliders[1])
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(camp_soliders[1], { key = 'nightmare_steampunk_rail_connect_34', skip = true })

	-- 다들 구경났나? 빨리빨리 움직인다, 실시!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(camp_soliders[1], { name = 'mad' })
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(camp_soliders[1], { name = 'release', sfx = '01_swing_01', count = 2 })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(camp_soliders[1], { key = 'nightmare_steampunk_rail_connect_35', bubble_type = 'shout', skip = true })

	-- 여기... 관광지 맞아...?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	character_util.shake(tourists[3], 0.06, 0.8)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(tourists[3], { key = 'nightmare_steampunk_rail_connect_36', skip = true })

	-- 페이드 아웃 후
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 남은 곡괭이 Dispose
	for i = 1, #pickaxes do
		pickaxes[i]:ConsumeComplete()
	end
	pickaxes = nil

	-- 관광객, 군인 disabled
	for i = 1, #tourists do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(tourists[i])
		character_util.set_active_state(tourists[i], 'disabled')
	end
	for i = 1, #camp_soliders do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(camp_soliders[i])
		character_util.set_active_state(camp_soliders[i], 'disabled')
	end

	self:ending()
end

function local_class:ending()
	-- 가짜 철도 관리인과 플레이어쪽으로 카메라 이동 후
	local train_master = self.controller.get_train_master()
	character_util.set_position(train_master, self.train_master_origin_pos)
	character_util.set_direction(train_master, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(train_master, { name = 'cross_arm' }, { name = 'doyagao' })
	party_util.align_party(train_master, 'right', 0)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	-- 진짜 철도 관리인과 병사 둘 좌표 세팅
	local real_train_master = self.controller:get_real_train_master()
	character_util.set_position(real_train_master, vector(57, 0, 35))

	local soliders = {}
	for i = 1, 2 do
		local solider = self.get_soldier(i)
		local position = vector(56, 0, 34) + vector((i - 1) * 2, 0, 0)
		character_util.set_position(solider, position)
		table.insert(soliders, solider)
	end

	-- 페이드 인
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 풉, 푸흐흐...
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_male_laugh_at_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(train_master, { name = 'cross_arm' }, { name = 'doyagao' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(train_master, { key = 'nightmare_steampunk_rail_connect_37', skip = true })

	-- 푸하하하하하하!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(train_master, { name = 'cast2' }, { name = 'attack' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(train_master, { key = 'nightmare_steampunk_rail_connect_38', skip = true })

	-- 감사합니다. 덕분에 관광객 분들에게 놀라운 경험을 선사해드렸군요.
	character_util.set_direction(train_master, 'right')
	character_util.set_emotion(train_master, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(train_master, { name = 'release', sfx = '01_swing_01', count = 2 })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(train_master, { key = 'nightmare_steampunk_rail_connect_39', skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(train_master)

	-- 별건 아니지만 도와주신 것에 대한 답례입니다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(train_master, { key = 'nightmare_steampunk_rail_connect_40', skip = true })

	-- 스타피스 드랍
	local star_piece = self.get_star_piece()
	star_piece_util.appear(star_piece, train_master.Position, nil)
	wait_for_sec(3)

	-- Directing) 가짜 철도 관리인과 플레이어 아래봄
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(train_master)
	character_util.set_direction(train_master, 'down')

	character_util.remove_emotion(user_party_leader)
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_direction(user_party[i], 'down')
	end

	-- Directing) 리더 scared 표정 및 점프
	character_util.set_emotion(train_master, { name = 'surprise' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
	character_util.jump(train_master, 0.5, 0.3)

	-- 저기, 저 자식입니다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.4, 0.2)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(user_party_leader, { key = 'nightmare_steampunk_rail_connect_41', bubble_type = 'shout', world_pos = vector(57, 0, 36.5), scale = 1.2, skip = true })

	-- Directing) 병사 둘과 진짜 열차장 등장
	local walk_sound = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_06' })
	for i = 1, #soliders do
		character_util.set_active_state(soliders[i], 'enabled')
		character_util.move_waypoint(soliders[i], vector(56, 0, 38) + vector((i - 1) * 2, 0, 0), 3.5, true, 'stop', 'floor', 'up')
	end
	character_util.set_active_state(real_train_master, 'enabled')
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(real_train_master, vector(57, 0, 39), 3.5, true, 'stop', 'floor', 'up')
	character_util.remove_emotion(train_master)
	walk_sound:Stop()

	-- 저 자식이에요! 제 옷 뺏어 입고 선로 관리원인 척 하는 놈!
	character_util.normal_double_jump(real_train_master, '01_small_jump_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(real_train_master, { key = 'nightmare_steampunk_rail_connect_42', skip = true })

	-- 칫, 방해하기는.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(train_master, { key = 'nightmare_steampunk_rail_connect_43', skip = true })

	-- 미개한 비제국민한테 관광 상품이나 파는 나약한 놈들!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(train_master, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(train_master, { name = 'release', sfx = '01_swing_01', count = 2 })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(train_master, { key = 'nightmare_steampunk_rail_connect_46', bubble_type = 'shout', skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(train_master)

	-- 위대한 라 제국이여 영원하라!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(train_master, { name = 'cast2' }, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(train_master, { key = 'nightmare_steampunk_rail_connect_44', bubble_type = 'shout', skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(train_master)

	-- Directing) 가짜 선로 관리원이 진짜 선로 관리원쪽으로 이동
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(train_master, real_train_master.Position, 6, true, 'stop', 'floor', 'down', true)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_trip_01')

	-- Directing) 진짜 선로 관리원 왼쪽으로 날아가며 군인들 놀람
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect):Instantiate(real_train_master.Position)
	character_util.set_direction(real_train_master, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(real_train_master, { name = 'prostrate' }, { name = 'confused' })
	character_util.jump(real_train_master, 1, 0.4)
	character_util.move_to(real_train_master, real_train_master.Position + unity_class.vector3.left, 0.4, nil, false)

	for i = 1, #soliders do
		character_util.set_direction(soliders[i], i == 1 and 'right' or 'left')
		character_util.set_emotion(soliders[i], { name = 'surprise' })
	end

	-- Directing) 가짜 선로 관리원 퇴장
	character_util.move_waypoint(train_master, train_master.Position + unity_class.vector3.back * 5, 6, true, 'stop', 'floor', 'down', true)
	wait_for_sec(2)

	-- 거기 서!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	walk_sound = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_06' })
	for i = 1, #soliders do
		character_util.set_direction(soliders[i], 'down')
		character_util.set_emotion(soliders[i], { name = 'attack' })
		character_util.move_waypoint(soliders[i], soliders[i].Position + unity_class.vector3.back * 5, 6, true, 'stop', 'floor', 'down', true)

		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local bankruptcy = self.get_bankruptcy()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, bankruptcy) and
			self.current_wolf_street_state == self.wolf_street_states.talk_bankrupt then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_to_bankrupt, self)
		return true
	end

	for i = 1, 4 do
		local table = self.get_table(i)
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, table) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.buy_stock, self, i)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
		return false
	end

	if e.Zone.Name == 'wolf_street_zone' and self.current_wolf_street_state == self.wolf_street_states.none then
		self.current_wolf_street_state = self.wolf_street_states.talk_bankrupt
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.start_wolf_street, self)
		return true
	end

	if e.Zone.Name == 'wolf_group_a' and self.current_wolf_street_state == self.wolf_street_states.select_stock and
			self.is_talk_group.group_a == false then
		self.is_talk_group.group_a = true
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_group_a, self)
		return true
	end

	if e.Zone.Name == 'wolf_group_b' and self.current_wolf_street_state == self.wolf_street_states.select_stock and
			self.is_talk_group.group_b == false then
		self.is_talk_group.group_b = true
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_group_b, self)
		return true
	end

	if e.Zone.Name == 'wolf_group_c' and self.current_wolf_street_state == self.wolf_street_states.select_stock and
			self.is_talk_group.group_c == false then
		self.is_talk_group.group_c = true
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_group_c, self)
		return true
	end

	if e.Zone.Name == 'wolf_group_d'and self.current_wolf_street_state == self.wolf_street_states.select_stock and
			self.is_talk_group.group_d == false then
		self.is_talk_group.group_d = true
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_group_d, self)
		return true
	end

	if e.Zone.Name == 'wolf_background_talk_1' and (self.current_wolf_street_state == self.wolf_street_states.none or
			self.current_wolf_street_state == self.wolf_street_states.talk_bankrupt) and
			self.is_background_talk_1 == false then
		self.is_background_talk_1 = true
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.background_talk_1, self))
		return true
	end

	if e.Zone.Name == 'wolf_background_talk_2'and (self.current_wolf_street_state == self.wolf_street_states.none or
			self.current_wolf_street_state == self.wolf_street_states.talk_bankrupt) and
			self.is_background_talk_2 == false then
		self.is_background_talk_2 = true
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.background_talk_2, self))
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) and
			not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party) then return false end

	local grid_name = e.CameraGrid.name

	if grid_name == 'wolf_lobby_grid' and not self.is_in_wolf_lobby_grid and
			self.current_wolf_street_state == self.wolf_street_states.none then
		if self.background_talk_sfx == nil then
			self.background_talk_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_shivermore_crowd_01', volume = 0.8
			, loop = true, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc', fade_in_time = 2 })
		else
			self.background_talk_sfx.Volume = 0.8
		end
			self.is_in_wolf_lobby_grid = true
	end

	if grid_name == 'wolf_street_grid' and not self.is_in_wolf_street_grid and
			self.current_wolf_street_state == self.wolf_street_states.none then
		self.is_in_wolf_street_grid = true
		self.background_talk_sfx.Volume = 1
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) and
			not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party) then return false end

	local grid_name = e.CameraGrid.name

	if grid_name == 'wolf_lobby_grid' and self.is_in_wolf_lobby_grid then
		self.is_in_wolf_lobby_grid = false
		if user_party.Leader.Position.z < 20 or user_party.Leader.Position.z > 29 then
			self.background_talk_sfx:FadeOut(1)
			self.background_talk_sfx = nil
		end

-- 파산녀와 대화
function local_class:talk_to_bankrupt()
	local bankruptcy = self.get_bankruptcy(i)

	party_util.align_party(bankruptcy.Position, 'right', 0.5, 'linear')

	local wait = true
	if self.is_talk_already == false then
		self.is_talk_already = true

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.remove_anim(bankruptcy)
		-- …어쩜 좋죠?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bankruptcy, { key = 'nightmare_steampunk_wolf_9', skip = true })

		character_util.set_emotion(bankruptcy, { name = 'tired' })
		-- 당장 가족들과 이사를 해야 하는데 상폐라니…!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bankruptcy, { key = 'nightmare_steampunk_wolf_10', skip = true })

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
		character_util.set_emotion(bankruptcy, { name = 'cry' })
		-- 흑흑! 나 같은 건 숨 쉴 자격도 없어!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bankruptcy, { key = 'nightmare_steampunk_wolf_11', skip = true })

		local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))

		-- 수업료가 필요한 법.
		branches:Add({
			Text = game_string:GetString('nightmare_steampunk_wolf_12'),
			Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy,
			Callback = function()
				wait = false
			end })
		-- 지금은 물이 차다.
		branches:Add({
			Text = game_string:GetString('nightmare_steampunk_wolf_13'),
			Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Brutal,
			Callback = function()
				wait = false
			end })

		ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(user_party.Leader, branches)

		while wait do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		character_util.set_emotion(bankruptcy, { name = 'tired' })
		-- 후… 아무래도 그렇겠죠?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bankruptcy, { key = 'nightmare_steampunk_wolf_14', skip = true })

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.set_direction(bankruptcy, 'down')
		character_util.set_anim(bankruptcy, { name = 'question', loop = false })
		-- 하지만 어떻게든 당장 보증금 마련하지 않으면…
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bankruptcy, { key = 'nightmare_steampunk_wolf_15', skip = true })

		character_util.remove_anim(bankruptcy)
		character_util.set_direction(bankruptcy, 'right')
		character_util.set_emotion(bankruptcy, { name = 'attack' })
		-- 저기요, 선생님!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bankruptcy, { key = 'nightmare_steampunk_wolf_16', skip = true })
	end

	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(bankruptcy, { name = 'sing'}, { name = 'smile' })
	-- 왠지 단맛 쓴맛 다 본 고수 같은데, 좋은 주식 하나 추천해주실래요?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bankruptcy, { key = 'nightmare_steampunk_wolf_17', skip = true })

	wait = true
	local pass = true
	local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))

	-- 수락한다.
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString('nightmare_steampunk_wolf_18'),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy,
		Callback = function()
			wait = false
		end })
	-- 거절한다.
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString('nightmare_steampunk_wolf_19'),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Brutal,
		Callback = function()
			wait = false
			pass = false
		end })

	ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(user_party.Leader, branches)

	while wait do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if not pass then
		character_util.set_emotion(bankruptcy, { name = 'tired' })
		character_util.remove_anim(bankruptcy)
		return
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(bankruptcy, { name = 'cast2'}, { name = 'smile'})
	-- 정말 감사합니다!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bankruptcy, { key = 'nightmare_steampunk_wolf_20', skip = true })
	-- 여기서 기다리고 있을 테니까, 좋은 걸로 골라주세요!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bankruptcy, { key = 'nightmare_steampunk_wolf_21', skip = true })

	for i = 1, 4 do
		local table = self.get_table(i)
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'stock_marker' .. i , table)
	end

	for i = 1, 4 do
		self.get_table(i).Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	end

	character_util.remove_relate_event(bankruptcy, self.cs_controller)
	quest_marker_util.remove('bankruptcy_marker')
	character_util.remove_anim(bankruptcy)

	character_util.remove_emotion(self.get_investor(1))
	character_util.remove_emotion(self.get_investor(3))
	character_util.remove_emotion(self.get_investor(4))
	character_util.remove_emotion(self.get_investor(5))

	self.current_wolf_street_state = self.wolf_street_states.select_stock
end

	party_util.align_party(self.table_pos[idx] + vector(0.5,0,0), 'down', 0.5, 'arc')

	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'nightmare_steampunk_wolf_' .. (21 + idx) })

	local wait = true
	local pass = true

	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString('nightmare_steampunk_wolf_26'),

		Callback = function()
			wait = false
		end })

local local_class = newclass('NightmareTeatanRescueSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = NightmareTeatanRescue @
		Comment = 로봇을 수리하여 딸에게 가져가면 딸이 바위를 부수고 아빠를 구출 @
		Index = 0 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.ifo_util = CS.Oak.IFieldObjectExtensions

	self.teatan_rescue_lady = 'teatan_rescue_lady'
	self.teatan_rescue_robot = 'teatan_rescue_robot'
	self.teatan_robot_lady = 'teatan_robot_lady'
	self.teatan_rescue_rock = 'teatan_rescue_rock'
	self.teatan_rescue_old = 'teatan_rescue_old'

	self.is_talking = false

	-- 로봇을 들고 있는지 체크하는 루틴이 돌고 있는지?
	self.is_check_holding_robot = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_levelup_new')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Env_BigRock_lv2_destroy')
	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))

	self.is_check_holding_robot = false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.ifo_util = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'lady_get_robot') and not self.is_talking then
			local robot = get_character(self.teatan_rescue_robot)
			local holder_check = lua_helper.reference_equals(robot.Holdable.Holder, user_party_leader)

			-- 리더가 CharacterHoldUpState 인지 체크
			local is_leader_hold_up = lua_helper.type_compare(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState,
					typeof(CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState))

			if is_leader_hold_up and holder_check then
				-- 로봇을 든 상태라면 바로 다음 이벤트 진행
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.give_robot
				, self, self.controller.is_repaired_robot))
			else
				-- self.is_check_holding_robot가 false일 때 (로직이 돌고 있지 않을때)만 코루틴 호출
				if not self.is_check_holding_robot then
					self.is_check_holding_robot = true
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.check_hold_up_robot
					, self))
				end
			end
			return true
		end
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, user_party.Leader, 'lady_get_robot') then
			-- 존 안에서 로봇을 드는지 확인하는 로직 플래그 false
			self.is_check_holding_robot = false
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

-- 로봇 주는 존에 들어왔을 때 체크 함수
function local_class:check_hold_up_robot()
	local robot = get_character(self.teatan_rescue_robot)
	while self.is_check_holding_robot do
		-- 대화중이지 않으면서 리더가 로봇을 들고 있을 때 give_robot 이벤트 시작

		-- 리더가 CharacterHoldUpState 인지 체크
		local is_leader_hold_up = lua_helper.type_compare(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState,
				typeof(CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState))

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(robot.Holdable.Holder, user_party_leader) and is_leader_hold_up
				and not self.is_talking then
			self.is_check_holding_robot = false
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.give_robot
			, self, self.controller.is_repaired_robot))
			break
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 손녀에게 로봇을 줌
function local_class:give_robot(check_repair)
	self.is_talking = true

	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	local teatan_lady = get_character(self.teatan_rescue_lady)
	local pos = teatan_lady.Position + 2 * unity_class.vector3.left
	user_party:PositionParty(pos, CS.Oak.Direction.Right, 1, CS.Oak.Party.AlignType.Linear)
	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1))

	character_util.set_direction(teatan_lady, 'left')

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_jump_01')

	character_util.set_anim(teatan_lady, { name = 'cliff' })
	character_util.set_emotion(teatan_lady, { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.jump(teatan_lady, 0.5, 0.3)
	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.3))

	character_util.remove_anim(teatan_lady)
	character_util.remove_emotion(teatan_lady)

	-- 앗! 그 로봇은…
	local string_key = 'nightmare_teatan_4_teatan_rescue_6'
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(teatan_lady, { key = string_key, skip = true })

	-- 기사님! 혹시 저에게 로봇을 빌려주실 수 있을까요?
	string_key = 'nightmare_teatan_4_teatan_rescue_7'
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(teatan_lady, { key = string_key, skip = true })

	local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))
	local wait = true
	local accepted = false

	-- 물론이지!
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString('nightmare_teatan_4_teatan_rescue_8'),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Normal,
		Callback = function()
			wait = false
			accepted = true
		end })

	-- 싫어!
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString('nightmare_teatan_4_teatan_rescue_9'),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Normal,
		Callback = function()
			wait = false
		end })

	ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(teatan_lady, branches)

	while wait do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if accepted then
		coroutine.yield(self:rescue_teatan(check_repair))
	else
		character_util.set_emotion(teatan_lady, { name = 'tired' })
		-- 네… 하지만 생각이 바뀌면 말씀해주세요.
		string_key = 'nightmare_teatan_4_teatan_rescue_10'
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(teatan_lady, { key = string_key, skip = true })

		character_util.set_direction(teatan_lady, 'right')

		self.is_talking = false

		field_ui_manager:Show()
		user_party:ResetControllers()
	end
end

-- 손녀가 로봇을 타고 할아버지를 구출
-- check_repair = 로봇 수리 여부에 따라 연출이 다름
function local_class:rescue_teatan(check_repair)
	local robot = get_character(self.teatan_rescue_robot)
	local teatan_lady = get_character(self.teatan_rescue_lady)

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.5))

	-- 들고있던 로봇을 놓은 상태로 함
	robot.Holdable:GetThrownBy(user_party_leader)
	message_system:SendSync(robot, CS.Oak.GetThrownEndEvent.Instance)
	message_system:SendSync(user_party_leader, CS.Oak.ReleaseHoldingObjectEvent.Create(user_party_leader))

	character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, { name = 'throw' })

	-- 던지는 sfx

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(current_time / fall_time)

local local_class = newclass('NightmareTeatansMainSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = NightmareTeatansMain @
		Comment =  주니어와의 만남 - 묘비에서 마리안과 주니어가 대화하는것 까지. @
		Index = 0 @
		NextSections = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	self.event_progress = {
		none = 0,
		run_juniors = 1,
		hold_marty_junior = 2,
		hold_talk_over = 3,
		marian_look_junior = 4,
		marian_talk_to_junior = 5
	}

	self.current_event_progress = self.event_progress.none

	self.marian = nil
	self.pc_teatan = nil
	self.marty_junior = nil
	self.junior_friend_1 = nil
	self.junior_friend_2 = nil
	self.junior_friend_3 = nil
	self.tdf_zaco_1 = nil
	self.tdf_zaco_2 = nil

	self.juniors_run_zone_name = 'juniors_run'
	self.hold_junior_zone_name = 'hold_marty_junior'

	quest_icon.PreLoad()
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.main_stage_1_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')

	self.marty_junior = get_character('marty_junior')
	self.junior_friend_1 = get_character('marty_junior_friend_1')
	self.junior_friend_2 = get_character('marty_junior_friend_2')
	self.junior_friend_3 = get_character('marty_junior_friend_3')
	self.tdf_zaco_1 = get_character('tdf_zaco_1')
	self.tdf_zaco_2 = get_character('tdf_zaco_2')
	self.marian = get_character('marian')
	self.pc_teatan = get_character('pc_teatan')
	self.children = { self.marty_junior, self.junior_friend_1, self.junior_friend_2, self.junior_friend_3 }

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("FX_hit")

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.main_stage_1_name then
		return true
	end

	-- 이전 섹션에서 바로 넘어왔다면 이어서 이벤트 실행
	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == -1 then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.launch_event, self, false))
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		if e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then
			if e.Zone.Name == self.juniors_run_zone_name and self.current_event_progress == self.event_progress.none then
				self.current_event_progress = self.event_progress.run_juniors
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.junior_attack_pc_event, self))

			elseif e.Zone.Name == self.hold_junior_zone_name and self.current_event_progress == self.event_progress.run_juniors then
				self.current_event_progress = self.event_progress.hold_marty_junior
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.hold_marty_junior_event, self))

			elseif e.Zone.Name == 'ignore_tdf_talk' and self.current_event_progress == self.event_progress.hold_talk_over then
				self.current_event_progress = self.event_progress.marian_look_junior
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.tdf_call_marian_event, self))

			elseif e.Zone.Name == 'ignore_marty_junior' and self.current_event_progress == self.event_progress.marian_look_junior then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.junior_crying, self))

			elseif e.Zone.Name == 'marian_talk_to_junior' and self.current_event_progress == self.event_progress.marian_look_junior then
				self.current_event_progress = self.event_progress.marian_talk_to_junior
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.marian_talk_to_junior_event, self))
			end
		end
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.tdf_zaco_1) and self.current_event_progress == self.event_progress.hold_talk_over then
			self.current_event_progress = self.event_progress.marian_look_junior
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_to_tdf_event, self))
		end
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.StageStartEvent) and stage.Name == self.controller.main_stage_1_name then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.launch_event, self, true))
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:launch_event(is_circular)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	-- bgm_transition: Muted -> Field(bgm_teatans_main)
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({
		state = 'field'
	})

	-- 마리안 파티로 세팅
	local marian = get_character('marian')
	marian.Position = user_party[user_party.Count - 1].Position + unity_class.vector3.back
	marian:RemoveAnimation()
	marian:RemoveEmotion()
	marian.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	local fs = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerPartyFollowerNPCState.Create(marian, user_party, 0, 0, false, CS.Oak.NpcFollowingStateInBattle.OutBattleZone)
	message_system:Send(marian.FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(fs))

	screen_util.fade_in(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	if is_circular == true then
		screen_util.fade_in_circular(1, CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInOutSine)
	else
		screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutSine)
	end

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.marty_juniors_run, self))

	local start_marker = stage.Field:GetMarker('default_start')
	local dir = CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(start_marker.direction)
	local target_pos = user_party_leader.Position + dir * 0.5
	local stage_name = game_string:GetString(stage.Name)
	coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.DirectionalStageEntry(target_pos, start_marker.direction, stage_name))

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)

	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

function local_class:child_run(child, land_pos, speed, wait_time)
	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(wait_time))

	local jump_time = 0.5

	child:Jump(1.75, jump_time)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(child, land_pos, (land_pos - child.Position).magnitude / jump_time, false, nil, 'flying')
	child:RemoveAnimation()

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(child, vector(-19, 1, 4), speed, true, nil, 'flying')

	child.Direction = character_util.get_direction('down')
	child:SetAnimation('idle', true)
	child:Jump(0.7, jump_time)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(child, vector(-19, 0, 2.5), (vector(-19, 0, 2.5) - child.Position).magnitude / jump_time, false)
	child:RemoveAnimation()

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(child, vector(2, 0, 2.5), speed, true)
end

function local_class:marty_juniors_run()
	local marty_junior = get_character('marty_junior')
	local junior_friend_1 = get_character('marty_junior_friend_1')
	local junior_friend_2 = get_character('marty_junior_friend_2')
	local junior_friend_3 = get_character('marty_junior_friend_3')
	local children = { marty_junior, junior_friend_1, junior_friend_2, junior_friend_3 }

	local interval = 0.15
	local wait_routines = {}
	for i, child in ipairs(children) do
		child.Position = vector(-27, 1, 4)
		child:SetEmotion('smile', true)
		child:SetAnimation('get', true)
		child.Direction = character_util.get_direction('right')

		wait_routines[i] = util.cs_generator(self.child_run, self, child, vector(-23, 1, 4), 8, interval * i)
	end

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_all(table.unpack(wait_routines)))

	-- 애들 아줌마 앞으로 정렬 시키기
	local align_pos = vector(34, 0, 2.5)
	local setting_pos = {
		align_pos + unity_class.vector3.right,
		align_pos + unity_class.vector3.right * 1.5 + unity_class.vector3.forward * 0.5,
		align_pos + unity_class.vector3.right * 1.5,
		align_pos + unity_class.vector3.right * 2
	}
	local child_directions = {'left', 'down', 'left', 'left'}

	for i, child in ipairs(children) do
		character_util.set_position(child, setting_pos[i])
		child.Direction = character_util.get_direction(child_directions[i])

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(child, marty_junior) then
			child:SetEmotion('mad', true)
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(child, junior_friend_2) then
			child:SetEmotion('damaged', true)
			child:SetAnimation('prostrate', true)
		else
			child:SetEmotion('tired', true)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:junior_attack_pc_event()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	camera_util.move_async(vector(35, 0, 2), 1, { ignorecameragrids = true })

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_kid_boy_shout_01')

	self.marty_junior:SetEmotion('attack', true)
	self.marty_junior:SetAnimation('release', true)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.marty_junior, { key = 'nightmare_teatans_s1_0_1_1', skip = true })
	self.marty_junior:RemoveAnimation()

	self.pc_teatan:SetAnimation('release', true)
	character_util.add_animation_sfx(self.pc_teatan, '01_swing_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.pc_teatan, { key = 'nightmare_teatans_s1_0_1_2', skip = true })

	self.pc_teatan:SetEmotion('doyagao', true)
	self.pc_teatan:SetAnimation('idle', true)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.pc_teatan, { key = 'nightmare_teatans_s1_0_2', skip = true })

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_small_jump_01')

	self.marty_junior:SetEmotion('mad', true)
	self.marty_junior:Jump(0.5, 0.3)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.marty_junior, { key = 'nightmare_teatans_s1_0_2_0', skip = true})

	self.pc_teatan:SetEmotion('attack', true)
	self.pc_teatan:SetAnimation('release', true)
	character_util.add_animation_sfx(self.pc_teatan, '01_swing_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.pc_teatan, { key = 'nightmare_teatans_s1_0_2_1' })
	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(3.1))

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(self.marty_junior, self.marty_junior.Position + unity_class.vector3.left * 0.5, 3, false)
	character_util.set_anim(self.marty_junior, {name = 'gauntlet_handskill2', loop = false, scale = 2})
	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.225))
	self.marty_junior:RemoveAnimation()

	for _, child in ipairs(self.children) do
		if not lua_helper.reference_equals(child, self.marty_junior) then
			child:SetEmotion('surprise', true)
			child:SetAnimation('idle', true)
			child:Jump(0.5, 0.3)
		end
	end

	self.tdf_zaco_1.Direction = character_util.get_direction('right')
	self.tdf_zaco_1:Jump(0.5, 0.3)
	self.tdf_zaco_2.Direction = character_util.get_direction('right')
	self.tdf_zaco_2:Jump(0.5, 0.3)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_hit_critical_01')

	camera_util.shake(0.25, 0.1)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("FX_hit"):Instantiate(self.pc_teatan.Position + unity_class.vector3.left * 0.3 + unity_class.vector3.forward * 0.1)

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.DyingEndEvent))

	self.junior_friend_1 = nil
	self.junior_friend_2 = nil
	self.junior_friend_3 = nil
	self.marian = nil
	self.harvester = nil

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		if e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then
			if e.Zone.Name == self.save_junior_zone_name and self.current_event_progress == self.event_progress.none then
				self.current_event_progress = self.event_progress.save_junior
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.save_junior_event, self))
			elseif e.Zone.Name == self.junior_friend_1.Name .. '_talk' and not self.friend_1_talked then
				self.friend_1_talked = true
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.junior_friend_1, { key = 'junior_friend_oneline_1' })
			elseif e.Zone.Name == self.junior_friend_2.Name .. '_talk' and not self.friend_2_talked then
				self.friend_2_talked = true
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.junior_friend_2, { key = 'junior_friend_oneline_2' })
			elseif e.Zone.Name == self.junior_friend_3.Name .. '_talk' and not self.friend_3_talked then
				self.friend_3_talked = true
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.junior_friend_3, { key = 'junior_friend_oneline_3' })
			end
		end
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.harvester, e.FieldObject) and self.current_event_progress == self.event_progress.save_junior then
			self.current_event_progress = self.event_progress.talk_junior
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.junior_and_marian_talk, self))
		end
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.DyingEndEvent) then
		self.boss_death = lua_helper.reference_equals(self.harvester, e.character)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:marian_superaction_cannon_fire(target_spine, sub_spine)
	local cannon_bone_names = {
		'fx1',
		'fx4',
		'fx2',
		'fx3'
	}

	local timing_count = 4
	local cannon_timings = {
		2 / 30,
		6 / 30 - 2 / 30,
		9 / 30 - 6 / 30,
		13 / 30 - 9 / 30,
	}

	--local spine_frame_per_sec = 30
	--for i, v in ipairs(cannon_timings) do
	--	cannon_timings[i] = v / spine_frame_per_sec
	--end

	local effect_dir = unity_class.vector3.left + unity_class.vector3.forward * 1.5
	local time_passed = 0
	local index = 1
	local shoot_timing = cannon_timings[1]

	while (time_passed <= self.fire_time) do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if time_passed >= shoot_timing then
			local bone = CS.Oak.SpineControllerExtensions.GetBone(target_spine, cannon_bone_names[index])
			local pos = CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.GetSpineEffectPosition(bone, target_spine, self.marian.Position, 1);

			CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.Instantiate(unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.marian_cannon_fire), pos, effect_dir)

			unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.marian_cannon_explosion):Instantiate(self.harvester.Position)

			stage_camera:Shake(0.2, 0.1)

			index = index == timing_count and 1 or index + 1
			shoot_timing = shoot_timing + cannon_timings[index]
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 이펙트 나오는 부분이 끝났음에도 불구하고 다른 coroutine을 기다리는 작업을 수행중이라 애니메이션이 지속됨
	local base_track = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.Character.SpineAnimationTrack.Base)
	sub_spine:ClearTrack(base_track)
	sub_spine:SetAnimation(base_track, 'idleF', false)

	target_spine:ClearTrack(base_track)
	target_spine:SetAnimation(base_track, 'idleB', false)
end

function local_class:marian_superaction_missile_fire(target_spine)
	local launcher_bone_names = {
		'missileUL',
		'missileDL',
		'missileUR',
		'missileDR'
	}
	local target_pos_offsets = {
		vector(1.7, 0, 3.5),
		vector(1.4, 0, 2),
		vector(1.2, 0, 0.5)
	}

	local cb = function ()
		local harvester = get_character('harvester')
		harvester:SetAnimation('damaged', true)
		harvester.SpineController:DamageRedPulse()
		harvester.SpineController:DamageSquish(0.6)
	end

	local time_passed = 0
	local index = 1;
	local shoot_interval = 0.08

	while (time_passed <= self.fire_time) do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if time_passed >= shoot_interval * index then
			local idx = index - 4 * math.floor((index- 1) / 4)
			local bone_name = launcher_bone_names[idx]
			local h = (bone_name == 'missileUL' or bone_name == 'missileUR') and 0.5 or 0.25
			local bone = CS.Oak.SpineControllerExtensions.GetBone(target_spine, bone_name)
			local start_pos = CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.GetSpineEffectPosition(bone, target_spine, self.marian.Position, h);
			local target_pos = self.harvester.Position + target_pos_offsets[CS.Utils.GetRandomInt(1, 4)]

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.shoot_missile, self, start_pos, target_pos, 0.25, false, cb))

			index = index + 1
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 마리안이 점프해서 하베스터한테 미사일 쏘는 거
function local_class:marian_jump_shot_missile(duration, wait_time)
	if wait_time ~= nil and wait_time > 0 then
		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(wait_time))
	end

	local target_pos_offsets = {
		vector(1.7, 0, 3.5),
		vector(1.4, 0, 2),
		vector(1.2, 0, 0.5)
	}

	local shoot_pos = self.marian.Position + unity_class.vector3.left * 1.5 + unity_class.vector3.forward * 0.1 + self.marian.SpineController.SpineTotalOffset
	local end_pos = self.harvester.Position + target_pos_offsets[CS.Utils.GetRandomInt(1, 4)]
	local cb = function ()
		local harvester = get_character('harvester')
		harvester.Direction = character_util.get_direction('right')
		harvester:SetAnimation('damaged', true)
		harvester.SpineController:DamageRedPulse()
		harvester.SpineController:DamageSquish(0.6)
		harvester.Position = harvester.Position + unity_class.vector3.left * 0.05
	end

	local marian_center = self.marian.Position + self.marian.SpineController.SpineTotalOffset
	local rifle_dir = (end_pos - marian_center).normalized

	self.marian.SpineController.AimPoint = CS.Oak.IKSupportUtil.GetAimPointInSpineSpace(marian_center + rifle_dir, marian_center)

	self:shoot_missile(shoot_pos, end_pos, duration, true, cb)
end

-- 특정위치로 미사일 쏘기
function local_class:shoot_missile(start_pos, end_pos, duration, use_unscaledtime, hit_callback)

	local dir = (end_pos - start_pos).normalized
	local rot = CS.UnityEngine.Quaternion.FromToRotation(unity_class.vector3.forward, dir)

	-- 발사 sfx
	music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '02_gun_shoot_01', play_pos = start_pos
	})

	local missile = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.missile_pool_name):Instantiate(start_pos, rot, nil)
	local trail = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.trail_pool_name):Instantiate(start_pos, rot, nil)

	local tp = 0
	while (tp < duration) do
		local progress = tp / duration

		missile.transform.position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
		trail.transform.position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)

		if use_unscaledtime then
			tp = tp + unity_class.time.unscaledDeltaTime
		else
			tp = tp + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 타격 sfx
	music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '02_explosion_02', play_pos = end_pos
	})

	missile:Dispose()
	trail:TriggeredDispose()
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.explosion_pool_name):Instantiate(end_pos)

	if hit_callback ~= nil then
		hit_callback()
	end
end
