local local_class = newclass('NightmareTeatansMainSection4')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = NightmareTeatansMain @
		Comment = 마티주니어로 변장한 인베이더 - 엔딩 까지. @
		Index = 3 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	self.event_progress = {
		none = 0,
		seen_help_shout = 1,
		junior_groan = 2,
		interacted_fake_teatan = 3,
		fight_boss = 4,
		ending = 5
	}
	self.current_progress = self.event_progress.none;

	self.boss_zone_name = 'boss'
	self.help_shout_zone_name = 'help_shout'
	self.explosion_effect_name = 'FX_dead'
	self.punch_effect_name = 'FX_hit'

	self.audience_invader_prefix = 'invader_audience_'
	self.boss_battle1_invader_prefix = 'boss_battle1_'
	self.robot_teatans_prefix = 'robot_teatan_'
	self.boss_battle1_invaders_count = 8
	self.audience_invader_count = 14

	self.fake_teatan = nil
	self.boss = nil

	self.boss_offset = vector(-2.9, 4.5, 0)

	self.stomp_effect_name = 'FX_Cin_Obj_RockExplosion'
	self.party_seen_junior_missile = false

	self.seen_boss_appear = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.main_stage_6_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_event')

	self.boss = get_character('boss_invader')
	self.fake_teatan = get_character('fake_teatan')

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.explosion_effect_name)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.stomp_effect_name)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.punch_effect_name)

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name == self.controller.main_stage_6_name then
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadBossTitle()
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadInvaderTransfer()

		self.boss = get_character('boss_invader')

		self.controller:missile_effectpool_preload()

		if not self.seen_boss_appear then
			local boss_room_monsters = {
				self.boss,
				get_character('boss_1_1'),
				get_character('boss_1_2'),
				get_character('boss_1_3')
			}
			for _, invader in ipairs(boss_room_monsters) do
				invader.FieldObjectController.DontFight = true
				invader.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
			end

			for i = 1, self.audience_invader_count do
				local invader = get_character(self.audience_invader_prefix .. i)
				invader.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
			end

			for i = 1, self.boss_battle1_invaders_count do
				local invader = get_character(self.boss_battle1_invader_prefix .. i)
				invader.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))

	self.boss = nil
	self.fake_teatan = nil
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.event_progress = nil
	self.boss = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		if e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then
			if e.Zone.Name == self.help_shout_zone_name and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.none then
				self.fake_teatan.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)
				self.current_progress = self.event_progress.seen_help_shout

				music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_negative_01')

				-- 사… 살려주세요!
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.fake_teatan,
						{ key = 'nightmare_teatans_s4_0_1', bubble_type = 'shout', world_pos = vector(41, 0, 49) })
			elseif e.Zone.Name == self.boss_zone_name and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.seen_help_shout then
				self.current_progress = self.event_progress.junior_groan

				-- 으으으…
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.fake_teatan, { key = 'nightmare_teatans_s4_0_1_1', skip = true })
			end
		end
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent) and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.fight_boss then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.boss, e.FieldObject) then
			local junior = get_character('robot_marty_junior')
			character_util.convert_to_npc(junior)

			self.current_progress = self.event_progress.ending
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.ending_event, self))
		end
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.junior_groan then

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.fake_teatan, e.Target) then
			self.fake_teatan.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)

			self.current_progress = self.event_progress.interacted_fake_teatan
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_fake_teatan, self))
		end
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) and
			self.current_progress == self.event_progress.interacted_fake_teatan then
		if e.BattleGroupName == 'boss_battle_1' then
			self.current_progress = self.event_progress.fight_boss
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.boss_appear_event, self))
		end
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent) and stage.Name == self.controller.main_stage_6_name then
		local main_quest = self.controller.quest_progress
		self.seen_boss_appear = main_quest:GetCustomState(self.controller.commander_event_save_key) == 1
		self.current_progress = self.seen_boss_appear and self.event_progress.fight_boss or self.event_progress.none
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.StageStartEvent) and stage.Name == self.controller.main_stage_6_name then
		if self.seen_boss_appear then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.custom_intro_event, self))
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:custom_intro_event()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	-- 전투후에 muted 되도록 필드 bgm을 비워둠
	music_player_util.remove_stage_music_clip({
		state = 'field'
	})

	-- bgm_transition: Event(bgm_marian) -> Combat(bgm_battle_boss)
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({
		name = 'bgm_battle_boss', state = 'combat'
	})

	local fake_marty = get_character('fake_teatan')
	fake_marty.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

	-- 마티한테 맞는 인베이더 두명 제거
	for i = 13, 14 do
		local invader = get_character(self.audience_invader_prefix .. i)
		invader.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

function local_class:boss_appear()
	-- 텀을 조금 준다
	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1))

	local start_height = 9
	self.boss.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.boss.Position, start_height)
	self.boss.SpineController.IsShadowActive = false
	self.boss.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	self.boss.Direction = character_util.get_direction('down')
	self.boss:SetAnimation('guard', true)

	local time_passed = 0
	local fall_duration = 0.25
	while(time_passed <= fall_duration) do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInQuad(time_passed, 0, 1, fall_duration)
		local y = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_height, 0, progress)

		self.boss.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.boss.Position, y)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.boss.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.boss.Position)
	self.boss.SpineController.IsShadowActive = true
	self.boss:RemoveAnimation()

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_stomp_01')

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.stomp_effect_name):Instantiate(self.boss.Position)

	camera_util.shake(0.6 ,0.4)

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local member = user_party[i]
		member:SetEmotion('attack', true)
		member:RemoveAnimation()
		member:Jump(0.6, 0.25)
		character_util.move_to(member, member.Position + direction_util.to_vector3(member.Direction) * -1, 0.25)
	end

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1))
end

function local_class:teatan_n_invader_fight(teatan, invader, wait_time)

	if wait_time ~= nil then
		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(wait_time))
	end

	character_util.look_at(teatan, invader)
	character_util.look_at(invader, teatan)

	local attacker = teatan
	local hitter = invader

	while (true) do
		attacker:SetEmotion('mad', true)
		attacker:SetAnimation('attack', false)
		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.3))
		attacker:RemoveAnimation()

		local dir = (hitter.Position - attacker.Position).normalized

		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.punch_effect_name):Instantiate(attacker.Position + dir * 0.5)

		hitter:SetEmotion('damaged', true)
		hitter.SpineController:DamageRedPulse()
		hitter.SpineController:DamageSquish(0.6)

		-- swap
		local temp = attacker
		attacker = hitter
		hitter = temp

		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.25))
	end
end

local local_class = newclass('NightmareTeatanTrioSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = NightmareTeatanTrio @
		Comment = 티탄 트리오와 무궁화 꽃이 피었습니다.  @
		Index = 0 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.ifo_util = CS.Oak.IFieldObjectExtensions
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.JoypadEvent), 'on_event')

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadActivityClear()
end

function local_class:start()
	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress < 0 then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.ready_race, self))
	else
		local kid_red = get_character('teatan_trio_red')
		quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(kid_red)
		kid_red.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)

		local kid_green = get_character('teatan_trio_green')
		kid_green.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)

		local kid_blue = get_character('teatan_trio_blue')
		kid_blue.Interactable.Talk = 'nightmare_teatans_2_teatan_trio_17'
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.JoypadEvent))

	local kid_red = get_character('teatan_trio_red')
	if lua_helper.type_compare(kid_red.Interactable, typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable)) then
		kid_red.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)
	end

	local kid_green = get_character('teatan_trio_green')
	if lua_helper.type_compare(kid_green.Interactable, typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable)) then
		kid_green.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.ifo_util = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	local kid_red = get_character('teatan_trio_red')
	local kid_green = get_character('teatan_trio_green')

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, kid_red) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, kid_green) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.retry_race, self))
			return true
		end
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

		if self.is_racing and zone_name == 'arrive_trio_quest' then
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.win_to_kid_red, self))
				return true
			elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, kid_red) then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.lose_to_kid_red, self))
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then
			if zone_name == 'runaway_trio_quest' and self.is_racing and not self.look_left then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.lose_runaway, self))
			end
		end
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.JoypadEvent) then
		if not self.is_racing or not self.look_left then return false end

		if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.JoypadEventType, CS.Oak.JoypadEventType.StickNeutral) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.lose_moving, self))
		end
	end

	return false
end

-- 시합 시작 전 세팅
function local_class:ready_race()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

	--카메라 세팅
	local marker = field:GetMarker('race_camera').position
	camera_util.move(marker, 0)
	camera_util.resize_to(6, 0)

	local kid_red = get_character('teatan_trio_red')
	local kid_green = get_character('teatan_trio_green')
	local kid_blue = get_character('teatan_trio_blue')

	local anim = {'release', 'success', 'clap', 'release'}
	-- 파티원들 npc로 변경 및 세팅
	marker = field:GetMarker('cheer_my_party').position
	for i = 0, self.controller.party_member.Count - 1 do
		character_util.convert_to_npc(self.controller.party_member[i])
		self.controller.party_member[i].Position = marker + i * 1 * unity_class.vector3.right
		character_util.set_direction(self.controller.party_member[i], 'down')
		character_util.set_anim(self.controller.party_member[i], { name = anim[i + 1] })
	end

	-- 출발선 세팅
	marker = field:GetMarker('race_start').position
	user_party_leader.Position = marker
	character_util.set_direction(user_party_leader, 'right')
	kid_red.Position = marker + 0.7 *  unity_class.vector3.forward
	character_util.set_direction(kid_red, 'right')
	kid_green.Position = marker + 0.7 * unity_class.vector3.back
	character_util.set_direction(kid_green, 'right')
	kid_blue.Position = field:GetMarker('race_start_kid_blue').position
	character_util.set_direction(kid_blue, 'right')

	kid_red.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	kid_green.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	kid_blue.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	kid_blue.Interactable.Talk = nil

	-- 게임 시작과 함께 bgm 변경
	-- bgm_transition: Field(bgm_teatans_main) -> Event(bgm_trickery_theme)
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({
		name = 'bgm_trickery_theme', state = 'event'
	})

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1))

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(kid_blue, { key = 'nightmare_teatans_2_teatan_trio_13' })

	-- 플레이어 달리기, 공격, 스킬 금지
	local manual_touch_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(user_party_leader, false)
	manual_touch_state:DisableControls(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Dash |
		CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Attack | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Super)

	local state_change_event = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(manual_touch_state)
	message_system:SendSync(user_party_leader.FieldObjectController, state_change_event)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()

	-- 달리기 할 때 사용하지 못하는 버튼 숨기기
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(user_party_leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton
		| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ModeChangeButton
		| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TeamCombinationButton)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.start_race, self))
end

-- 시합 시작
function local_class:start_race()
	self.look_left = false
	self.is_racing = true
	-- 라운드에 따라 패턴이 달라서 홀수 라운드, 짝수 라운드 구분
	local race_round = 1

	local kid_red = get_character('teatan_trio_red')
	local kid_green = get_character('teatan_trio_green')
	local kid_blue = get_character('teatan_trio_blue')

	-- 레드와 그린 이동
	local pos = vector(kid_blue.Position.x, 0, kid_red.Position.z)
	local kid_red_move_coroutine = coroutine_class.coroutine(
		stage.StageGameObject, self.ifo_util.MoveTo(kid_red, pos, nil, 2.4, true, true))
	pos = vector(kid_blue.Position.x, 0, kid_green.Position.z)
	local kid_green_move_coroutine = coroutine_class.coroutine(
		stage.StageGameObject, self.ifo_util.MoveTo(kid_green, pos, nil, 1, true, true))

	-- 티탄 트리오의 시합 액션 루틴이 돌고있는지 체크
	self.action_routine = true
	while true do
		-- 타이머 UI 켜기
		if race_round % 2 == 1 then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(kid_blue, 1.5))
		else
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(kid_blue, 1.2))
		end

		self.look_left = false
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(kid_red_move_coroutine)
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(kid_green_move_coroutine)

		character_util.set_direction(kid_blue, 'right')

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(kid_blue, { key = 'nightmare_teatans_2_teatan_trio_14' })
		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1))

		if not self.is_racing then break end

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(kid_blue, { key = 'nightmare_teatans_2_teatan_trio_15' })
		if race_round % 2 == 1 then
			coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.5))
		else
			coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.2))
		end

		if not self.is_racing then break end

		-- 타이머 UI 끄기
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(kid_blue))

		stop_coroutine(kid_red_move_coroutine)
		stop_coroutine(kid_green_move_coroutine)
		character_util.remove_anim(kid_red)
		character_util.remove_anim(kid_green)

		character_util.set_direction(kid_blue, 'left')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(kid_blue, { key = 'nightmare_teatans_2_teatan_trio_16' })

		self.look_left = true

		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1))

		if not self.is_racing then break end

		race_round = race_round + 1
	end
	self.action_routine = false

	-- 타이머 UI 끄기
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(kid_blue))

	stop_coroutine(kid_red_move_coroutine)
	stop_coroutine(kid_green_move_coroutine)
	character_util.remove_anim(kid_red)
	character_util.remove_anim(kid_green)
end

-- 움직여서 졌을 때
function local_class:lose_moving()
	self.is_racing = false

	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	-- 티탄 트리오의 시합 액션 루틴이 끝나기를 기다림 (다른 행동 충돌 방지)
	while not self.action_routine do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 패배시 bgm 원복 처리
	-- bgm_transition: Event(bgm_trickery_theme) -> Field(bgm_teatans_main)
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({
		state = 'field'
	})

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1))

	for i = 0, self.controller.party_member.Count - 1 do
		character_util.remove_anim(self.controller.party_member[i])
		character_util.set_anim(self.controller.party_member[i], { name = 'cast' })
		character_util.set_emotion(self.controller.party_member[i], { name = 'cry' })
	end

	character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, { name = 'embarrassed' })
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party_leader, { name = 'scared' })

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_runaway_01')

	local kid_blue = get_character('teatan_trio_blue')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(kid_blue,
		{ key = 'nightmare_teatans_2_teatan_trio_18', skip = true })

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.lose, self))
end

-- 영역을 이탈해서 졌을 때
function local_class:lose_runaway()
	self.is_racing = false

	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	-- 티탄 트리오의 시합 액션 루틴이 끝나기를 기다림 (다른 행동 충돌 방지)
	while not self.action_routine do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 패배시 bgm 원복 처리
	-- bgm_transition: Event(bgm_trickery_theme) -> Field(bgm_teatans_main)
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({
		state = 'field'
	})

	for i = 0, self.controller.party_member.Count - 1 do
		character_util.remove_anim(self.controller.party_member[i])
		character_util.set_anim(self.controller.party_member[i], { name = 'cast' })
		character_util.set_emotion(self.controller.party_member[i], { name = 'cry' })
	end

	local kid_blue = get_character('teatan_trio_blue')

	character_util.set_direction(kid_blue, 'left')

	camera_util.resize_to(CS.Oak.StageCamera.DefaultCameraSize, 0.5)
	camera_util.move_async(kid_blue.Position, 0.5)

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(kid_blue,
		{ key = 'nightmare_teatans_2_teatan_trio_19', skip = true })

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(kid_blue,
		{ key = 'nightmare_teatans_2_teatan_trio_20', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout' })

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.lose, self))
end

-- 레드가 먼저 도착해서 졌을 때
function local_class:lose_to_kid_red()
	self.is_racing = false

	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	-- 티탄 트리오의 시합 액션 루틴이 끝나기를 기다림 (다른 행동 충돌 방지)
	while not self.action_routine do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 패배시 bgm 원복 처리

	self.is_racing = false

	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	-- 티탄 트리오의 시합 액션 루틴이 끝나기를 기다림 (다른 행동 충돌 방지)

	end

	local kid_blue = get_character('teatan_trio_blue')

	character_util.set_emotion(kid_blue, { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.set_emotion(kid_red, { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.set_emotion(kid_green, { name = 'surprise' })

	character_util.jump(kid_blue, 0.5, 0.5)
	character_util.jump(kid_red, 0.5, 0.5)

	camera_util.resize_to(CS.Oak.StageCamera.DefaultCameraSize, 0.5)
	camera_util.move_async(user_party_leader.Position, 0.5)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_negative_02')

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(kid_blue,
		{ key = 'nightmare_teatans_2_teatan_trio_23', skip = true })

	local pos = user_party_leader.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0.5)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, self.ifo_util.MoveTo(kid_red, pos, nil, 8, false, true))

	local waypoint_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
	waypoint_list:Add(user_party_leader.Position + vector(-1, 0, -0.5))

	local move_info = CS.Oak.WaypointMoveInfo()
	move_info.waypoints = waypoint_list
	move_info.speed = 8

	local duration = move_info:GetDuration(kid_green.Position)
	character_util.move_waypoint(
			kid_green, waypoint_list, 8, false, 'stop', 'floor', nil, true
	)
	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(duration))

	-- 박수 루프 sfx 재생
	local clap_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_clap_01', loop = true, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'npc'
	})

	character_util.set_anim(kid_green, { name = 'clap' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(kid_green,
		{ key = 'nightmare_teatans_2_teatan_trio_24', skip = true })

	-- 박수 루프 sfx 중지
	clap_sfx:FadeOut(0.2)

	character_util.remove_anim(kid_green)
	character_util.remove_emotion(kid_red)
	character_util.set_emotion(kid_red, { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(kid_red,
		{ key = 'nightmare_teatans_2_teatan_trio_25', skip = true })

	camera_util.move_async(get_field_object('teatan_trio_door').Position, 1)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('teatan_trio_door', false))
	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1))

	camera_util.move_async(user_party_leader.Position, 1, { end_target = user_party_leader})

	coroutine.yield(quest_util.complete_quest(self.controller, 0,
		true, false, false))
end

return local_class

		local gnome_door_keepers = self:get_gnome_door_keepers()
		local keeper_1 = gnome_door_keepers[1]
		local keeper_2 = gnome_door_keepers[2]

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, keeper_1) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, keeper_2) then
			-- 뚱보 잭은 쉬고 있으니까 방해하지 마라
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(e.Target, { key = 'nightmare_titantavern_3_mining_door_keepers', skip = true })
			return true
		elseif string.find(e.Target.Name, 'ore') ~= nil then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.pick_axing, self, e.Target))
			return true
		end
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self:get_gnome_brother()) then
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self:get_gnome_brother(), {key = 'nightmare_titantavern_3_mining_sleep'})
			if not self.snore then
				self.snore = true
				music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_sleep_02')
			end
		end
	end
	return false
end


function local_class:pick_axing(theore)
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	local princess = self:get_princess()

	local animationDuration = 0.9
	local totalDuration = 0.4

	local attackDuration = totalDuration / 4 * 3
	local destroyDuration = totalDuration / 4 * 1

	local pickAxeName = 'pickaxe_gold_sword'

	princess.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', pickAxeName)

	character_util.set_anim(princess,{ name = 'twohand_attack' , loop = true, scale = (animationDuration / totalDuration) })

	wait_for_sec(attackDuration - 0.1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_mining_01', parent = theore})

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_rock_break_01' })
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Env_SmallRock_lv1_destroy'):Instantiate(theore.Bounds.center + 0.5 * unity_class.vector3.down)

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	theore.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
	camera_util.shake(0.1, destroyDuration, nil, nil)

	wait_for_sec(destroyDuration)

	character_util.remove_anim(princess)
	princess:RefreshWeaponAttachments()
	party_util.reset_controllers()
end

return local_class

	local destroyDuration = totalDuration / 4 * 1

	party_util.reset_controllers()

	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party) then
		if e.CameraGrid.name == self.rope_on_grid_name then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.rope_on, self))
			return true
		elseif e.CameraGrid.name == self.rope_off_grid_name then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.rope_off, self))
			return true
		elseif e.CameraGrid.name == self.rope_help_grid_name and self.req_check == false then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.help_request, self))
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_gird_leave_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party) then
		if e.CameraGrid.name == self.rope_help_grid_name then
			speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.get_thief())
			self.help_check = false
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:rope_on()
	local cheese_thief = self.get_thief()
	if self.rope_state == nil then
		self.rope_state = CS.Oak.CharacterRopeTrappedState(cheese_thief,
				character_util.get_direction('right'), cheese_thief.Position)
		message_system:SendSync(cheese_thief, CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(self.rope_state))
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
		character_util.set_emotion(cheese_thief, { name = 'idle' })
	end
end

function local_class:rope_off()
	if self.rope_state ~= nil then
		self.rope_state:Fall()
		self.rope_state:End()
		self.rope_state = nil
	end
end

-- 도와달라는 생쥐 도둑
function local_class:help_request()
	self.req_check = true
	self.help_check = true
	local cheese_thief = self.get_thief()
	local time_passed = 0.5
	local i = 0
	while self.help_check do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if time_passed >= 2 then
			time_passed = 0
			i = i + 1
		end

		if i % 4 == 1 and time_passed == 0 then
			-- 여기야, 여기!
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(cheese_thief,
					{ key = 'nightmare_titantavern_cheese_thief_9', bubble_type = 'shout' })
		elseif i % 4 == 3 and time_passed == 0 then
			-- 여기 스위치 좀 눌러줘!
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(cheese_thief,
					{ key = 'nightmare_titantavern_cheese_thief_10', bubble_type = 'shout' })
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	self.req_check = false
end

	if e.IsTurningOn and

		return true
	end
	return false
end

	character_util.shake(bug, 0.02, 9999)
	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress < 0 then
		self.started = true
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.start_event, self)
	else
		local fruit = self:get_fruit()
		fruit.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	local fruit = self:get_fruit()
	if lua_helper.type_compare(fruit.Interactable, CS.Oak.Interactable) then
		fruit.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		local fruit = self:get_fruit()
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, fruit) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.start_event, self)
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:start_event()
	local princess = self:get_princess()
	local fat_gnome = self:get_gnome()

	local fat_gnome_speech_offset = CS.SpeechBubbleOffset.Offsets[speech_bubble.bubble_directions.rt]
	fat_gnome_speech_offset = fat_gnome_speech_offset + 1 * unity_class.vector3.up

	local bug = self:get_hiding_bug()
	local fruit = self:get_fruit()

	fruit.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	local fruit_position = fruit.Position + 0.5 * unity_class.vector3.left + 0.5 * unity_class.vector3.forward

	local party_dir = (princess.Position.x > fruit_position.x) and unity_class.vector3.left or unity_class.vector3.right
	local party_dir_str = (party_dir == unity_class.vector3.left) and 'left' or 'right'
	local bug_dir = (princess.Position.x > fruit_position.x) and unity_class.vector3.right or unity_class.vector3.left
	local bug_dir_str = (party_dir == unity_class.vector3.left) and 'right' or 'left'

	character_util.convert_to_npc(fat_gnome)

	character_util.move_to(princess, fruit_position + 1.8 * bug_dir, 0.5, nil, true, true)
	character_util.move_to_async(fat_gnome, fruit_position + 1.8 * bug_dir + 1 * unity_class.vector3.forward, 0.5, nil , true, true)

	character_util.set_direction(princess, party_dir_str)
	character_util.set_direction(fat_gnome, party_dir_str)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.remove_anim(fat_gnome)
	character_util.remove_anim(princess)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_rustle_01' })
	character_util.move_to_async(princess, fruit_position + 1.5 * bug_dir, nil, 4, true, true)

	character_util.set_direction(princess, party_dir_str)
	character_util.set_anim(princess, { name = 'push' })
	local deviation = 0.5 * direction_util.to_vector3(vector_util.to_direction(bug.Position - princess.Position))
	character_util.spine_deviate_local(princess, deviation, 0.3, 0.2)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.remove_anim(princess)
	character_util.stop_shake(bug)

	character_util.show_emoticon_async(bug, nil, 'question')

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_rustle_01' })
	character_util.set_direction(bug, bug_dir_str)
	character_util.move_to_async(bug, fruit_position + 1 * bug_dir, nil, 3)

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_bad_fairy_01' })
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(bug, nil, 'heart')

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_small_jump_01' })
	character_util.jump(bug, 2, 0.5)
	character_util.move_to(bug, princess.Position + 1 * unity_class.vector3.back, 0.5)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.set_direction(princess, 'down')
	character_util.set_direction(fat_gnome, 'down')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.convert_to_party_member(fat_gnome, user_party)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(princess)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(fat_gnome)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(bug)

	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0)

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

return local_class

				local breakable = get_field_object('main_breakable_' .. i)
				message_system:Send(breakable, CS.Oak.GimmickResetEvent.Instance)
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	if string.find(e.Info.target.Name, 'ant_') and
			string.find(e.Info.sender.Name, 'main_breakable_') then

		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
		damage_info.sender = user_party.Leader
		damage_info.target = e.Info.target
		damage_info.damage = e.Info.target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * 100
		command_util.execute_damage(damage_info)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == 'ant' then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.meet_fat_gnome, self)
	end

	return false
end

	for i = 1, 2 do

function local_class:first_gnome_jump_routine()
	for i = 1, 9 do
		local gnome = get_character('first_gnome_' .. (i - 1))
		local marker = field:GetMarker(gnome.Name)

		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_small_jump_01')
		character_util.jump(gnome, 0.3, 0.3)

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
			character_util.set_anim(gnome, {name = 'rifle_walk'})
			character_util.move_to_async(gnome, marker.position, 1, nil, true, true)
			character_util.set_anim(gnome, {name = 'sniper_shoot', loop = false, scale = 0})
			character_util.look_at(gnome, user_party.Leader)
		end))
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
	end
end

function local_class:resize_tavern_camera(camera, size, duration)
	local time_passed = 0
	local start_size = camera.orthographicSize
	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local size = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(time_passed, start_size, size - start_size, duration)

		camera.orthographicSize = size

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:move_tavern_camera(camera, target, duration)
	local time_passed = 0
	local start_pos = camera.transform.position
	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		camera.transform.position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, target, time_passed / duration)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

		wait_for_sec(CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0, 2))

			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
		end
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(gnome, {key = text, skip = true})
	end

	if side_move then
		for _ = 1, 3 do
			character_util.move_waypoint_async(gnome,gnome.Position + vector(1.5, 0, 0),
					6, false, nil, nil, nil)
			character_util.move_waypoint_async(gnome,gnome.Position + vector(-1.5, 0, 0),
					6, false, nil, nil, nil)
		end

		Comment = 요정에게 가서 원래대로 돌려달라고 한다. 알고보니 마술은 노움으로 변하는것. @
		Index = 1 @
		NextSections = 2 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.stage_name = 'nightmare_titantavern_1'
	self.fairy_mining_sound = nil

	self.saw_monologue = false

	self.fairy_mining = false
	self.fairy_monologue = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')

	--unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_fairy_tail_red')

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.set_npcs, self))

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end

	CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('nightmare_titantavern_main', self.quest_spec.QuestId,
			self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, get_field_object('hole_1'))
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))

	local fairy = get_character('bad_fairy')
	if fairy ~= nil then
		fairy.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
	end

	CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:RemoveQuestMarker('nightmare_titantavern_main')
end

--region on event

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		local fairy = get_character('bad_fairy')

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, fairy) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_with_fairy, self)
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then return false end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party.Leader then return false end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == 'main_s2_fairy' and not self.saw_monologue then
		self.saw_monologue = true
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.beer_loop, self))
	end

	local marker_fo = {get_field_object('hole_1'), get_field_object('quarry_entrance'),
					   get_field_object('quarry_entrance'), get_character('bad_fairy')}
	for i = 1, 4 do
		if zone_name == 's2_marker_' .. i then
			CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:RemoveQuestMarker('nightmare_titantavern_main')
			CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('nightmare_titantavern_main', self.quest_spec.QuestId,
					self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, marker_fo[i])
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party.Leader then return false end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == 'main_s2_fairy' then
		local marker = field:GetMarker('s2_fairy_exit')
		if user_party.Leader.Position.x > marker.position.x and user_party.Leader.Position.z < marker.position.z then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.angry_fairy, self)
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:mining()
	local fairy = get_character('bad_fairy')
	local ore = get_field_object('fairy_ore')

	local anim_duration = 0.6
	local total_duration = 1
	local attack = total_duration / 4 * 3
	local destroy = total_duration / 4

	self.fairy_mining = true

	while self.fairy_mining do
		character_util.set_anim(fairy, {name = 'twohand_attack', scale = anim_duration / total_duration, sfx_name = '01_mining_01', loop = false})

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.Shake(ore.Transform, 0.1, destroy))

		character_util.remove_anim(fairy)

function local_class:fluttering()
	local fat_gnome = get_character('fat_gnome')
	local origin_pos = fat_gnome.Transform.localPosition
	local speed = 1.5
	local radius = 0.15
	local timePassed = 0

	while true do
		timePassed = timePassed + unity_class.time.deltaTime * speed
		local x = radius * unity_class.mathf.Cos(timePassed)
		local z = radius * unity_class.mathf.Sin(timePassed)

		fat_gnome.Transform.localPosition = origin_pos + vector(x, 0, z)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:item_push_overlay(id, title, subtitle, desc)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_get_keyitem_01')
	local fat_gnome = get_character('fat_gnome')
	local princess = get_character('princess')
	character_util.set_anim(fat_gnome, {name = 'get'})

	local item = drop_item_util.create_item({ itemid = id, pos = fat_gnome.Position, target = nil, sprscale = 0.75,
											  lootstate = "dontfindlooter", showoncharacter = true, notforinven = true})

	local item_fx = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_highlight_item'):Instantiate(fat_gnome.Position + vector(0.5, 1.5, -0.1))
	local duration = 1.5
	local timer = 0

	while timer < duration do
		local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(fat_gnome.Position + vector(0.5, 0.6, -0.1), fat_gnome.Position + vector(0.5, 1.5, -0.1), timer / duration)
		item.Position = cur_pos
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	local wait_for_ui = true

	local item_placeholder = CS.Oak.ItemPlaceholder()
	item_placeholder.ItemId = 20007
	item_placeholder.NotForInventory = true
	item_placeholder.SkipItemGetText = true

	local ui_overlay_state = CS.UIOverlayState()
	ui_overlay_state.Type = CS.UIOverlayType.Item
	ui_overlay_state.Title = subtitle
	ui_overlay_state.Text = title
	ui_overlay_state.Item = item_placeholder
	ui_overlay_state.ItemDesc = desc
	ui_overlay_state.OkAction = function() wait_for_ui = false end

	stage.UISceneManager:PushOverlay(CS.UIOverlay.Instance, ui_overlay_state)

	while wait_for_ui == true do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	item_fx:Dispose()

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(fat_gnome)

	item.ConsumeTarget = princess
	item:ConsumeComplete()

end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('NightmareTitanTavernTrainerPostSection')

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	-- npc
	self.get_bug_master = function() return get_character('bug_owner') end
	self.get_trainer = function() return get_character('trainer') end
	self.get_trainer_assistant1 = function() return get_character('assistant1') end
	self.get_trainer_assistant2 = function() return get_character('assistant2') end
	self.get_bug = function() return get_character('lulu_bug') end
end

function local_class:enter()
	local trainer = self:get_trainer()
	local assistant1 = self:get_trainer_assistant1()
	local assistant2 = self:get_trainer_assistant2()
	local owner = self:get_bug_master()
	local bug = self:get_bug()

	trainer.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)
	assistant1.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)
	assistant2.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)
	owner.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)
	bug.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	local trainer = self:get_trainer()
	local assistant1 = self:get_trainer_assistant1()
	local assistant2 = self:get_trainer_assistant2()
	local owner = self:get_bug_master()
	local bug = self:get_bug()

	local npcs = { trainer,
					assistant1,
					assistant2,
					owner,
					bug }

	for _,thenpc in ipairs(npcs) do
		if lua_helper.type_compare(thenpc.Interactable, CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
			thenpc.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)
		end
	end

				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(gnome, {key = 'not_tall_enough_oneline'})
			else
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.help_us, self, i)
			end
		end
	end
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.giant) and self.swallowed == false then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.are_you_ready, self)
	end
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.bombbug) and self.swallowed == false then
		self.has_talked_to_gnome = false
		self.swallowed = false
	end
end
--------------------
function local_class:help_us(i)

	if i <= 2 then
		party_util.align_to_target(self.gardener_gnome_list[1], 'left', 0.5)
	else
		party_util.align_to_target(self.gardener_gnome_list[4], 'right', 0.5)
	end
	--여기 나무에는 열매가 너무 높은 곳에 열렸어요.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.gardener_gnome_list[1], {key = 'not_tall_enough_1', skip = true})
	--저희는 키가 작아서 도무지 열매를 딸 수가 없어요.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.gardener_gnome_list[2], {key = 'not_tall_enough_2', skip = true})
	--어쩌죠? 열매를 꼭 따야 하는데…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.gardener_gnome_list[3], {key = 'not_tall_enough_3', skip = true})
	--꼬마야, 이건 우리가 도와줄 수 있을 것 같은데.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.giant, {key = 'not_tall_enough_4', skip = true})
	--정말? 어떻게?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.princess, {key = 'not_tall_enough_5', skip = true})
	--우리 둘이 무게를 합쳐서 있는 힘껏 땅을 내리쳐 보는 거야!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.giant, {key = 'not_tall_enough_6', skip = true})
	--재밌겠다!
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.princess, {name = 'clap'}, {name = 'smile'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.princess, {key = 'not_tall_enough_7', skip = true})
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.princess)
	--그래, 준비되면 나한테 얘기해 줘.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.giant, {key = 'not_tall_enough_8', skip = true})

	character_util.convert_to_npc(self.giant)
	self.giant.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)
	self.has_talked_to_gnome = true

end
function local_class:are_you_ready()
	--뚱보, “준비 됐니?”
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.giant, {key = 'not_tall_enough_9', skip = true})
	--공주, “응!”
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.princess, {key = 'not_tall_enough_10', skip = true})
	--뚱보, 공주를 흡수한다.
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.FatGnomeRideEvent.Create(false))
	--뚱보, “좋아, 이제 같이 뛰어보자!”
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.giant, {key = 'not_tall_enough_11', skip = true})

	self.swallowed = true

	yield_return_func(quest_util.activate_quest, self.controller)

end


function local_class:setting()
	self.main_quest_id = 124
	self.main_quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.main_quest_id)
	local princess_name = 'princess'
	if self.main_quest_progress.InnerProgress == 3 then
		princess_name = 'princess_gnome_1'
	elseif self.main_quest_progress.InnerProgress >= 4 and not self.main_quest_progress.IsComplete then
		princess_name = 'princess_gnome_3'
	end

	for i=1,4 do

		--if i <= 2 then
		--	character_util.set_direction(gnome, 'right')
		--else
		--	character_util.set_direction(gnome, 'left')
		--end
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(gnome, {name = 'hurt'}, {name = 'tired'})
	end

	self.giant = get_character('fat_gnome')
	self.bombbug = get_character('hiding_bug')
	self.princess = get_character(princess_name)

end

local local_class = newclass('NotTallEnoughSection1')
--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = Not Tall Enough  @
		Comment =  스타피스 1: 키가 큰 라즈베리 나무 본문 @
		Index = 0 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	self.stage_name = 'nightmare_titantavern_1'

	-- 퀘스트 수행중인지
	self.start_quest = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_event')

	self.gardener_gnome_list = {}
	self.giant = nil

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end
	self.zone_1 = 'tall_raspberry_bush'

	self.is_in_zone = false
	self.is_in_zones = { false, false, false, false }
	self.berry_counts = {0, 0, 0, 0}
	self.bush_offset = {0, 12, 24, 32}
	self.jump_count = 0
	self.is_midair = false
	self.swallowed = false

	self:setting()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.VehicleRidingStateChangeEvent))

	for i=1,4 do
		if self.gardener_gnome_list[i].Interactable:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
			self.gardener_gnome_list[i].Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)
		end
		self.gardener_gnome_list[i] = nil
	end

	self.giant.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	self.giant = nil

	self.gardener_gnome_list = nil
	self.controller = nil

end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return false
	end
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		self:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.TouchEvent) then
		self:on_touch_event(e)
	end
	return false
end
------

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Action3TouchDown then
		if self.is_midair == false then
			--speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.giant, {key = '공격한다'})
			if user_party.Leader == self.giant then
				--- FIXME: 급히 점프 쿨타임 코드를 넣어놨지만, 부쉬에 대한 데미지 판정으로 전체 로직을 고치면서 없어져야 한다.
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.jump_cooltime, self, 1))
				if self.is_in_zone then
					self.jump_count = self.jump_count + 1
					if self.jump_count == 3 then
						coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.complete, self))
					elseif self.jump_count < 3 then
						coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.drop_berries, self, 0, self.jump_count))
					end
				end
				for i = 1, 4 do
					if self.is_in_zones[i] and self:bush_check(i) then
						self.berry_counts[i] = self.berry_counts[i] + 1
						if self.berry_counts[i] == 3 then
							coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.drop_berries, self, i, self.berry_counts[i]))
							for j = 1, 4 do
								local num = (i * 4) + j
								local bush = get_field_object('raspberry_bush_' .. num)
								if bush.ActiveState == active_state('enabled') then
									coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
											util.cs_generator(self.bush_shrink, self, bush, 0.5))
								end
							end
							self.berry_counts[i] = 4
						elseif self.berry_counts[i] < 3 then
							coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.drop_berries, self, i, self.berry_counts[i]))
						end
					end
				end
			else
				self.is_midair = false
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	for i = 1, 4 do
		local gnome = self.gardener_gnome_list[i]
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, gnome) then
			if not self.start_quest then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.help_us, self, i)
				return true
			end
		end
		local bush = get_field_object('raspberry_bush_' .. i)
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, bush) then
			if bush.ActiveState == active_state('enabled') then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.tall_narration, self)
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.giant) and self.swallowed == false then
		self.swallowed = true
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name
	if e.FullEnter and e.FieldObject == user_party.Leader then
		if zone_name == self.zone_1 then
			self.is_in_zone = true
		end
		if zone_name == self.zone_1 .. '_1' then
			self.is_in_zones[1] = true
		end
		if zone_name == self.zone_1 .. '_2' then
			self.is_in_zones[2] = true
		end
		if zone_name == self.zone_1 .. '_3' then
			self.is_in_zones[3] = true
		end
		if zone_name == self.zone_1 .. '_4' then
			self.is_in_zones[4] = true
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name
	if e.FullLeave and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
		if zone_name == self.zone_1 then
			self.is_in_zone = false
		end
		if zone_name == self.zone_1 .. '_1' then
			self.is_in_zones[1] = false
		end
		if zone_name == self.zone_1 .. '_2' then
			self.is_in_zones[2] = false
		end
		if zone_name == self.zone_1 .. '_3' then
			self.is_in_zones[3] = false
		end
		if zone_name == self.zone_1 .. '_4' then
			self.is_in_zones[4] = false
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_vehicle_riding_stage_change_event(e)
	--- 날탈 상태
	local vehicle_state = e.State

	-- 폭탄 벌레를 타고 올라갈 때
	if vehicle_state == CS.Oak.FlyingVehicleBehaviour.FlyState.Ascending then
		--- 다시 연출을 보여줄 수 있도록 플래그 되돌려줌
		self.start_quest = false

		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.VehicleRidingStateChangeEvent))

		local ride_duration = 0.35

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.giant)
		character_util.convert_to_party_member(self.giant, user_party)

		character_util.stop(self.giant)
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.giant, 0, ride_duration / 2)

		-- 노움들 다시 세팅
		for i = 1, 4 do
			local gnome = self.gardener_gnome_list[i]
			character_util.add_listener(gnome, self.controller)
			gnome.Interactable.Talk = nil

			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(gnome)

			character_util.set_emotion(gnome, { name = 'tired' })
			character_util.set_anim(gnome, { name = 'hurt' })
		end
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:bush_check(index)
	local answer = false
	for i = 1, 4 do
		if get_field_object('raspberry_bush_' .. (index * 4 + i)).ActiveState == active_state('enabled') then
			answer = true
		end
	end
	return answer
end

function local_class:drop_berries(n, count)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	wait_for_sec(1)

	for i = 1, 4 do
		local gnome = self.gardener_gnome_list[i]
		character_util.set_emotion(gnome, { name = 'surprise' })
		character_util.remove_anim(gnome)
	end

	local center = vector (-48.5,0,-28.5)
	if n ~= 0 then
		local pos_table = {
			vector(-4, 0, 4),
			vector(-4, 0, -4),
			vector(4, 0, -4),
			vector(4, 0, 4)
		}
		center = center + pos_table[n]
	end
	for i=1, (count+2)*count do
		local rad = math.pi * 4 * random_util.get_random_value()
		local target_pos = center + (vector(math.cos(rad),0, math.sin(rad)) * random_util.get_random_int(0.1, 2))
		local berry = drop_item_util.create_item({
			pos = center,
			target = target_pos,
			itemid = 20131,
			not_for_inventory = true
		})
		local j = random_util.get_random_int(1,4)
		if n == 0 then
			berry.ConsumeTarget = self.gardener_gnome_list[j]
		else
			berry.ConsumeTarget = user_party.Leader
		end
	end

	if self.jump_count ~= 3 then
		self.is_midair = false
		field_ui_manager:Show()
	end
end

function local_class:bush_shrink(bush, duration)
	if bush.ActiveState == active_state('disabled') then
		return
	end
	wait_for_sec(1)
	local timer = 0
	while timer < duration do
		local scale = 1 -(timer / duration)
		bush.transform.localScale = vector(scale, scale, scale)
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	bush.transform.localScale = vector(0, 0, 0)
	bush.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
end

function local_class:complete()
	for i = 1, 4 do
		local bush = get_field_object('raspberry_bush_' .. i)
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(self.bush_shrink, self, bush, 0.5))
	end
	self:drop_berries(0, self.jump_count)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--노움들, smile, success, 외침, “와! 열매를 충분히 모았어요!”
	for i = 1, 4 do
		local gnome = self.gardener_gnome_list[i]
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(gnome, {name = 'success'}, {name = 'smile'})
	end
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.gardener_gnome_list[1], {
				key = 'not_tall_enough_12',
				skip = true,
				scale = 1.5,
				offset = 0,
				world_pos = vector (-48.5,0,-30.5)
	})
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--뚱보, 공주를 아래쪽에 뱉어낸다: 단, 아래가 막혀 있을 경우 다른 방향으로 뱉기
	local pos = user_party.Leader.Position
	if pos.x > -48.5 then
		party_util.align_party(vector(-47, 0, pos.z - 1), 'up', 0.5)
	else
		party_util.align_party(vector(-50, 0, pos.z - 1), 'up', 0.5)
	end
	wait_for_sec(0.2)
	character_util.set_direction(self.giant, 'down')
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.FatGnomeTakeOffEvent.Instance)
	wait_for_sec(1.2)
	pos = user_party.Leader.Position
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_to_async, self.giant,
				vector(pos.x,0,self.gardener_gnome_list[2].Position.z), 1, nil, true, true),
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_to_async, self.princess,
				vector(pos.x,0,self.gardener_gnome_list[2].Position.z-1.5), 1, nil, true, true)
	})

	character_util.set_direction(self.giant, 'down')
	character_util.set_direction(self.princess, 'up')

	--뚱보, 공주 방향 보고 smile, “꼬마야, 우리가 해냈어!”
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.giant, {name = 'idle'}, {name = 'smile'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.giant, {key = 'not_tall_enough_13', skip = true})
	--공주, 뚱보 방향 보고, smile, success, “아하하! 재밌다! 재밌다!”
	--party_util.align_party(self.gardener_gnome_list[1]+vector(-1,0,0), 'up', 0.6, 'linear')

	character_util.set_direction(self.princess, 'up')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.princess, {name = 'success'}, {name = 'smile'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.princess, {key = 'not_tall_enough_14', skip = true})
	--노움1, “여러분, 도와주셔서 감사해요!”

		{ key = 'not_tall_enough_2', skip = true })

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.gardener_gnome_list[3],
		{ key = 'not_tall_enough_3', skip = true })

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.giant, { key = 'not_tall_enough_4', skip = true })

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.princess, { key = 'not_tall_enough_5', skip = true })

	--우리 둘이 무게를 합쳐서 있는 힘껏 땅을 내리쳐 보는 거야!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.giant, { key = 'not_tall_enough_6', skip = true })

	self.giant.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	-- section1에서 post section으로 넘어갔는지, 혹은 스테이지 시작 부터 post section인지 확인용
	self.controller.event_activated = true

end

	self.occult_girl.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)

end

function local_class:start() quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(self.occult_girl)
end

function local_class:exit()
	if self.occult_girl ~= nil then
		if self.occult_girl.Interactable:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
			self.occult_girl.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
		end

		self.occult_girl = nil
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.occult_girl) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
					stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_with_occult_girl, self))
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:interact_with_occult_girl()
	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(self.occult_girl)
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:focus_occult_girl())

	character_util.align_party(self.occult_girl, "down", nil,"arc")

	local is_interested = true
	local is_accepted = false
	local wait = true

	if not self.skip_request then

		coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:request_main())

		local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))
		branches:Add({
			Text = game_string:GetString(self.branch_name1),
			Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy,
			Callback = function()
				wait = false
			end})
		branches:Add({
			Text = game_string:GetString(self.branch_name2),
			Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Brutal,
			Callback = function()
				wait = false
				is_interested = false
			end})

		ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(self.occult_girl, branches)

		while wait do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		wait = true
	end

	if is_interested then
		coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:explaine_main())

		if self.skip_request then
			coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:repeat_explaine_main())
		end

		self.skip_request = true

		is_accepted = quest_util.process_quest_request(self.quest_spec.QuestId)

		if is_accepted then
			floating_text_util.activate_for_quest(user_party_leader, self.quest_spec.QuestName, 0)

			coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:repeat_main())
			coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:focus_unlock())

			coroutine.yield(quest_util.activate_quest(self.controller))
		else
			coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:decline_main())
			coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:focus_unlock())
			quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(self.occult_girl)
		end
	else
		coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:focus_unlock())
		quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(self.occult_girl)
	end

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

return local_class

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.ghost_girl) and not self.flag_checker[1] then

function local_class:ghost_popup()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	local marker = field:GetMarker(self.marker_name1)
	local item_data = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData("ItemData")

	character_util.set_position(self.ghost_girl, marker.position)
	character_util.set_direction(self.ghost_girl, "down")

	local pos = user_party_leader.Position

	local player_dir
	if pos.x >= marker.position.x then
		player_dir = "left"
	else
		player_dir = "right"
	end
	character_util.set_direction(user_party_leader, player_dir)

	local knock_back_dir = vector((pos.x - marker.position.x) / math.abs(pos.x - marker.position.x) / 2,
			0, -0.2)

	local knock_back_info = character_util.knockback_info("linear", true, knock_back_dir, nil,
			nil, nil, true, 0.6, 0.6, 2)

	command_util.publish_knock_back(user_party_leader.Owner, user_party_leader,
			knock_back_info, user_party_leader.Position)

	self.fx_hit_Earth:Instantiate(pos)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.big_hit_sfx_handle_name)
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party_leader, {name = "hurt"})
	character_util.spine_pulse_color(user_party_leader, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 1)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish(user_party_leader, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.3)

	for key,value in pairs(self.ghost_wall) do
		character_util.set_active_state(value, "enabled")
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(value, 1, 0.5)
	end

	local drop_item = drop_item_util.create_item(
			{pos = pos, target = self.ghost_girl.Position,
			 itemid = item_data:GetSpec(self.card_student_spec_name).Id, notforinven = true, lootstate = "dontfindlooter"})

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.jump(user_party[i], 1, 0.5)
	end

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.2))

	user_party_leader:RemoveEmotion()
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party_leader, { name = "surprise"})
	character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, {name = "seat"})

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.4))

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.drop_item_Sfx_handle_name)

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.8))

	local party_pos_x = user_party_leader.Position.x - (0.375 * (user_party.Count - 2))
	local move_done
	if user_party.Count ~= 1 then
		move_done = false
	else
		move_done = true
	end

	for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local c = user_party[i]
		local target_pos = vector(party_pos_x, 0, user_party_leader.Position.z - 1)

		character_util.move_waypoint(c, target_pos, (target_pos - c.Position).magnitude, true,
				nil, nil, CS.Oak.Direction.Up, nil, nil,
				function ()
					move_done = true
				end)
		party_pos_x = party_pos_x + 0.75
	end

	while not move_done do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_direction(user_party[i], user_party_leader.Direction)
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party[i], {name = "scared"})
	end

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1))

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.summon_effect_sfx_handle_name)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.ghost_appear_sfx_handle_name)
	self.fx_levelup:Instantiate(self.ghost_girl.Position)
	self.fx_dead:Instantiate(self.ghost_girl.Position)
	drop_item:ConsumeComplete()
	character_util.set_active_state(self.ghost_girl, "enabled")

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1))

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		user_party[i]:RemoveAnimation()
		user_party[i]:RemoveEmotion()
	end

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1))

	self:set_marker_and_tracker()

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:interact_with_ghost()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name2)
	character_util.align_party(self.ghost_girl, "down", nil, "arc")

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.5))

	if not self.skip_reqeust then
		self.skip_reqeust = true
		coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:Scene_1_0())
	end

	coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:Scene_1_1())

	local wait = true
	local is_opened = false

	local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString(self.branch_name1),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Normal,
		Callback = function()
			wait = false
			is_opened = true
		end})
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString(self.branch_name2),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Normal,
		Callback = function()
			wait = false
		end})

	ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(self.ghost_girl, branches)

	while wait do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if is_opened then
		coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:Scene_1_2())

		for key,value in pairs(self.ghost_wall) do
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(value, 0, 1)
		end

		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1))

		for key,value in pairs(self.ghost_wall) do
			character_util.set_active_state(value, "disabled")
		end

		coroutine.yield(quest_util.progress_section(self.controller))
	else
		coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:Scene_1_3())
		self:set_marker_and_tracker()
	end

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:ghost_disappear()
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(user_party_leader,
			{key = self.talk_name1, world_pos = self.ghost_girl.Position, skip = true })
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

return local_class

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) and
				e.Zone.Name == self.boss_zone_init_section_name then
			self.is_zone = true
		end
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then
			if e.Zone.Name == self.boss_zone_init_section_name then
				self.is_zone = false
			elseif not self.is_battle and self.is_zone and e.Zone.Name == self.boss_zone_ready_section_name then

						util.cs_generator(self.battle_init, self))
			end
		end
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		if e.BattleGroupName == self.battle_group_name then

function local_class:boss_explosion_setup()

	character_util.spine_damage_squish(self.shadow_beast, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.3)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.boss_explosion, self))

	character_util.set_anim(self.shadow_beast, {name = "dead"})
end

function local_class:boss_explosion()
	local explosion_time_step = 0.25

	self.shadow_beast:Shake(0.05, 1000)

	camera_util.shake(0.04, 2, false)
	camera_util.resize_to(3, 3)

	local time_left = 11
	local is_stay = false

	local dying_audio_source_holder = CS.Oak.AudioSourceHolder()
	local explosion_loop_audiosource_holder = music_player_util.play_sfx(
			{name = self.explosion_loop_sfx_handle_name,
			 loop = true, fade_in_time = 1, type_priority = CS.Oak.SfxTypePriority.Loop,
			 player_priority = CS.Oak.SfxPlayerPriority.Npc})

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.boss_explosion_sfx_handle_name)

	while time_left > 0 do
		local center = self.shadow_beast.Bounds.center
		local xwidth = self.shadow_beast.Hitbox.size.x
		local zdepth = self.shadow_beast.Hitbox.size.z
		local radius_rand = 0.5 + CS.UnityEngine.Random.value * 0.5
		xwidth = xwidth * radius_rand
		zdepth = zdepth * radius_rand

		local rand = CS.UnityEngine.Random.value * math.pi * 2;
		local pos = center + vector(math.cos(rand) * xwidth, 0, math.sin(rand) * zdepth)

		local explosion = self.fx_explosion_small:Instantiate(pos)
		explosion.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one

		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(math.min(explosion_time_step, time_left)))

		time_left = time_left - explosion_time_step

		if not is_stay and time_left <= 5 then
			is_stay = true

			self.fx_explosion_boss:Instantiate(self.shadow_beast.Position)
			camera_util.shake(0.06, 5, false)

			dying_audio_source_holder = music_player:PlaySfx(self.dying_sfx_handle_name)
		end
	end

	explosion_loop_audiosource_holder:FadeOut(0.3)
	dying_audio_source_holder:Stop()

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.final_explosion_sfx_handle_name)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.boss_explosion_sfx_handle_name)

	character_util.set_active_state(self.shadow_beast, "disabled")

	stage_camera:ResizeToDefault(1)
end

function local_class:set_marker_and_tracker()
	if not self.is_battle then
		local marker = field:GetMarker(self.marker_name1)
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.marker_name2, self.quest_spec.QuestId,
				self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, marker.position)
		quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.tracker_name))
	else
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name2)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

return local_class

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.ghost_girl) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
					self.interact_with_girls, self))
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:interact_with_girls()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name1)
	character_util.align_party(self.ghost_girl.Position, "down", nil, "arc")

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1))

	coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:Scene_3_0())

	local laura_flag = false
	local shadow_flag = false

	for i = 1, 3 do
		local wait = true
		local is_interest = 2
		local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))

		if not laura_flag then
			branches:Add({
				Text = game_string:GetString(self.branch_name1),
				Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Normal,
				Callback = function()
					wait = false
					is_interest = 0
					laura_flag = true
				end})
		end

		if not shadow_flag then
			branches:Add({
				Text = game_string:GetString(self.branch_name2),
				Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Normal,
				Callback = function()
					wait = false
					is_interest = 1
					shadow_flag = true
				end})
		end

		branches:Add({
			Text = game_string:GetString(self.branch_name3),
			Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Normal,
			Callback = function()
				wait = false
			end})

		ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(self.ghost_girl, branches)

		while wait do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		if is_interest == 0 then
			coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:Scene_3_0_bt1())
		elseif is_interest == 1 then
			coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:Scene_3_0_bt2())
		elseif i == 1 or i == 2 then
			coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:Scene_3_0_bt3())
			break
		end

		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1))
	end

	coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:Scene_3_0_ending())
	coroutine.yield(quest_util.progress_section(self.controller))

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	-- npc 이름
	self.oni_girl_name = 'oni_girl'

	-- 그리드 이름
	self.event_grid_name = 'oni_girl_grid'

	-- 마커 이름
	self.oni_girl_start_marker_name = 'oni_girl_start_pos'
	self.oni_girl_race_start_marker_name = 'oni_girl_race_start_pos'
	self.oni_girl_race_marker_name = 'oni_girl_race_'

	-- 이벤트 존 이름
	self.end_race_zone_name = 'oni_girl_end_race'
	self.player_leave_race_zone_name = 'oni_girl_leave_race'

	-- 기믹 이름
	self.door_name = 'oni_girl_door'

	-- 퀘스트 마커 이름
	self.oni_girl_quest_marker_name = 'oni_girl_racing_quest'

	-- 도깨비 소녀 웨이포인트 수
	self.oni_girl_waypoint_count = 11

	-- 플레이어가 이겼는지
	self.winner = nil

	-- 경주를 시작했는지
	self.race_start = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadActivityClear()

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress < 0 then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.start_race, self)
	else
		local oni_girl = get_character(self.oni_girl_name)
		quest_icon_util.set_quest_notice(oni_girl)
		character_util.add_listener(oni_girl, self.controller)

		character_util.set_emotion(oni_girl, { name = 'smile' })
		character_util.set_anim(oni_girl, { name = 'attack' })
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	local oni_girl = get_character(self.oni_girl_name)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(oni_girl, self.controller)

	self.winner = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local oni_girl = get_character(self.oni_girl_name)
	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, oni_girl) then

		quest_marker_util.remove(self.oni_girl_quest_marker_name)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.winner, user_party.Leader) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.win_player, self))

		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(self.winner, oni_girl) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.lose_player, self)

		else
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.retry_race, self))
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

-- ZoneEnterEvent
function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local oni_girl = get_character(self.oni_girl_name)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, oni_girl, self.end_race_zone_name) and self.race_start then
		if not self.winner then
			self.race_start = false
			self.winner = oni_girl

			-- bgm_transition: Event(bgm_lana) -> Field(bgm_cafe_main)
			music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })
		end
		return true
	end

	local leader = user_party.Leader
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.end_race_zone_name) and self.race_start then
		if not self.winner then
			self.race_start = false
			self.winner = leader
			CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowActivityClear()

			-- bgm_transition: Event(bgm_lana) -> Field(bgm_cafe_main)
			music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })
		end
		return true
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.player_leave_race_zone_name) and self.race_start then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.player_leave_race, self)
	end

	return false
end

-- 경주 시작
function local_class:start_race()
	local oni_girl = get_character(self.oni_girl_name)
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	self.race_start = true

	-- 경기 장소로 세팅
	-- bgm_transition: Field(ondemand/cafe/preload:bgm_cafe_main) -> Muted
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	local oni_girl_pos = field:GetMarker(self.oni_girl_race_start_marker_name).position
	oni_girl.Position = oni_girl_pos
	character_util.set_direction(oni_girl, 'left')
	party_util.position_party(oni_girl_pos + 2 * unity_class.vector3.back, 'left', 'linear')

	-- 가드들 세팅
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
		util.cs_generator(self.controller.race_guard_setting, self.controller))

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 좋아! 시작하자!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(oni_girl, { key = 'cafe_oni_girl_racing_7', skip = true })

	-- 3, 2, 1… 출발!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(oni_girl, { key = 'cafe_oni_girl_racing_8', skip = true })

	-- bgm_transition: Muted -> Event(bgm_lana)
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_lana', state = 'event' })

-- 퀘스트 재시작

	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	local oni_girl = get_character(self.oni_girl_name)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(oni_girl, self.controller)

	quest_icon_util.remove(oni_girl)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(oni_girl)

	party_util.align_to_target(oni_girl, 'right', 1, 'linear')

	-- 어때? 날 이길 준비는 됐어?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(oni_girl, { key = 'cafe_oni_girl_racing_21', skip = true })

	-- 퀘스트 수락 UI
	local accepted = quest_util.process_quest_request(self.quest_spec.QuestId, false)

	if accepted then
		floating_text_util.activate_for_quest(user_party.Leader, self.quest_spec.QuestName, 0)
		screen_util.quest_accept_event()

		character_util.set_emotion(oni_girl, { name = 'attack' })
		character_util.set_anim(oni_girl, { name = 'shoot' })
		-- 어서 레이스하러 가자!

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(oni_girl)

function local_class:run_oni_girl_routine()
	local oni_girl = get_character(self.oni_girl_name)

	local oni_girl_waypoints = {}
	for i = 1, self.oni_girl_waypoint_count do
		local marker = field:GetMarker(self.oni_girl_race_marker_name .. i).position
		table.insert(oni_girl_waypoints, marker)
	end

	wp_util.move_way_points_async(oni_girl, { waypoints = oni_girl_waypoints, speed = 5, run = true })

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.winner, oni_girl) then
		character_util.set_emotion(oni_girl, { name = 'smile' })
		character_util.set_anim(oni_girl, { name = 'victory_extra' })
	else
		character_util.set_emotion(oni_girl, { name = 'tired' })
	end

	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.oni_girl_quest_marker_name, oni_girl)

	character_util.add_listener(oni_girl, self.controller)

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(oni_girl, { key = 'cafe_oni_girl_racing_24', skip = true })

	local oni_girl = get_character(self.oni_girl_name)

	-- 시작 지점으로 세팅
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	character_util.set_direction(oni_girl, 'right')
