		QuestName = OniGirlRacingChina @
		Comment = 중국 스테이지 도깨비 소녀 달리기. @
		Index = 0 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	self.oni_girl = nil

	self.racing_on = false
	self.racing_finished = false
	self.racing_won = false

	self.oni_girl_name = "onigirl"

	self.race_end_marker_name = "race_end"
	self.race_start_marker_name = "race_start"

	self.talk_name1 = "onigirlracing_china_giveup"

	self.marker_name = "onigirl_racing_china"
	self.tracker_name = "onigirlracing_china_tracker_0"

	self.battle_gate_name = "onigirl_battlegate_"
	self.door_name = "onigirl_door"
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	self.oni_girl = get_character(self.oni_girl_name)
	self.oni_girl.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)

	self.controller:setting_dummies()

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	self.controller.scene:add_callback('SetRace', { controller = self, func = self.set_race } )
	self.controller.scene:add_callback('OpenDoor', { controller = self, func = self.open_door } )

	quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.tracker_name))

	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == -1 then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.start_race, self))
	else
		quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(self.oni_girl)
		character_util.set_anim(self.oni_girl, {name = "attack"})
	end

	return
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	self.oni_girl = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.oni_girl) then
			if not self.racing_finished then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
						self.start_race, self, true))
			else
				if self.racing_won then
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
							self.win_race, self))
				else
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
							self.lose_race, self))
				end

				self.racing_finished = false
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:start_race(align)
	if align == nil then
		align = false
	end

	self.oni_girl:RemoveAnimation()
	ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.marker_name, self.quest_spec.QuestId,
	self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self.oni_girl)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(self.oni_girl)

	if align then
		character_util.align_party(self.oni_girl, "left")
	end

	yield_return(self.controller.scene, "race_start")

	self.racing_on = true
	self.oni_girl.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	self.oni_girl.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()

	local cor = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
			self.controller.scene.onigirl_race, self.controller.scene))

	local won = false
	local race_start = field:GetMarker(self.race_start_marker_name).position
	local race_end = field:GetMarker(self.race_end_marker_name).position

	while true do
		if user_party_leader.Position.z > race_start.z + 1 then
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name)
			user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

			stop_coroutine(cor)

			coroutine.yield(nil)

			character_util.stop(self.oni_girl)

			camera_util.move(self.oni_girl.Position, 1)
			coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1))

			character_util.jump(self.oni_girl, 0.2, 0.3)
			character_util.set_direction(self.oni_girl, "left")

			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.oni_girl, {key = self.talk_name1, skip = true})
			self.controller:stop_race_bgm()

			yield_return(self, "lose")
			break
		end

		if not won and user_party_leader.Position.z <= race_end.z then
			CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowActivityClear()
			self.controller:stop_race_bgm()
			camera_util.shake(0.07, 0.1)

			won = true
		end

		if self.oni_girl.Position.z <= race_end.z then
			character_util.stop(self.oni_girl)
			character_util.set_direction(self.oni_girl, "left")

			if not won then
				character_util.set_anim(self.oni_girl, {name = "victory_extra"})
				character_util.set_emotion(self.oni_girl, {name = "doyagao"})
			else
				character_util.set_anim(self.oni_girl, {name = "seat"})
				character_util.set_emotion(self.oni_girl, {name = "tired"})
			end
			quest_icon.SetQuestCleared(self.oni_girl)
			self.racing_on = false
			self.racing_won = won
			self.racing_finished = true
			break
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.controller:stop_race_bgm()
	self:end_race()

	self.oni_girl.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
	self.oni_girl.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)
	self.oni_girl.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance
end

function local_class:lose_race()
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(self.oni_girl)
	character_util.align_party(self.oni_girl, "left")
	yield_return(self.controller.scene, "player_lose")
	yield_return(self, "lose")
end

function local_class:win_race()
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name)
	quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(self.oni_girl)
	character_util.align_party(self.oni_girl, "left")
	yield_return(self.controller.scene, "win_race")
	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0)
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

function local_class:lose()
	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(self.oni_girl)
	self.racing_on = false

	yield_return(self.controller.scene, "lose_race")

	self.oni_girl:RemoveAnimation()
	self.oni_girl:RemoveEmotion()

	quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(self.oni_girl)
	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:set_race()
	self.controller:revive_dummies()

	for i = 1, 8 do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create(
				string.format("%s%d", self.battle_gate_name, i )))
	end
end

function local_class:end_race()
	for i = 1, 8 do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create(
				string.format("%s%d", self.battle_gate_name, i )))
	end
end

function local_class:open_door()
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.door_name))
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

return local_class

end

end

end

--- OnEvent
function local_class:on_event(e)
	local oni_girl = self.get_oni_girl()

	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, oni_girl) then

-- 공중전화에 상호작용 했을 때 라나와의 대화
function local_class:talk_oni_girl()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local oni_girl = self.get_oni_girl()
	local phone_box = self.get_phone_box()

	if not self.is_call_pizza_house then
		local phone_box_speech_offset = vector(2.7, 0, 2.3)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		-- 어설픈 건강보다는 고기와 치즈! 혈관의 대적, 마마존스입니다!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(phone_box,
			{ key = 'demonworld_oni_girl_racing_26', skip = true, offset = phone_box_speech_offset })

		-- 오늘 추천 메뉴는 슈프림 스테이크 딥디쉬 피자입니다.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(phone_box,
			{ key = 'demonworld_oni_girl_racing_26_1', skip = true, offset = phone_box_speech_offset })

		-- 주문하시겠어요?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(phone_box,
			{ key = 'demonworld_oni_girl_racing_26_2', skip = true, offset = phone_box_speech_offset })

		-- 선택 : 주문한다 (50 마계 달러) / 끊는다.
		local player_choice = choose_util.play_choose_event({
			{ 'demonworld_oni_girl_racing_27', 'mercy' },
			{ 'demonworld_oni_girl_racing_28', 'brutal' }
		})

		-- '끊는다' 선택 시
		if player_choice == 2 then
			self:end_call_event()
			return
		end

		-- '주문한다' 선택 시

		-- 잔액이 부족할 경우
		local demon_world_dollar = get_or_create_global_table('stageeventcontrollers/DemonWorldDollar')
		if demon_world_dollar:get_dollar() < self.pizza_price then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_comic_01')
			-- 돈이 모자라다…
			field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'demonworld_oni_girl_racing_31', mintotalduration = 1 })

			self:end_call_event()
			return
		end

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_drop_gold_01')

		demon_world_dollar:remove_dollar(self.pizza_price, false, { play_sfx = false })

		-- 10초 안에 도착할 거에요. 최근 정말 빠른 알바생이 들어왔거든요.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(phone_box,
			{ key = 'demonworld_oni_girl_racing_29', skip = true, offset = phone_box_speech_offset })

		self.controller.stop_deliver_routine = true
		character_util.stop(oni_girl)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_phone_call_fail_01')
		character_util.move_to_async(leader, leader.Position + vector(0, 0, -0.75),
			1, nil, false, true)

		local z_dif = 7
		oni_girl.Position = leader.Position + vector(1.5, 0, -1 * z_dif)

		party_util.align_party(leader.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), 'left', 0.5, 'linear')

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'question', loop = false })
		wait_for_sec(3)

		local move_duration = 1

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_lana_01')
		-- 번개보다 빠르게! 마마존스 피자입니다!
		wait_all({
			util.cs_generator(
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async, oni_girl, { key = 'demonworld_oni_girl_racing_1' }),
			util.cs_generator(
				character_util.move_waypoint_async, oni_girl, oni_girl.Position + vector(0, 0, z_dif),
				z_dif / move_duration, true, nil, nil, 'left')
		})

		character_util.set_emotion(oni_girl, { name = 'smile' })

		character_util.remove_anim(leader)

		character_util.normal_jump(oni_girl, true)
		character_util.move_to_async(oni_girl, oni_girl.Position + vector(0.01, 0, 0), 0.32)

		character_util.normal_jump(oni_girl, true)
		character_util.move_to_async(oni_girl, oni_girl.Position + vector(-0.01, 0, 0), 0.32)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
		-- 앗, {0}잖아!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(oni_girl, { key = { 'demonworld_oni_girl_racing_2', user.Name }, skip = true })

		-- 오랜만이야. 어디 멀리 다녀왔나보네.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(oni_girl, { key = 'demonworld_oni_girl_racing_3', skip = true })

		-- 내 라이벌답게 어디선가 특훈이라도 하고 온거겠지?!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(oni_girl, { key = 'demonworld_oni_girl_racing_4', skip = true })

		-- 하지만 나도 이 마계에서 만만치 않게 빨라졌다고
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(oni_girl, { key = 'demonworld_oni_girl_racing_5', skip = true })

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		-- 마계에서 가장 가혹한 직업이라는 피자 배달부을 하며 몸과 마음을 단련했으니까 말이지!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(oni_girl, { key = 'demonworld_oni_girl_racing_6', skip = true })

		self.is_call_pizza_house = true
	else
		party_util.align_to_target(oni_girl, 'left', 1, 'linear')
	end

	-- 그런 의미에서... 이번엔 피자 배달 승부 어때?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(oni_girl, { key = 'demonworld_oni_girl_racing_7', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_emotion(oni_girl)

	oni_girl.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil

	-- 퀘스트 수락 UI
	local accepted = quest_util.process_quest_request(self.quest_spec.QuestId, false)

	if accepted then
		floating_text_util.activate_for_quest(leader, self.quest_spec.QuestName, 0)
		screen_util.quest_accept_event(nil, false)

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		yield_return_func(quest_util.activate_quest, self.controller)
	else

		-- 이해해. 누구라도 이 번개같은 속도를 보면 겁먹을 테니까!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(oni_girl,
			{ key = 'demonworld_oni_girl_racing_24', skip = true })

		-- 생각이 바뀌면 다시 도전해도 좋아!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(oni_girl,
			{ key = 'demonworld_oni_girl_racing_25', skip = true })

		quest_icon_util.set_quest_notice(oni_girl)
		character_util.add_listener(oni_girl, self.controller)

		field_ui_manager:Show()
		party_util.reset_controllers()
	end

	return accepted
end

	character_util.move_to_async(leader, leader.Position + vector(0, 0, -0.75),

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	party_util.reset_controllers()

return local_class

			self.right_gauge_bar = self.versus_ui.transform:Find('Content/Right/Gauge'):GetComponent(
				typeof(CS.UIProgressBar))

			self.left_gauge_label = self.versus_ui.transform:Find('Content/Left/Gauge/Value'):GetComponent(

function local_class:start()
	-- 시작 progress에 따른 처리
	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress < 0 then
		self.already_failed_player = false
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.start_race, self))
	else
		local oni_girl = self.get_oni_girl()
		local phone_box = self.get_phone_box()
		oni_girl.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(phone_box.Bounds.center) + vector(1.5, 0, -3)
		character_util.set_direction(oni_girl, 'left')
		quest_icon_util.set_quest_notice(oni_girl)

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('oni_girl_door'))

--- OnEvent
function local_class:on_event(e)
	local oni_girl = self.get_oni_girl()

	-- 배달 고객한테 상호작용 시
	for _, customer in pairs(self.player_customer) do
		if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, customer) then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_number_01')

			self.player_point = self.player_point + 1
			self.left_gauge_label.text = self.player_point .. ' / ' .. 5
			self.left_gauge_bar.value = self.player_point / 5

			if self.player_point > 4 then
				self.player_win = true
				character_util.stop(oni_girl)
			end

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
				party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
				field_ui_manager:Hide()

				self:throw_pizza_box(true, customer)

				-- 라이트닝 카운터나 플레이어가 이겼을 때는 컨트롤 돌려주지 않음
				if self.oni_girl_point < 5 and not self.player_win then

					local leader = user_party.Leader

					-- 이동, 달리기, 상호작용 제외 컨트롤 불가능하도록 설정
					local player_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(leader, false)
					player_state:DisableControls(CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.All) ~
						(CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Move) +
							CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Dash) +
							(CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Interact))))
					message_system:SendSync(leader.FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(player_state))

					field_ui_manager:Show()
					party_util:reset_controllers()
				end

				end))
			return true
		end
	end

	-- 라이트닝 카운터에 상호작용 시
	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, oni_girl) then
		character_util.remove_relate_event(oni_girl, self.controller)
		quest_icon_util.remove(oni_girl)

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
			party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
			field_ui_manager:Hide()

			party_util.align_to_target(oni_girl, 'left', 1, 'linear')

			self:start_race()
		end))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,

		return true
	end
	return false
end

		sfx_invisible.Position = vector(leader.Position.x, 0, self.get_right_dir_car_pos(1).z + 0.5)

--- 경주 시작
function local_class:start_race()
	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local oni_girl = self.get_oni_girl()
	local phone_box = self.get_phone_box()

	if self.already_failed_player then
		-- 어때 다시 도전할거야?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(oni_girl, { key = 'demonworld_oni_girl_racing_34', skip = true })

		-- 선택: 도전한다. / 지금은 됐어.
		local player_choice = choose_util.play_choose_event({
			{ 'demonworld_oni_girl_racing_35', 'mercy' },
			{ 'demonworld_oni_girl_racing_36', 'brutal' }
		})

		-- 지금은 됐어. 선택 시
		if player_choice == 2 then
			character_util.add_listener(oni_girl, self.controller)
			quest_icon_util.set_quest_notice(oni_girl)
			field_ui_manager:Show()
			party_util.reset_controllers()
			return
		end
	end

	-- 도전한다. 선택 시

	-- 다섯 판을 먼저 배달 하는 사람이 승리야!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(oni_girl, { key = 'demonworld_oni_girl_racing_8', skip = true })

	character_util.set_emotion(oni_girl, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_anim(oni_girl, { name = 'shoot' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	-- 그럼, 시작하자!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(oni_girl, { key = 'demonworld_oni_girl_racing_9', skip = true })

	-- bgm_transition: Field(bgm_demonworld_main) -> Muted, 1
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 1 })

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	self.is_racing = true

	local racing_start_pos = self.get_racing_start_pos()

			  notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', showoncharacter = true })

		self.controller.oni_girl_pizza_box.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.zero

		self.controller.oni_girl_hold_up_state = true

	end

	oni_girl.Position = racing_start_pos + vector(0, 0, -1)
	oni_girl.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(oni_girl)
	character_util.set_direction(oni_girl, 'right')

	-- 리더 피자 박스 설정
	self.controller.leader_pizza_box = drop_item_util.create_item(
		{ pos = leader.Position, itemid = self.controller.pizza_box_item_id,

	self.controller.leader_pizza_box.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.zero

	self.controller.leader_hold_up_state = true
	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'hold_loop', upper = true })

	leader.Position = racing_start_pos
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')

	-- 돌아다니는 주민 세팅
	for i = 1, self.total_citizen_count do
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.citizen_move_routine, self, i))
	end
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.check_crash_routine, self))
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.car_move_manager, self))

	wait_for_sec(1)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_intro_demonworld_01')

	local sfx_invisible = self.get_sfx_invisible()
	local car_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
		{ sfx_name = '01_car_loop_03', loop = true, parent = sfx_invisible })

	wait_for_sec(1)

	self.is_player_collided_with_car = false

	self.player_win = false

	self.player_point = 0
	self.left_gauge_label.text = self.player_point .. ' / ' .. 5

	self.right_gauge_label.text = self.oni_girl_point .. ' / ' .. 5

	for _, customer in pairs(self.player_customer) do

		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, customer.Name, customer)
	end

	-- 3… 2… 1… 출발!

	-- 이동, 달리기, 상호작용 제외 컨트롤 불가능하도록 설정
	local player_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(leader, false)
	player_state:DisableControls(CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.All) ~

		local go_waypoints = {}

			local waypoint = self.get_oni_girl_delivery_pos(part, i)

		end

		local cb = function(waypoint_index)

				elseif waypoint_index == 3 then

--- 피자 박스 배달 연출
function local_class:throw_pizza_box(is_player, customer)
	quest_marker_util.remove(customer.Name)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(customer, self.controller)

	self.player_is_throwing_box = true

	local target = self.get_oni_girl()

	character_util.set_emotion(customer, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.set_anim(customer, { name = 'clap' })

	if is_player then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_clap_02')

		target = user_party.Leader
		party_util.align_to_target(customer, customer.Direction, 0.3, 'linear')
	end

	-- 피자 박스 던지는 연출
	local pizza_box = drop_item_util.create_item(
		{ pos = target.Position + vector(0, 1.4, 0), itemid = self.controller.pizza_box_item_id,
		  notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', showoncharacter = true })

	pizza_box.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.zero

	if is_player then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_box_01')
	end

	local target_pos = customer.Position + 0.3 * direction_util.to_vector3(customer.Direction)
	sp_util.sine_move(pizza_box, { from = pizza_box.Position, to = target_pos, duration = 0.5, height = 1.5 })

	pizza_box.ConsumeTarget = customer

	self.player_is_throwing_box = false
end

--region 돌아다니는 주민 및 자동차 로직

-- 돌아다니는 주민 루틴
function local_class:citizen_move_routine(index)
	local citizen = self.get_racing_citizen(index)

	citizen.Position = self.citizen_origin_pos[citizen]

	local citizen_speed = 4

	-- 시작 지점, 끝 지점
	local move_waypoint = {}
	for i = 1, 2 do
		local waypoint = self.get_citizen_waypoint(index, i)
		table.insert(move_waypoint, waypoint)
	end

	local current_index = 1

	self.stop_citizen_moving[citizen] = false

	-- 경주 중일 때만 움직임
	while self.is_racing do
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(citizen, move_waypoint[current_index], citizen_speed)

		if self.stop_citizen_moving[citizen] then
			while self.stop_citizen_moving[citizen] do
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
		else
			current_index = current_index + 1

			if current_index > #move_waypoint then
				current_index = 1
			end
		end
	end
end

--- 돌아다니는 자동차 관리
function local_class:car_move_manager()
	if not self.cars then
		self.cars = {}
		for i = 1, self.total_car_count do
			local car = self.get_racing_car(i)
			car.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
			car.Transform.localScale = 0.75 * unity_class.vector3.one
			table.insert(self.cars, car)
		end
	end

	local right_dir_start_pos = self.get_right_dir_car_pos(1)
	local left_dir_start_pos = self.get_left_dir_car_pos(1)

	local right_dir_end_pos = self.get_right_dir_car_pos(2)
	local left_dir_end_pos = self.get_left_dir_car_pos(2)

	local right_dir_time = unity_class.time.time
	local left_dir_time = unity_class.time.time

	local right_dir_cur_time = right_dir_time
	local left_dir_cur_time = left_dir_time

	local car_speed = 12

	while self.is_racing do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		right_dir_cur_time = right_dir_cur_time + dt
		left_dir_cur_time = left_dir_cur_time + dt

		if right_dir_cur_time - right_dir_time > 1 then

			local car = self.cars[1]
			if car then
				right_dir_time = unity_class.time.time

				car.Position = right_dir_start_pos
				car.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 180, 0)
				car.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.5, 0, 1), vector(1, 1, 1))
				table.remove(self.cars, 1)

				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
					character_util.move_to_async(car, right_dir_end_pos, nil, car_speed)

					car.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
					table.insert(self.cars, car)
				end))
			end
		end

		if left_dir_cur_time - left_dir_time > 1 then

			local car = self.cars[1]
			if car then
				left_dir_time = unity_class.time.time

				car.Position = left_dir_start_pos
				car.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, 0)
				car.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.5, 0, 0), vector(1, 1, 1))
				table.remove(self.cars, 1)

				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
					character_util.move_to_async(car, left_dir_end_pos, nil, car_speed)

					car.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
					table.insert(self.cars, car)
				end))
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

--- 플레이어와 주민 및 자동차 충돌 체크 루틴
function local_class:check_crash_routine()
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	local citizens = {}
	for i = 1, self.total_citizen_count do
		local citizen = self.get_racing_citizen(i)
		table.insert(citizens, citizen)
		self.is_playing_crash_action[citizen] = false
	end

	local cars = {}
	for i = 1, self.total_car_count do
		local car = self.get_racing_car(i)
		table.insert(cars, car)
	end

	while self.is_racing do
		for _, citizen in pairs(citizens) do
			-- 바운드가 겹치는지 체크 / 넉백 중일 때는 충돌하지 않도록
			if not (math.abs(self:get_overlapped_xz_area(citizen.Bounds, leader.Bounds)) < constants.epsilon) and
				leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentAction ~= CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stunned then

				music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_hit_npc_01')

				-- npc 이동 정지
				character_util.stop(citizen)
				self.stop_citizen_moving[citizen] = true

				-- 플레이어 넉백 방향
				local dir = vector_util.to_direction(leader.Position - citizen.Position)
				local player_knock_back_dir = direction_util.to_vector3(dir)

				-- 플레이어 넉백
				local knock_back_info = character_util.knockback_info(
					'linear', true, player_knock_back_dir, nil, nil,
					nil, true, nil, CS.Oak.Constants.WallBounceTime,
					CS.Oak.Constants.WallBounceDistance)

				command_util.publish_knock_back(leader.Owner, leader, knock_back_info, leader.Position)

				-- npc 충돌 처리
				character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(citizen)
				character_util.spine_deviate_local(citizen,
					-0.25 * player_knock_back_dir, 0.12, 0.12)

				if not self.is_playing_crash_action[citizen] then
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
						util.cs_generator(self.crash_citizen_action, self, citizen, player_knock_back_dir))
				end

			end
		end

		for _, car in pairs(cars) do
			-- 바운드가 겹치는지 체크 / 자동차 다중 충돌 방지
			if not (math.abs(self:get_overlapped_xz_area(car.Bounds, leader.Bounds)) < constants.epsilon) and
				not self.is_player_collided_with_car then

				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.player_air_spin, self))
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:get_overlapped_xz_area(bounds1, bounds2)
	local min_x = math.max(bounds1.min.x, bounds2.min.x)
	local min_z = math.max(bounds1.min.z, bounds2.min.z)
	local max_x = math.min(bounds1.max.x, bounds2.max.x)
	local max_z = math.min(bounds1.max.z, bounds2.max.z)

	return math.max(0, max_x - min_x) * math.max(0, max_z - min_z);
end

--- 충돌 후 주민 행동
function local_class:crash_citizen_action(citizen, player_knock_back_dir)
	self.is_playing_crash_action[citizen] = true

	-- npc 넉백 (npc 이동 방향에서만 넉백 됨)
	-- 넉백 이동에 벽이 있으면 넉백 되지 않음
	local citizen_knock_back_dir = -1 * player_knock_back_dir

	local obj_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(citizen.Bounds, 0.4 * citizen_knock_back_dir)
	local is_wall = false

	-- 벽이 있는지 체크
	for i = 0, obj_list.Count - 1 do
		local obj = obj_list[i]
		if obj.EntityGroup == CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle then
			is_wall = true
			break
		end
	end

	obj_list:Dispose()

	-- npc 넉백 실행
	local guard_dir = direction_util.to_vector3(citizen.Direction)
	if not is_wall and player_knock_back_dir == guard_dir or player_knock_back_dir == -1 * guard_dir then
		local knock_back_info = character_util.knockback_info(
			'linear', true, citizen_knock_back_dir, nil, nil,
			nil, true, nil, CS.Oak.Constants.WallBounceTime,
			CS.Oak.Constants.WallBounceDistance)

		command_util.publish_knock_back(citizen.Owner, citizen, knock_back_info, citizen.Position)
	end

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	self.is_playing_crash_action[citizen] = false
	self.stop_citizen_moving[citizen] = false
end

--- 자동차 충돌 연출
function local_class:player_air_spin()
	if self.oni_girl_point > 4 then
		return
	end

	self.is_player_collided_with_car = true

	local leader = user_party.Leader

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	camera_util.shake(0.25, 0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_car_damaged_01')

	self.get_hit_effect():Instantiate(leader.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))
	self.get_last_hit_effect():Instantiate(leader.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local fall_time = 1.5
	local free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(15, 20, 0, 0)

	-- 피격 연출
	character_util.spine_rotate(leader, 360, fall_time)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(leader)
	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(leader)
	character_util.set_direction(leader, direction_util.to_side_dir(leader.Direction))

	character_util.remove_anim(leader, true)
	character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'embarrassed' })

	local start_pos = leader.Position

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fall_down_01')

	while (unity_class.time.time - cur_time < fall_time) do
		free_fall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		local dist_y = free_fall:GetDistance()

		character_util.set_position(leader, start_pos + vector(0, dist_y, 0), true)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_mech_stomp_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')

	camera_util.shake(0.4, 0.5)

	self.get_butt_bounce_effect():Instantiate(leader.Position)

	character_util.remove_anim(leader)

	character_util.spine_rotate(leader, 0, 0)
	leader.Position = start_pos
	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'prostrate' })
	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.shake(leader, 0.04, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_player_popup_01'})

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	character_util.mario_jump_async(leader, leader.Direction)

	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'hold_loop', upper = true })

	if self.oni_girl_point > 4 or self.player_win then
		return
	end

	-- 이동, 달리기, 상호작용 제외 컨트롤 불가능하도록 설정
	local player_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(leader, false)
	player_state:DisableControls(CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.All) ~
		(CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Move) +
			CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Dash) +
			(CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Interact))))
	message_system:SendSync(leader.FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(player_state))

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	party_util.reset_controllers()

	-- 무적 시간 대기
	local immune_duration = 1

	wait_for_sec(immune_duration)

	self.is_player_collided_with_car = false
end

--endregion

return local_class

    self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress
    self.quest_spec = quest_spec

    self.racing_finished = false
    self.racing_won = false

    self.tracker_name = "onigirlracing_desert_tracker_0"
    self.marker_name = "onigirl_racing_desert"
    self.race_start_marker_name = "race_start"
    self.race_end_marker_name = "race_end"
    self.exit_race_out_name = "exit_race_out"
    self.talk_name = "onigirlracing_desert_giveup"

    self.door_name = "onigirl_door"
end

function local_class:enter()
    message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

    self.oni_girl = get_character("onigirl")
    self.oni_girl.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)

    return true
end

function local_class:start()
    self.controller.scene:add_callback('OpenDoor', { controller = self, func = self.open_door } )

    quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.tracker_name))

    if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == -1 then
        coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.start_race, self))
    else
        quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(self.oni_girl)
        character_util.set_anim(self.oni_girl, {name = "attack"})
    end
end

function local_class:exit()
    message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

    self.controller = nil
    self.quest_progress = nil

    self.oni_girl = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
    local event_type = e:GetType()
    if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
        if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.oni_girl) then
            if not self.racing_finished then
                coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
                        stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.start_race, self, true))
            else
                if self.racing_won then
                    coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
                            stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.win_race, self))
                else
                    coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
                            stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.lose_race, self))
                end
                self.racing_finished = false
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end

function local_class:start_race(align)
    self.oni_girl:RemoveAnimation()

    ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.marker_name, self.quest_spec.QuestId,
            self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self.oni_girl)
    field_ui_manager:Hide()
    quest_icon.RemoveIcon(self.oni_girl)

    if align then
        character_util.align_party(self.oni_girl, "left")
    end

    coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:race_start())

    self.racing_on = true
    self.oni_girl.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
    self.oni_girl.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

    field_ui_manager:Show()
    user_party:ResetControllers()

    local cor = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
            self.controller.scene.onigirl_race, self.controller.scene))

    local won = false
    local race_start = field:GetMarker(self.race_start_marker_name).position
    local race_end = field:GetMarker(self.race_end_marker_name).position

    local exit = get_field_object(self.exit_race_out_name)
    local exit_interactable = exit.Interactable
    exit.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

    while true do
        if user_party_leader.Position.x < race_start.x - 1 then
            ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name)
            user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

            stop_coroutine(cor)

            coroutine.yield(nil)

            character_util.stop(self.oni_girl)

            camera_util.move(self.oni_girl.Position, 1)
            coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1))

            character_util.jump(self.oni_girl, 0.2, 0.3)
            character_util.set_direction(self.oni_girl, "left")

            speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.oni_girl, {key = self.talk_name, skip = true})
            self.controller:stop_race_bgm()
            coroutine.yield(self:lose())
            break
        end

        if not won and user_party_leader.Position.x >= race_end.x then
            CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowActivityClear()
            self.controller:stop_race_bgm()
            camera_util.shake(0.07, 0.1)

            won = true
        end

        if self.oni_girl.Position.x >= race_end.x then
            character_util.stop(self.oni_girl)

            if not won then
                character_util.set_anim(self.oni_girl, {name = "victory_extra"})
                character_util.set_emotion(self.oni_girl, {name = "doyagao"})
            else
                character_util.set_anim(self.oni_girl, {name = "seat"})
                character_util.set_emotion(self.oni_girl, {name = "tired"})
            end
            quest_icon.SetQuestCleared(self.oni_girl)
            self.racing_on = false
            self.racing_won = won
            self.racing_finished = true
            break
        end
        coroutine.yield(nil)
    end

    self.controller:stop_race_bgm()

    exit.Interactable = exit_interactable

    self.oni_girl.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
    self.oni_girl.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)
    self.oni_girl.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance
end

function local_class:lose_race()
    ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name)
    field_ui_manager:Hide()
    quest_icon.RemoveIcon(self.oni_girl)
    character_util.align_party(self.oni_girl, "right")

    coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:player_lose())
    coroutine.yield(self:lose())
end

function local_class:win_race()
    ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name)
    quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)
    field_ui_manager:Hide()
    quest_icon.RemoveIcon(self.oni_girl)
    character_util.align_party(self.oni_girl, "right")

    coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:win_race())
    coroutine.yield(quest_util.complete_quest(self.controller, 0))

    field_ui_manager:Show()
end

function local_class:lose()
    quest_icon.RemoveIcon(self.oni_girl)

    self.racing_on = false

    coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:lose_race())

    self.oni_girl:RemoveAnimation()
    self.oni_girl:RemoveEmotion()

    quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(self.oni_girl)
    field_ui_manager:Show()
    user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:open_door()
    message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.door_name, true))
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('OniGirlRacingDungeonkingdomSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = OniGirlRacingDungeonkingdom @
		Comment = 던전 왕국 스테이지 도깨비 소녀 달리기. @
		Index = 0 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
    self.controller = controller
    self.quest_spec = quest_spec
    self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

    self.oni_girl = nil
    self.race_finished = false
    self.player_race_won = false

    self.end_door_open_count = 0

    self.interact_coroutine = nil

    self.lana_race_waypoints = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
    self.lana_race_waypoints:Add(vector(-57, 0, -29))
    self.lana_race_waypoints:Add(vector(-57, 0, -36))
    self.lana_race_waypoints:Add(vector(-34, 0, -36))

    self.quest_marker_name = "onigirl_racing_dungeonkingdom"

    self.prev_stage_bgm_state = nil
    self.prev_stage_bgm_name = nil
    self.race_coroutine = nil
    self.lana_run_coroutine = nil

    self.lana_origin_position = vector(-25, 0, -30)
end

function local_class:enter()
    message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
    message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.DoorOpenedEvent), 'on_event')
    message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_event')
    message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectRevivedEvent), 'on_event')

    self.oni_girl = get_character("onigirl")

    return true
end

function local_class:start()
    if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == -1 then
        self.race_coroutine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.start_race, self))
    else
        self:set_oni_girl()
    end
end

function local_class:exit()
    message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
    message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.DoorOpenedEvent))
    message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))
    message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectRevivedEvent))

    self.controller = nil
    self.quest_spec = nil
    self.quest_progress = nil
    self.oni_girl = nil

    self.prev_stage_bgm_state = nil
    self.prev_stage_bgm_name = nil
    self.interact_coroutine = nil
    self.race_coroutine = nil
    self.lana_run_coroutine = nil

    self.lana_race_waypoints = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
    local event_type = e:GetType()
    if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
        if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.oni_girl) then
            if self.race_finished then
                self.race_finished = false
                if self.player_race_won then
                    self.interact_coroutine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
                            CS.Oak.Game.Instance.gameObject, util.cs_generator(self.win_race, self))
                else
                    self.interact_coroutine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
                            CS.Oak.Game.Instance.gameObject, util.cs_generator(self.lose_race, self))
                end
            else
                self.interact_coroutine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
                        CS.Oak.Game.Instance.gameObject, util.cs_generator(self.re_challenge, self))
            end
        end
    elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.DoorOpenedEvent) then
        if e.DoorHandleName == "onigirl_door_1" or e.DoorHandleName == "onigirl_door_2" then
            self.end_door_open_count = self.end_door_open_count + 1
        end
    elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent) then
        -- 레이스 진행도중에 플레이어가 죽었을경우 곧 GameOver Bgm이 나오기때문에 강제로 BgmState를 Field로 바꾸어 꼬임을 방지.
        if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) and self.race_coroutine ~= nil then
            stop_coroutine(self.race_coroutine)
            stop_coroutine(self.lana_run_coroutine)

            local oni_direction_pos = (user_party_leader.Position - self.oni_girl.Position):GetX0z()
            character_util.set_direction(self.oni_girl, oni_direction_pos:ToDirection())
            character_util.set_emotion(self.oni_girl, {name = "idle", loop = true})
            character_util.set_anim(self.oni_girl, {name = "idle", loop = true})

            -- GameOverUI 리소스 로드가 길어질 경우 BgmState가 꼬이지 않도록 임시로 바꿔준 필드 Bgm이 잠시동안 들릴 수 있다.
            -- 따라서, volume을 0으로 재생하여 들리지 않도록 방지.
            music_player:PlayStageMusic(CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Field, nil, 0)
        end
    elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectRevivedEvent) then
        if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) and self.race_coroutine ~= nil then
            self:set_oni_girl()

            self.interact_coroutine = nil
            self.race_coroutine = nil
        end
    end

    return false
end

function local_class:set_oni_girl()
    character_util.set_position(self.oni_girl, self.lana_origin_position)
    character_util.set_direction(self.oni_girl, "right")
    character_util.set_anim(self.oni_girl, {name = "attack", loop = true})
    character_util.set_emotion(self.oni_girl, {name = "smile", loop = true})
    self.oni_girl.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance
    self.oni_girl.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()

    quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(self.oni_girl)
    if self.oni_girl.Interactable:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
        self.oni_girl.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)
    end
end

function local_class:re_challenge()
    quest_icon.RemoveIcon(self.oni_girl)
    if self.oni_girl.Interactable:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
        self.oni_girl.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
    end

    field_ui_manager:Hide()

    character_util.align_party(self.oni_girl, "right", nil,"arc")

    local waited = true
    local accepted = false

    CS.Oak.IQuestEventControllerExtensions.ProcessQuestRequest(nil, self.quest_spec.QuestId, function(accepted_in)
        waited = false
        accepted = accepted_in
    end)

    while waited do
        coroutine.yield(nil)
    end

    if accepted then
        self.race_coroutine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
                stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.start_race, self))
    else
        screen_util.quest_decline_Event()

        quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(self.oni_girl)
        if self.oni_girl.Interactable:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
            self.oni_girl.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)
        end

        --user_party:ResetControllers()
        field_ui_manager:Show()
        self.interact_coroutine = nil
    end

end

function local_class:start_race()
    character_util.set_emotion(self.oni_girl, {name = "smile", loop = true})
    character_util.set_anim(self.oni_girl, {name = "shoot", loop = true})
    yield_return_func(CS.Oak.IFieldObjectExtensions.TalkAsync, self.oni_girl, "onigirl_dungeonkingdom_7", true)

    character_util.remove_emotion(self.oni_girl)
    character_util.remove_anim(self.oni_girl)

    screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, "linear")

    -- 라나 출발 준비
    character_util.set_position(self.oni_girl, vector(-26, 0, -29))
    character_util.set_direction(self.oni_girl, "left")
    self.oni_girl.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
    self.oni_girl.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

    -- 플레이어 출발 준비
    user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
    user_party:PositionParty(vector(-26, 0, -30), CS.Oak.Direction.Left, 0, "linear")

    screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, "linear")

    yield_return_func(CS.Oak.IFieldObjectExtensions.TalkAsync, self.oni_girl, "onigirl_8", true)

    self:backup_and_mute_stage_music()

    yield_return_func(CS.Oak.IFieldObjectExtensions.TalkAsync, self.oni_girl, "onigirl_9", true)

    self:play_race_bgm()

    -- 라나 출발
    self.lana_run_coroutine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.lana_run, self))

    -- 플레이어 출발
    user_party:ResetControllers()
    field_ui_manager:Show()

    local won = false
    local race_start = field:GetMarker("race_start").position
    local race_end = field:GetMarker("race_end").position

    while true do
        -- 플레이어가 트랙 밖으로 이탈하려 했을 때
        local is_run_away = user_party_leader.Position.x >= race_start.x + 2

        if is_run_away then
            user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
            stop_coroutine(self.lana_run_coroutine)
            character_util.stop(self.oni_girl)
            character_util.remove_emotion(self.oni_girl)
            character_util.remove_anim(self.oni_girl)

            camera_util.move(self.oni_girl.Position, 1)
            coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1))

            local oni_direction_pos = (user_party_leader.Position - self.oni_girl.Position):GetX0z()
            character_util.set_direction(self.oni_girl, oni_direction_pos:ToDirection())
            character_util.jump(self.oni_girl, 0.2, 0.3)
            yield_return_func(CS.Oak.IFieldObjectExtensions.TalkAsync, self.oni_girl, "onigirl_10", true)


            -- 경기장 이탈 시의 BGM 처리
            self:stop_race_bgm()

            yield_return_func(self.give_up_race, self)

            break
        end

        local is_reach_end_point = user_party_leader.Position.x >= race_end.x
                and user_party_leader.Position.z <= race_end.z + 2
        -- 플레이어가 승리했을 때
        if not won and is_reach_end_point then
            CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowActivityClear()

            -- 승리 시의 BGM 처리
            self:stop_race_bgm()

            camera_util.shake(0.07, 0.1)

            won = true
        end

        -- 라나가 골 지점에 들어왔을 때
        local is_lana_reach_end_point = self.oni_girl.Position.x >= race_end.x
                and self.oni_girl.Position.z <= race_end.z + 2.5
        if is_lana_reach_end_point then
            character_util.stop(self.oni_girl)

            -- 플레이어가 졌다면
            if not won then
                character_util.set_emotion(self.oni_girl, {name = "doyagao", loop = true})
                character_util.set_anim(self.oni_girl, {name = "success", loop = true})
            else
                character_util.set_emotion(self.oni_girl, {name = "tired", loop = true})
                character_util.set_anim(self.oni_girl, {name = "idle", loop = true})
            end

            local qi = self.quest_progress.QuestId
            if ui_quest_marker:IsActiveMarker(self.quest_progress.QuestId) then
                ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_progress.QuestId, false, self.oni_girl)
            end

            quest_icon.SetQuestCleared(self.oni_girl)

            self.player_race_won = won
            self.race_finished = true

            break
        end

        coroutine.yield(nil)
    end

    self:stop_race_bgm()

    self.oni_girl.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
    if self.oni_girl.Interactable:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
        self.oni_girl.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)
    end
    self.oni_girl.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance

    self.interact_coroutine = nil
    self.race_coroutine = nil
end

-- 달리기 시합에서 패배하고 도깨비 소녀에게 말 걸었을 때 실행
function local_class:lose_race()
    field_ui_manager:Hide()
    user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

    camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.15)
    camera_util.resize_to(3, 0.15)
    coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.15))

    music_player:PlayDialogueSfx(CS.Oak.DialogueSfxType.Emphasize)

    yield_return_func(CS.Oak.IFieldObjectExtensions.TalkAsync, self.oni_girl, "onigirl_dungeonkingdom_9", true)

    stage_camera:ResizeToDefault(0.15)
    coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.15))

    yield_return_func(self.lana_n_party_teleport, self)

    character_util.set_anim(self.oni_girl, {name = "success", loop = true})

    yield_return_func(CS.Oak.IFieldObjectExtensions.TalkAsync, self.oni_girl, "onigirl_dungeonkingdom_10", true)

    self.interact_coroutine = nil

-- 달리기 시합에서 승리하고 도깨비 소녀에게 말 걸었을 때 실행
function local_class:win_race()

    user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

    yield_return_func(CS.Oak.IFieldObjectExtensions.TalkAsync, self.oni_girl, "onigirl_dungeonkingdom_12", true)

    character_util.set_direction(self.oni_girl,
            (user_party_leader.Position - self.oni_girl.Position):ToDirection())

    camera_util.resize_to(3, 0.3)

    yield_return_func(CS.Oak.IFieldObjectExtensions.TalkAsync, self.oni_girl, "onigirl_dungeonkingdom_15", true)

    character_util.remove_anim(self.oni_girl)

    yield_return_func(CS.Oak.IFieldObjectExtensions.TalkAsync, self.oni_girl, "onigirl_dungeonkingdom_16", true)

-- 달리기 도중 경로를 이탈해, 경기를 포기했다고 간주될 때 불리는 코루틴
function local_class:give_up_race()

    character_util.remove_anim(self.oni_girl)
    character_util.remove_emotion(self.oni_girl)

end

function local_class:lana_run()
    local run_speed = 4.25

    character_util.set_anim(self.oni_girl, {name = "run", loop = true})

    for i = 0, self.lana_race_waypoints.Count - 1 do
        local move_point = self.lana_race_waypoints[i]
        yield_return_func(CS.Oak.IFieldObjectExtensions.MoveTo, self.oni_girl, move_point, nil, run_speed, true)
    end
end

function local_class:lana_n_party_teleport()
    screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, "linear")

    character_util.set_position(self.oni_girl, self.lana_origin_position)
    character_util.set_direction(self.oni_girl, "right")

    user_party:PositionParty(self.lana_origin_position + unity_class.vector3.right, CS.Oak.Direction.Left, 0, "linear")

    camera_util.move(user_party_leader.Position, 1, {target = user_party_leader, end_target = user_party_leader})

    screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, "linear")
end

function local_class:open_end_door()
    message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create("onigirl_door_1", false))
    message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create("onigirl_door_2", false))

    while self.end_door_open_count ~= 2 do
        coroutine.yield(nil)
    end

    camera_util.move(user_party_leader.Position, 1, user_party_leader)
    coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1))
end

-- 레이스 전 Muted 상태로 BGM을 바꾸기 전에 기존 BGM 백업하는 과정
function local_class:backup_and_mute_stage_music()
    self.prev_stage_bgm_name = music_player.CurrentStageMusicName
    self.prev_stage_bgm_state = music_player.StageBgmState

    -- 팡파레, 새로운 캐릭터 얻는 상태의 예외처리
    if music_player.StageBgmState == CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Fanfare
            or music_player.StageBgmState == CS.Oak.StageBgmState.NewCharacterTheatre then
        self.prev_stage_bgm_state = CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Field
    end

    music_player:PlayStageMusic(CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Muted)
end

-- 레이싱 BGM 재생
function local_class:play_race_bgm()
    --music_player_util.play_sfx("02_gun_shoot_01")
    music_player:PlaySfxOneShot("02_gun_shoot_01")

    music_player:PlayStageMusic("bgm_lana", CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Event, 0)
end

-- 레이싱 BGM 중지 후 기존 BGM으로 복구
function local_class:stop_race_bgm()
    -- 이미 BGM이 중지되었다면 리턴
    if music_player.CurrentStageMusicName ~= "bgm_lana" then
        return
    end

    if self.prev_stage_bgm_state == CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Event then
        music_player:PlayStageMusic(self.prev_stage_bgm_name, CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Event)
    else
        music_player:PlayStageMusic(self.prev_stage_bgm_state)
    end

end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('OniGirlRacingHighSchoolSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = OniGirlRacingHighSchool @
		Comment = 라이브 이벤트 학교 스테이지 도깨비 소녀 달리기. @
		Index = 0 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	self.oni_girl = nil

	self.racing_coroutine = nil

	self.racing_on = false
	self.racing_finished = false
	self.racing_won = false

	self.oni_girl_name = "onigirl"

	self.race_gole_zone_name = "lightning_counter_gole"
	self.race_zone_name = "lightning_counter_battle"

	self.race_end_marker_name = "race_end"
	self.race_start_marker_name = "race_start"

	self.talk_name1 = "onigirlracing_highschool_giveup"

	self.marker_name = "onigirl_racing_highschool"
	self.tracker_name = "onigirlracing_highschool_tracker_0"

	self.door_name_1 = "onigirl_door_1"
	self.door_name_2 = "onigirl_door_2"
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	self.oni_girl = get_character(self.oni_girl_name)
	self.oni_girl.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.tracker_name))

	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == -1 then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.start_race, self))
	else
		quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(self.oni_girl)
		character_util.set_anim(self.oni_girl, { name = "attack" })
	end

	return
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	self.oni_girl = nil

	self.racing_coroutine = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		self:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not e.FullEnter then
		return
	end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.race_gole_zone_name then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then
			if self.racing_on == true then
				self.racing_on = false
				self.racing_won = true

				CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowActivityClear()
			end

			self.controller:stop_race_bgm()

			camera_util.shake(0.07, 0.1)
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.oni_girl) then
			if self.racing_on == true then
				self.racing_on = false
			end

			if self.racing_finished == false then
				self.racing_finished = true
			end

			self.controller:stop_race_bgm()

			character_util.stop(self.oni_girl)
			character_util.set_direction(self.oni_girl, "right")

			if not self.racing_won then
				character_util.set_anim(self.oni_girl, { name = "victory_extra" })
				character_util.set_emotion(self.oni_girl, { name = "doyagao" })
			else
				character_util.set_anim(self.oni_girl, { name = "seat" })
				character_util.set_emotion(self.oni_girl, { name = "tired" })
			end

			quest_icon.SetQuestCleared(self.oni_girl)

			self.oni_girl.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
			self.oni_girl.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)
			self.oni_girl.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if not e.FullLeave then
		return
	end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.race_zone_name then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then
			if self.racing_on == true then
				self.racing_on = false

				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
						stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.give_up, self))
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.oni_girl) then
		if not self.racing_finished then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
					self.start_race, self, true))
		else
			if self.racing_won then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
						self.win_race, self))
			else
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
						self.lose_race, self))
			end

			self.racing_finished = false
		end
	end
end

function local_class:start_race(align)
	if align == nil then
		align = false
	end

	self.oni_girl:RemoveAnimation()
	ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.marker_name, self.quest_spec.QuestId,
			self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self.oni_girl)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(self.oni_girl)

	if align then
		character_util.align_party(self.oni_girl, "left")
	end

	self.oni_girl:SetAnimation("shoot", true)
	self.oni_girl:SetEmotion("attack", true)

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.oni_girl, { key = 'onigirlracing_highschool_6', skip = true })

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

	local marker = field:GetMarker(self.race_start_marker_name).position
	character_util.align_party(marker + vector(0, 0, -1), 'up', 0)

	character_util.set_position(self.oni_girl, marker + vector(-1, 0, 0))
	character_util.set_direction(self.oni_girl, CS.Oak.Direction.Down)

	self.oni_girl:RemoveAnimation()
	self.oni_girl:RemoveEmotion()

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.5))

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

	self.controller:backup_and_mute_stage_music()

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.oni_girl, { key = 'onigirlracing_highschool_7', skip = true })

	self.controller:play_race_bgm()

	self.racing_on = true
	self.oni_girl.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	self.oni_girl.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()

	self.racing_coroutine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.onigirl_race, self))
end

function local_class:onigirl_race()
	local lana_default_speed = 5

	self.oni_girl:SetAnimation("run", true)

	coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.IFieldObjectExtensions.MoveTo(
			self.oni_girl, vector(-32, 0, 27), nil, lana_default_speed, true))

	coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.IFieldObjectExtensions.MoveTo(
			self.oni_girl, vector(-40, 0, 27), nil, lana_default_speed, true))

	coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.IFieldObjectExtensions.MoveTo(
			self.oni_girl, vector(-40, 0, 25.5), nil, lana_default_speed, true))

	character_util.jump(self.oni_girl, 1, 0.5)

	coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.IFieldObjectExtensions.MoveTo(
			self.oni_girl, vector(-31, 0, 25), nil, lana_default_speed, true))

	coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.IFieldObjectExtensions.MoveTo(
			self.oni_girl, vector(-31, 0, 23), nil, lana_default_speed, true))

	coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.IFieldObjectExtensions.MoveTo(
			self.oni_girl, vector(-33, 0, 23), nil, lana_default_speed, true))

	coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.IFieldObjectExtensions.MoveTo(
			self.oni_girl, vector(-33, 0, 20), nil, lana_default_speed, true))
end

function local_class:give_up()
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name)
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	stop_coroutine(self.racing_coroutine)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	character_util.stop(self.oni_girl)

	camera_util.move(self.oni_girl.Position, 1)
	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1))

	character_util.jump(self.oni_girl, 0.2, 0.3)
	character_util.look_at(self.oni_girl, user_party_leader)
	self.oni_girl:RemoveAnimation()

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.oni_girl, { key = self.talk_name1, skip = true })

	self.oni_girl.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)
	self.oni_girl.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance

	yield_return(self, "lose")
end

	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, oni_girl) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
			stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.talk_with_oni_girl, self, oni_girl))

		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- 라나와 대화
function local_class:talk_with_oni_girl(oni_girl)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(oni_girl, self.controller)
	quest_icon_util.remove(oni_girl)

	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	party_util.align_to_target(oni_girl, 'right', 1, 'linear')

	if not self.talk_skip then
		character_util.normal_jump(oni_girl)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
		-- 라나 (right, smile, idle) : 안녕, 친구! 또 만났네!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(oni_girl,
			{ key = 'lilith_tower_oni_girl_racing_1', skip = true })

		character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(
			user_party.Leader, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })

		character_util.remove_emotion(oni_girl)
		-- 응..? 여긴 밥 먹으러 왔는데..
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(oni_girl,
			{ key = 'lilith_tower_oni_girl_racing_1_1', skip = true })

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = pre @
		QuestName = OniGirlRacingSnowMountain @
		Comment = 도깨비 소녀에게 퀘스트 수락 받기 전 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
    self.controller = controller
    self.cs_controller = self.controller.cs_controller
    self.quest_spec = quest_spec
    self.scene = self.controller.scene

    self.shake_coroutine = nil
end

function local_class:enter()
    message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
end

function local_class:start()
    local oni_girl = get_character("onigirl")
    quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(oni_girl)

    if oni_girl.Interactable:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
        oni_girl.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)
    end

    self.shake_coroutine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
            util.cs_generator(self.controller.shake_oni_girl, self.controller, oni_girl))
end

function local_class:exit()
    message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

    if self.shake_coroutine ~= nil then
        stop_coroutine(self.shake_coroutine)
    end

    local oni_girl = get_character("onigirl")

    if oni_girl.Interactable:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
        oni_girl.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)
    end

    self.shake_coroutine = nil

    self.controller = nil
    self.cs_controller = nil
    self.quest_spec = nil
    self.scene = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
    local event_type = e:GetType()

    if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
        local oni_girl = get_character("onigirl")

        if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, oni_girl) then
            coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.quest_open, self))
        end
    end

    return false
end

function local_class:quest_open()
    local oni_girl = get_character("onigirl")

    quest_icon.RemoveIcon(oni_girl)

    if oni_girl.Interactable:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
        oni_girl.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)
    end

    field_ui_manager:Hide()

    character_util.align_party(oni_girl, "right")

    local is_accepted = false
    local wait = true

    yield_return_func(self.scene.quest_open, self.scene)

    CS.Oak.IQuestEventControllerExtensions.ProcessQuestRequest(nil, self.quest_spec.QuestId, function(accepted_in)
        wait = false
        is_accepted = accepted_in
    end)

    while wait do
        coroutine.yield(nil)
    end

    if is_accepted then
        screen_util.quest_accept_event()
        yield_return_func(quest_util.activate_quest, self.controller)
    else
        screen_util.quest_decline_Event()

        quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(oni_girl)
        if oni_girl.Interactable:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
            oni_girl.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)
        end

        field_ui_manager:Show()
        user_party:ResetControllers()
    end

end

function local_class:dispose()
end

return local_class

		if oni_girl.Interactable:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
			oni_girl.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)
		end

		self.shake_coroutine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(self.controller.shake_oni_girl, self.controller, oni_girl))
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.scene = nil

	self.shake_coroutine = nil

	self.prev_stage_bgm_state = nil
	self.prev_stage_bgm_name = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		local oni_girl = get_character("onigirl")

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, oni_girl) then
			if self.race_finished then
				self.race_finished = false
				if self.player_race_won then
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
							util.cs_generator(self.win_race, self))
				else
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
							util.cs_generator(self.lose_race, self))
				end
			else
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
						util.cs_generator(self.re_challenge, self))
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:re_challenge()
	local oni_girl = get_character("onigirl")
	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(oni_girl)

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	character_util.align_party(oni_girl, "right")

	local is_accepted = false
	local wait = true

	CS.Oak.IQuestEventControllerExtensions.ProcessQuestRequest(nil, self.quest_spec.QuestId, function(accepted_in)
		is_accepted = accepted_in
		wait = false
	end)

	while wait do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if is_accepted then
		screen_util.quest_accept_event()

		if self.shake_coroutine ~= nil then
			stop_coroutine(self.shake_coroutine)
		end

		yield_return_func(self.start_race, self)
	else
		screen_util.quest_decline_Event()

		quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(oni_girl)

		field_ui_manager:Show()
		user_party:ResetControllers()
	end
end

function local_class:start_race()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	local oni_girl = get_character("onigirl")

	character_util.set_anim(oni_girl, {name = "shoot", loop = true})

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(oni_girl, {key = "onigirl_3_15", skip = true})

	character_util.remove_anim(oni_girl)

	stop_coroutine(self.shake_coroutine)
	oni_girl.SpineController:CancelShake()
	self.shake_coroutine = nil

	self:backup_and_mute_stage_music()

	yield_return_func(self.scene.race_start, self.scene)

	self:play_race_bgm()

	-- 라나 출발 시작
	oni_girl.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	oni_girl.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	start_coroutine(self.race_route, self)

	-- 플레이어 출발 시작
	user_party:ResetControllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()

	local won = false
	local race_start_pos = field:GetMarker("race_start").position
	local race_end_pos = field:GetMarker("race_end").position

	while true do
		-- 플레이어가 트랙 밖으로 이탈하려 했을 때
		if user_party_leader.Position.z > race_start_pos.z + 3 then
			user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
			self.is_race_quit = true

			character_util.stop(oni_girl)

			camera_util.move(oni_girl.Position, 1)
			wait_for_sec(1)

			oni_girl.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(vector_util.get_x0z(
					user_party_leader.Position - oni_girl.Position))
			character_util.jump(oni_girl, 0.2, 0.3)

			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(oni_girl, {key = "onigirl_10", skip = true})

			-- 경기장 이탈 시의 BGM 처리
			self:stop_race_bgm()

			yield_return_func(self.give_up_race, self)

			break
		end

		-- 플레이어가 승리했을 때
		if not won and user_party_leader.Position.z <= race_end_pos.z then
			CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowActivityClear()

			-- 승리 시의 BGM 처리
			self:stop_race_bgm()

			camera_util.shake(0.07, 0.1)

			won = true
		end

		-- 라나가 골 지점에 들어왔을 때
		if oni_girl.Position.z <= race_end_pos.z then
			character_util.stop(oni_girl)

			-- 플레이어가 졌다면
			if not won then
				character_util.set_anim(oni_girl, {name = "victory_extra", loop = true})
				character_util.set_emotion(oni_girl, {name = "doyagao", loop = true})
			else    -- 플레이어가 이겼다면
				character_util.set_anim(oni_girl, {name = "idle", loop = true})
				character_util.set_emotion(oni_girl, {name = "tired", loop = true})
			end

			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_progress.QuestId,
					self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, oni_girl)
			quest_icon.SetQuestCleared(oni_girl)

			self.player_race_won = won
			self.race_finished = true
			break
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self:stop_race_bgm()

	oni_girl.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
	if oni_girl.Interactable:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
		oni_girl.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)
	end
	oni_girl.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance
end

function local_class:lose_race()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	local oni_girl = get_character("onigirl")

	character_util.align_party(oni_girl, "left", 1, "arc")

	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)
	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(oni_girl)

	oni_girl.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(user_party_leader.Position - oni_girl.Position)

	yield_return_func(self.scene.player_lose, self.scene)

	yield_return_func(self.give_up_race, self)
end

function local_class:win_race()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	local oni_girl = get_character("onigirl")

	character_util.align_party(oni_girl, "left", 1, "arc")

	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)
	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(oni_girl)

	oni_girl.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(user_party_leader.Position - oni_girl.Position)

	yield_return_func(self.scene.win_race, self.scene)

	yield_return_func(self.open_end_door, self)

	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0)

	user_party:ResetControllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

function local_class:give_up_race()
	local oni_girl = get_character("onigirl")
	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(oni_girl)

	yield_return_func(self.scene.lose_race, self.scene)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(oni_girl)
	quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(oni_girl)

	if self.shake_coroutine == nil then
		self.shake_coroutine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(self.controller.shake_oni_girl, self.controller, oni_girl))
	end

	self.is_race_quit = false

	user_party:ResetControllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

function local_class:open_end_door()
	camera_util.move(vector(-28.5, 0, -96.5), 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create("onigirl_door_1", false))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create("onigirl_door_2", false))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create("onigirl_door_3", false))

	wait_for_sec(2.5)

	camera_util.move(user_party_leader.Position, 1, { end_target = user_party_leader })
	wait_for_sec(1)
end

-- 레이스 전 Muted 상태로 BGM을 바꾸기 전에 기존 BGM 백업하는 과정
function local_class:backup_and_mute_stage_music()
	self.prev_stage_bgm_name = music_player.CurrentStageMusicName
	self.prev_stage_bgm_state = music_player.StageBgmState

	-- 팡파레, 새로운 캐릭터 얻는 상태의 예외처리
	if music_player.StageBgmState == CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Fanfare
			or music_player.StageBgmState == CS.Oak.StageBgmState.NewCharacterTheatre then
		self.prev_stage_bgm_state = CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Field
	end

	music_player:PlayStageMusic(CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Muted)
end

-- 레이싱 BGM 재생
function local_class:play_race_bgm()
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot("02_gun_shoot_01")

	music_player:PlayStageMusic("bgm_lana", CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Event, 0)
end

-- 레이싱 BGM 중지 후 기존 BGM으로 복구
function local_class:stop_race_bgm()
	-- 이미 BGM이 중지되었다면 리턴
	if music_player.CurrentStageMusicName ~= "bgm_lana" then
		return
	end

	if self.prev_stage_bgm_state == CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Event then
		music_player:PlayStageMusic(self.prev_stage_bgm_name, CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Event)
	else
		music_player:PlayStageMusic(self.prev_stage_bgm_state)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

function local_class:race_route()
	local oni_girl = get_character("onigirl")

	local race_wp = {
		{
			vector(-30.5, 0, -56),
		},
		{
			vector(-30.5, 1, -58),
		},
		{
			vector(-30.5, 1, -59),
		},
		{
			vector(-30.5, 0, -61),
		},
		{
			vector(-34, 0, -61),
			vector(-34, 0, -69),
			vector(-32, 0, -69),
			vector(-32, 0, -73.5),
			vector(-23, 0, -73.5),
			vector(-23, 0, -79),
			vector(-20, 0, -79),
			vector(-20, 0, -82),
			vector(-24, 0, -82),
			vector(-24, 0, -88),
			vector(-27.5, 0, -88),
			vector(-27.5, 0, -90),
		}
	}

	local move_speed = 4.5
	local jump_dur = 0.5

	if self.is_race_quit then
		return
	end

	wp_util.move_async(oni_girl, race_wp[1], move_speed, nil)

	if self.is_race_quit then
		return
	end

	character_util.jump(oni_girl, 1, jump_dur)
	character_util.move_to_async(oni_girl, race_wp[2][1], jump_dur, nil, true, true)

	if self.is_race_quit then
		return
	end

	wp_util.move_async(oni_girl, race_wp[3], move_speed, nil)

	if self.is_race_quit then
		return
	end

	character_util.jump(oni_girl, 0.5, jump_dur)
	character_util.move_to_async(oni_girl, race_wp[4][1], jump_dur, nil, true, true)

	if self.is_race_quit then
		return
	end

	wp_util.move_async(oni_girl, race_wp[5], move_speed, nil, { last_direction = 'left' })
end

return local_class

end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(train.Interactable, CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then

	end

	local oni_girl = get_character(self.oni_girl_name)

	end
end

end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		local train = get_character(self.train_name)
		local oni_girl = get_character(self.oni_girl_name)
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, train) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.boarding_train, self)
			return true
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, oni_girl) then
			-- 두고 봐, 다음엔 절대 지지 않을 테니까!
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(oni_girl, {key = 'onigirl_steampunk_21', skip = true})
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

-- 열차 탑승 연출
function local_class:boarding_train()
	local duration = 0.5
	local hide_weapon_key = 'onigirl_train_event'

	local train = get_character(self.train_name)
	local racing_train = get_character(self.controller.racing_train_name)

	-- 파티원들 열차 탑승
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local party_member = user_party[i]
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(party_member, 0, duration)
		party_member:HideWeapon(true, hide_weapon_key)
		character_util.set_direction(party_member, 'left')
		character_util.move_to(party_member, train.Position, duration, nil, nil, true)
	end

	wait_for_sec(duration)

	character_util.move_to(train, train.Position + 9 * unity_class.vector3.left,
		1.5, nil, true)

	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	-- 경기장으로 세팅
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.7, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	camera_util.resize_to(6, 0)
	camera_util.move(racing_train.Position, 0, { end_target = racing_train })
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 열차 출발
	self.controller.train_move_progress = 1

	for _ = 1, #self.controller.train_way_point_count do
		yield_return_func(self.controller.train_move, self.controller)
	end

	local marker = field:GetMarker(self.controller.train_pos_name .. 'final').position + 5 * unity_class.vector3.forward
	character_util.move_waypoint(racing_train, marker, self.controller.train_speed)

	yield_return_func(self.controller.end_game_setting, self.controller)

	character_util.move_to_async(train, train.Position + 9 * unity_class.vector3.right,
		1.5, nil, true)

	-- 파티원들 열차 하차
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local party_member = user_party[i]
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(party_member, 1, duration / 2)
		party_member:HideWeapon(true, hide_weapon_key)
		character_util.set_direction(party_member, 'right')
		local pos = train.Position + 2.5 * unity_class.vector3.right +
			i * 0.5 * CS.Oak.Constants.DistBetweenPartyMembers * unity_class.vector3.left
		character_util.move_to(party_member, pos, duration, nil, nil, true)
	end

	wait_for_sec(duration)

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local party_member = user_party[i]
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(party_member, 1, duration / 2)
		party_member:HideWeapon(false, hide_weapon_key)
	end
end

return local_class
