local local_class = newclass('OniGirlRacingTeatansSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = OniGirlRacingTeatans @
		Comment = 티탄 스테이지 도깨비 소녀 달리기. @
		Index = 0 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	self.oni_girl = nil

	self.racing_on = false
	self.racing_finished = false
	self.racing_won = false

	self.oni_girl_name = "onigirl"
	self.door_name = "onigirl_door"

	self.branch_name1 = "bt_no"
	self.branch_name2 = "bt_yes"

	self.talk_name1 = "onigirlracing_teatans_7"
	self.talk_name2 = "onigirlracing_teatans_23"
	self.talk_name3 = "onigirlracing_teatans_giveup"

	self.tracker_name = "onigirlracing_teatans_tracker_0"
	self.marker_name1 = "onigirl_racing_teatans"
	self.marker_name2 = "race_start"
	self.marker_name3 = "race_end"

	quest_icon.PreLoad()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	self.oni_girl = get_character(self.oni_girl_name)
	self.oni_girl.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)
	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	self.controller.scene:add_callback('OpenDoor', { controller = self, func = self.open_door } )
	quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.tracker_name))

	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == -1 then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
				stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.start_race, self))
	else
		quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(self.oni_girl)
		character_util.set_anim(self.oni_girl, {name = "attack"})
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	self.oni_girl = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.oni_girl) then
			if not self.racing_finished then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
						stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.start_race, self, true))
			else
				if self.racing_won then
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
							stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.win_race, self))
				else
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
							stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.lose_race, self))
				end
				self.racing_finished = false
			end
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:start_race(align)
	local is_align = align or false

	self.oni_girl:RemoveAnimation()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(self.oni_girl)

	if is_align then
		character_util.align_party(self.oni_girl, "left")
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.oni_girl, {key = self.talk_name1, skip = true})

		local wait = true
		local go = false

		local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))
		branches:Add({
			Text = game_string:GetString(self.branch_name1),
			Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Intellect,
			Callback = function()
				wait = false
			end})
		branches:Add({
			Text = game_string:GetString(self.branch_name2),
			Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Forced,
			Callback = function()
				go = true
				wait = false
			end})

		ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(self.oni_girl, branches)

		while wait do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		if go then
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.oni_girl, {key = self.talk_name2, skip = true})
		else
			field_ui_manager:Show()
			quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(self.oni_girl)
			user_party:ResetControllers()
			return
		end
	end

	ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.marker_name1, self.quest_progress.QuestId,
	self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self.oni_girl)

	coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:race_start())

	self.racing_on = true
	self.oni_girl.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	self.oni_girl.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()

	local race_coroutine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.controller.scene.onigirl_race, self.controller.scene))

	local race_start = field:GetMarker(self.marker_name2).position
	local race_end = field:GetMarker(self.marker_name3).position


	while true do
		if user_party_leader.Position.x < race_start.x or user_party_leader.Position.z > race_start.z + 1 then
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name1)
			user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
			stop_coroutine(race_coroutine)

			coroutine.yield(nil)

			character_util.stop(self.oni_girl)
			camera_util.move(self.oni_girl.Position, 1)

			coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1))

			self.oni_girl:RemoveEmotion()
			character_util.jump(self.oni_girl, 0.2, 0.3)
			character_util.set_direction(self.oni_girl, "left")
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.oni_girl, {key = self.talk_name3, skip = true})
			self.controller:stop_race_bgm()

			coroutine.yield(self:lose())
			break
		end

		if not won and user_party_leader.Position.x >= race_end.x then
			CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowActivityClear()

			self.controller:stop_race_bgm()
			camera_util.shake(0.07, 0.1)

			won = true
		end

		if self.oni_girl.Position.x >= race_end.x then
			character_util.stop(self.oni_girl)
			character_util.set_direction(self.oni_girl, "left")

			if not won then
				character_util.set_anim(self.oni_girl, {name = "victory_extra"})
				character_util.set_emotion(self.oni_girl, {name = "doyagao"})
			else
				character_util.set_anim(self.oni_girl, {name = "seat"})
				character_util.set_emotion(self.oni_girl, {name = "tired"})
			end

			quest_icon.SetQuestCleared(self.oni_girl)
			self.racing_on = false
			self.racing_won = won
			self.racing_finished = true
			break
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.controller:stop_race_bgm()
	self.oni_girl.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
	self.oni_girl.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)
	self.oni_girl.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance
end

function local_class:lose_race()
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name1)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(self.oni_girl)
	character_util.align_party(self.oni_girl, "left")

	coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:player_lose())
	coroutine.yield(self:lose())
end

function local_class:win_race()
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name1)
	quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(self.oni_girl)
	character_util.align_party(self.oni_girl, "left")

	coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:win_race())
	coroutine.yield(quest_util.complete_quest(self.controller, 0))

	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

function local_class:lose()
	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(self.oni_girl)
	self.racing_on = false

	coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:lose_race())

	self.oni_girl:RemoveAnimation()
	self.oni_girl:RemoveEmotion()
	quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(self.oni_girl)
	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:open_door()
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.door_name, false))
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('OniGirlRacingTitantavernSection1')

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)

    self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress
    self.quest_spec = quest_spec

    self.oni_girl = nil
    self.ridable_bombbug = nil

    self.racetrack_maidens = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.FieldObject)

    self.interact_coroutine = nil

    self.maiden_attacked = false
    self.race_finished = false

    self.winner = nil
    self.questMarkerName = "onigirl_racing_titantavern"

    self.prev_stage_bgm_state = nil
    self.prev_stage_bgm_name = ""
    self.onigirl_origin_position = vector(0, 0, 0)

    self.try_riding_when_racing = false
    self.lana_runcoroutine = nil

    self.bigmaiden_eventname = "hand_crush"
    self.bgm_lana_name = "bgm_lana"
    self.race_start_marker_name = "race_start"
    self.race_end_marker_name = "race_end"

    self.talk_titantavern_name7 = "onigirl_titantavern_7"
    self.talk_titantavern_name8 = "onigirl_titantavern_8"
    self.talk_titantavern_name9 = "onigirl_titantavern_9"
    self.talk_titantavern_name10 = "onigirl_titantavern_10"
    self.talk_titantavern_name11 = "onigirl_titantavern_11"
    self.talk_titantavern_name12 = "onigirl_titantavern_12"
    self.talk_titantavern_name13 = "onigirl_titantavern_13"
    self.talk_titantavern_name14 = "onigirl_titantavern_14"
    self.talk_titantavern_name15 = "onigirl_titantavern_15"
    self.talk_titantavern_name16 = "onigirl_titantavern_16"
    self.talk_titantavern_name17 = "onigirl_titantavern_17"
    self.talk_titantavern_name18 = "onigirl_titantavern_18"
    self.talk_name8 = "onigirl_8"
    self.talk_name9 = "onigirl_9"
    self.talk_name10 = "onigirl_10"
end

function local_class:enter()
    message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_event')

    self.oni_girl = get_character("onigirl")
    self.onigirl_origin_position = self.oni_girl.Position

    for i = 1, 3 do
        local maiden = get_field_object(string.format("race_track_maiden_%d", i))
        self.racetrack_maidens:Add(maiden)
    end

    self.ridable_bombbug = get_character("ridable_bombbug")

    return true
end

function local_class:start()
    if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == -1 then
        coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.start_race, self))
    else
        quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(self.oni_girl)
        self.oni_girl.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)
    end
end

function local_class:exit()
    message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))

    self.oni_girl.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)

    self.controller = nil
    self.quest_progress = nil
    self.oni_girl = nil
    self.interact_coroutine = nil
    self.winner = nil
    self.ridable_bombbug = nil
    self.lana_runcoroutine = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
    local event_type = e:GetType()
    if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
        if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.oni_girl) and self.interact_coroutine == nil then
            if self.race_finished then
                self.race_finished = false

                if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.winner, user_party_leader) then
                    self.interact_coroutine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
                            stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.win_race, self))
                else
                    self.interact_coroutine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
                            stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.lose_race, self))
                end
            else
                self.interact_coroutine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
                        stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.re_challenge, self))
            end
        end

        self.try_riding_when_racing = lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.ridable_bombbug)
    elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
        local satisfied = false;
        if e.Params ~= nil and e.Params.Length == 1 then
            satisfied = true
        end

        if self.racetrack_maidens:Contains(e.Sender) and satisfied and e.Params[0] == self.bigmaiden_eventname then
            self.maiden_attacked = true;
        end
    end
    return false
end

function local_class:re_challenge()
    quest_icon.RemoveIcon(self.oni_girl)
    field_ui_manager:Hide()

    character_util.align_party(self.oni_girl, "left", 1, "arc")

    local waited = true
    local accepted = false

    CS.Oak.IQuestEventControllerExtensions.ProcessQuestRequest(nil, self.quest_spec.QuestId, function(accepted_in)
        waited = false
        accepted = accepted_in
    end)

    while (waited) do
        coroutine.yield(nil)
    end

    if accepted then
        coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QuestAcceptEvent())
        coroutine.yield(self:start_race())
    else
        coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QuestDeclineEvent())
        quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(self.oni_girl)
        user_party:ResetControllers()
        field_ui_manager:Show()
    end

    self.interact_coroutine = nil
end

function local_class:start_race()
    field_ui_manager:Hide()
    user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

    message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.oni_girl, {self.race_start_marker_name}))

    local race_start = field:GetMarker(self.race_start_marker_name).position
    local race_end = field:GetMarker(self.race_end_marker_name).position

    self.winner = nil
    self.race_finished = false
    self.try_riding_when_racing = false

    for i = 0, self.racetrack_maidens.Count - 1 do
        local behaviour = self.racetrack_maidens[i].FieldObjectBehaviour

        if behaviour.CustomEvent == nil or behaviour.CustomEvent == "" then
            behaviour.CustomEvent = self.bigmaiden_eventname
        end
    end

    self.ridable_bombbug.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
    message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

    self.oni_girl:SetEmotion("smile", true)
    self.oni_girl:SetAnimation("shoot", true)

    coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.IFieldObjectExtensions.TalkAsync(self.oni_girl, self.talk_titantavern_name7, true))

    self.oni_girl:RemoveEmotion()
    self.oni_girl:RemoveAnimation()

    screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, "linear")

    self.oni_girl.Position = race_start + unity_class.vector3.back
    self.oni_girl.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
    self.oni_girl.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
    self.oni_girl.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

    user_party:PositionParty(race_start, CS.Oak.Direction.Right, 0, "linear")

    coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.5))

    screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, "linear")

    coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.IFieldObjectExtensions.TalkAsync(self.oni_girl, self.talk_name8, true))

    self:backup_and_mute_stage_music()

    coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.IFieldObjectExtensions.TalkAsync(self.oni_girl, self.talk_name9, true))

    self:play_race_bgm()

    self.lana_runcoroutine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
            stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.lana_run, self))

    user_party:ResetControllers()
    field_ui_manager:Show()

    local is_runaway = false

    while true do
        if user_party_leader.Position.x <= race_start.x - 2 and
                user_party_leader.Position.z >= race_start.z - 2 then
            is_runaway = true
        else
            is_runaway = false
        end

        if is_runaway or self.try_riding_when_racing then
            coroutine.yield(self:give_up_race())
            break
        end

        local player_reach_endpoint = false
        local lana_reach_endpoint = false

        if user_party_leader.Position.x <= race_end.x and
                user_party_leader.Position.z <= race_end.z + 3 then
            player_reach_endpoint = true
        end

        if self.oni_girl.Position.x <= race_end.x and
                self.oni_girl.Position.z <= race_end.z + 3 then
            lana_reach_endpoint = true
        end

        if player_reach_endpoint then
            if self.winner == nil then
                CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowActivityClear()
                self:stop_race_bgm()
                camera_util.shake(0.07, 0.1)
                self.winner = user_party_leader
            elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(self.winner, self.oni_girl) then
                break
            end
        end

        if lana_reach_endpoint then
            CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState.Stop(self.oni_girl)

            if self.winner == nil then
                self.oni_girl:SetAnimation("hurt", true)
                self.oni_girl:SetEmotion("doyagao", true)

                quest_icon.SetQuestCleared(self.oni_girl)

                self:stop_race_bgm()
                self.winner = self.oni_girl
            elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(self.winner, user_party_leader) then
                self.oni_girl:SetAnimation("idle", true)
                self.oni_girl:SetEmotion("tired", true)

                quest_icon.SetQuestCleared(self.oni_girl)

                break
            end
        end

        if self.maiden_attacked then
            music_player:PlaySfxOneShot("01_drown_02")
            screen_util.fade_out_async_circular(0.6, CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInOutSine)
            get_field_object("maiden_hand"):GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator)):Play("end", -1)
            stop_coroutine(self.lana_runcoroutine)
            CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState.Stop(self.oni_girl)
            self.oni_girl.SpineController:CancelJump()

            coroutine.yield(nil)

            self.oni_girl:SetAnimation("hurt", true)
            self.oni_girl:SetEmotion("doyagao", true)

            self.oni_girl.Position = race_end
            self.oni_girl.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left

            for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
                local c = user_party[i]

                c.SpineController:Scale(unity_class.vector3.one, 0)
                character_util.set_active_shadow(c, true)
                c:RemoveAnimation()
                c:RemoveEmotion()
                c.LockedDirection = CS.Oak.Direction.None
            end

            user_party:PositionParty(self.oni_girl.Position + unity_class.vector3.left, CS.Oak.Direction.Right, 0, "linear")
            quest_icon.SetQuestCleared(self.oni_girl)
            self.maiden_attacked = false

            self:stop_race_bgm()
            screen_util.fade_in_async_circular(0.6, CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInOutSine)
            break
        end

        coroutine.yield(nil)
    end

    for i = 0, self.racetrack_maidens.Count - 1 do
        local behaviour = self.racetrack_maidens[i].FieldObjectBehaviour

        if behaviour.CustomEvent == self.bigmaiden_eventname then
            behaviour.CustomEvent = nil
        end
    end

    self.ridable_bombbug.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
    self.ridable_bombbug.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)
    message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

    if not is_runaway and not self.try_riding_when_racing then
        self.race_finished = true
    end

    self.oni_girl.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
    self.oni_girl.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)
    self.oni_girl.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance

    message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.oni_girl, {self.race_end_marker_name}))

    user_party:ResetControllers()
    field_ui_manager:Show()
end

	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

end

	local onigirl = get_character(self.onigirl_name)
	onigirl.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)

	character_util.set_anim(onigirl, { name = 'attack', loop = true })
	quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(onigirl)

	return true
end

end

function local_class:exit()
	local onigirl = get_character(self.onigirl_name)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(onigirl.Interactable, CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
		onigirl.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()

	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, onigirl) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.talk_onigirl, self))
			return true
		end
	end
	return false

-- 도깨비 소녀와 대화
function local_class:talk_onigirl()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local onigirl = get_character(self.onigirl_name)

	onigirl.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)

	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(onigirl)

	party_util.align_to_target(onigirl, 'left', 1, 'linear')

	if not self.skip_talk then
		character_util.set_emotion(onigirl, { name = 'smile' })
		character_util.set_anim(onigirl, { name = 'success', sfx_name = '01_player_jump_01' })
		-- 안녕, 친구!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(onigirl, { key = 'movie_4_onigirl_starwars_1', skip = true })

		character_util.remove_anim(onigirl)

		-- 너도 이 우주선 타 봤어?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(onigirl, { key = 'movie_4_onigirl_starwars_2', skip = true })

		character_util.set_anim(onigirl, { name = 'attack' })
		-- 제법 속도감이 느껴졌지만...
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(onigirl, { key = 'movie_4_onigirl_starwars_3', skip = true })

		character_util.remove_anim(onigirl)

		character_util.remove_emotion(onigirl)
		-- 진정한 스피드 마니아라면 이 정도는 문제없잖아?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(onigirl, { key = 'movie_4_onigirl_starwars_4', skip = true })

		character_util.remove_anim(onigirl)

		character_util.set_anim(onigirl, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
		-- 그런 의미에서... 달리기 한 번 어때?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(onigirl, { key = 'movie_4_onigirl_starwars_5', skip = true })

		character_util.remove_anim(onigirl)

		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		camera_util.resize_to(3, 0.3)
		wait_for_sec(0.3)

		character_util.set_anim(onigirl, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false, sfx_name = '01_jump_01' })
		wait_for_sec(1.3)

		character_util.remove_anim(onigirl)

		-- 이번엔 이 우주선으로 말이야!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(onigirl, { key = 'movie_4_onigirl_starwars_6', skip = true })

		camera_util.resize_to_default(0.3)
	end

	self.skip_talk = true

	-- 퀘스트 수락 UI
	local accepted = quest_util.process_quest_request(self.quest_spec.QuestId, false)

	if accepted then
		floating_text_util.activate_for_quest(leader, self.quest_spec.QuestName, 0)
		screen_util.quest_accept_event()
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		yield_return_func(quest_util.activate_quest, self.controller)
	else
		quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(onigirl)
		onigirl.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)
		field_ui_manager:Show()
		party_util.reset_controllers()
	end
end

return local_class

]]

function local_class:init(controller)
    self.controller = controller
    self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress
    self.pickyMerchant = nil
    self.vendor = nil
    self.skipRequest = false
end

function local_class:enter()
    self.pickyMerchant = get_character("picky_merchant")
    self.pickyMerchant.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
    self.pickyMerchant.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)

    self.vendor = get_character("street_vendor")
    self.vendor.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
    self.vendor.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)
    return true
end

function local_class:start()
    quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(self.pickyMerchant)
end

function local_class:exit()
    quest_icon.RemoveIcon(self.pickyMerchant)

    self.pickyMerchant.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
    self.vendor.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)

    self.controller = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
    local event_type = e:GetType()
    if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
        if e.Target == self.pickyMerchant then
            coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
                    util.cs_generator(self.get_pickyMerchant_Quest, self))
        end
        if e.Target == self.vendor then
            if(stage.BattleManager:GetBattleFor(user_party_leader) ~= nil) then
                speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.vendor, "picky_merchant_vendor_talk_at_battle")
            else
                speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.vendor, "picky_merchant_0")
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end

function local_class:get_pickyMerchant_Quest()
    field_ui_manager:Hide()

    quest_icon.RemoveIcon(self.pickyMerchant)

    character_util.align_party(self.pickyMerchant, "down")

    if not self.skipRequest then
        coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:get_quest())
        self.skipRequest = true
    end

    self.vendor:RemoveEmotion()

    local accepted = quest_util.process_quest_request(self.quest_progress)

    if accepted then
        coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QuestAcceptEvent())

        for i=0, user_party.Count - 1 do
            CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState.Stop(user_party[i])
        end

        speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.pickyMerchant, {key = "picky_merchant_1_4", skip = true})

        coroutine.yield(quest_util.progress_section(self.controller))
        self.pickyMerchant:RemoveAnimation()
        self.pickyMerchant:RemoveEmotion()
        user_party:ResetControllers()
        quest_icon.SetQuestAccepted(self.pickyMerchant)
    else
        coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QuestDeclineEvent())
        quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(self.pickyMerchant)
        user_party:ResetControllers()
    end

    field_ui_manager:Show()
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

return local_class

function local_class:enter()

    self.pickyMerchant.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
    self.pickyMerchant.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)

function local_class:start()

end

function local_class:on_event(e)
    local event_type = e:GetType()
    if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
        if e.Target == self.pickyMerchant then
            local hasDesertWater = self.quest_progress:GetCustomState("buy_desert_water") == 1

            if hasDesertWater then
                coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
                        util.cs_generator(self.no_mineral, self))
            else
                speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.pickyMerchant, "picky_merchant_2_0")
            end
        end
        if e.Target == self.vendor then
            if(stage.BattleManager:GetBattleFor(user_party_leader) ~= nil) then
                speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.vendor, "picky_merchant_vendor_talk_at_battle")
            else
                coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
                        util.cs_generator(self.get_water, self))
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end

function local_class:get_water()
    field_ui_manager:Hide()

    ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker("vendor")

    character_util.align_party(self.vendor, "down")

    coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:get_water())

    local waitForBranch = true
    local isMineralWater = false
    local isClose = false

    local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))

    local regularWater = CS.Oak.TalkBranch()
    regularWater.Text = game_string:GetString("picky_merchant_talk_branch_0")
    regularWater.Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Normal
    regularWater.Callback = function()
        waitForBranch = false
    end

    local mineralWater = CS.Oak.TalkBranch()
    mineralWater.Text = game_string:GetString("picky_merchant_talk_branch_1")
    mineralWater.Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Normal
    mineralWater.Callback = function()
        waitForBranch = false
        isMineralWater = true
    end

    local close = CS.Oak.TalkBranch()
    close.Text = game_string:GetString("close")
    close.Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Normal
    close.Callback = function()
        waitForBranch = false
        isClose = true
    end

    local hasDesertWater = self.quest_progress:GetCustomState("buy_desert_water") == 1

    if not hasDesertWater then
        branches:Add(regularWater);
    end

    branches:Add(mineralWater);
    branches:Add(close);

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)

function local_class:on_event(e)

    if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
        if e.Target == self.potman then
            coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
                    util.cs_generator(self.quest_open, self))
        end
    end
    return false
end

function local_class:quest_open()
    field_ui_manager:Hide()

    quest_icon.RemoveIcon(self.potman)
    character_util.align_party(self.potman, "right", 1.0, "arc")
    coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:quest_open())
    coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.3))
    floating_text_util.activate_for_quest(user_party_leader, self.quest_spec.QuestName, 0)
    coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QuestAcceptEvent())
    coroutine.yield(quest_util.activate_quest(self.controller))

    field_ui_manager:Show()
end

function local_class:move_pot()
    music_player:PlaySfxOneShot("01_player_jump_01")

    local curTime = unity_class.time.time
    local curPos = self.potman.Position
    local jumpTime = 0.5

    local startY = 0
    local endY = 1

    while unity_class.time.time - curTime < jumpTime do
        local curY = 0
        if unity_class.time.time - curTime <= jumpTime / 2 then
            curY = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutCubic(unity_class.time.time - curTime, startY, endY - startY, jumpTime / 2)
        else
            curY = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutCubic((curTime + jumpTime) - unity_class.time.time, startY, endY - startY, jumpTime / 2);
        end

        self.potman.Position = vector(curPos.x, curY, curPos.z)
        coroutine.yield(nil)
    end

    local audio_source_holder = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = "01_dash_01", loop = true, parent = potMan,
    type_priority = CS.Oak.SfxTypePriority.Loop, player_priority = CS.Oak.SfxPlayerPriority.Npc})

    local waypoint1 = vector(-67, 0, -3)
    local waypoint2 = vector(-72, 0, -3)
    local endPoint = vector(-78, 0, 2)

    local speed = 4.5

    while self.potman.Position.z > waypoint1.z do
        self.potman.Position = self.potman.Position + vector(0, 0, -1) * speed * unity_class.time.deltaTime;
        coroutine.yield(nil)
    end

    while self.potman.Position.x > waypoint2.x do
        self.potman.Position = self.potman.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0) * speed * unity_class.time.deltaTime;
        coroutine.yield(nil)
    end

    audio_source_holder:Stop()
    self.potman.Position = endPoint;
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

return local_class

			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.marker_name, self.quest_progress.QuestId,

	quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)
	screen_util.fade_in_circular(1, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.5))

	character_util.set_anim(self.red_hood, {name = "attack", loop = false})
	character_util.set_emotion(self.red_hood, {name = "attack"})

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.3))

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.goblin_hit_sfx_handle_name)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.hit_sfx_handle_name)

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(self.victim_goblin.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0))
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.last_hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(self.victim_goblin.Position)

	local knock_back_time = 0.3
	self.victim_goblin.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	character_util.spine_rotate(self.victim_goblin, 360, knock_back_time)
	character_util.spine_pulse_color(self.victim_goblin, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor,
			1, 0.3, 0.5)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish(self.victim_goblin, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.3)

	character_util.set_anim(self.victim_goblin, {name = "embarrassed"})
	character_util.set_emotion(self.victim_goblin,  {name = "damaged"})

	local knockback_info = character_util.knockback_info("physics", true, vector(-1, 0, 0),
	30000, 0.05, CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient)

	local ckms = CS.Oak.CharacterKnockBackState.Create(self.victim_goblin, knockback_info);
	self.victim_goblin.FieldObjectBehaviour:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(ckms))

	self.red_hood:RemoveAnimation()

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(knock_back_time))

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.goblin_die_sfx_handle_name)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.hit_sfx_handle_name)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.evil_laugh_sfx_handle_name)

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(self.victim_goblin.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0))
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.last_hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(self.victim_goblin.Position)

	camera_util.shake(0.4, 1)
	local air_spin_state = CS.Oak.CharacterAirSpinState.Create(self.victim_goblin, vector(-1, 0, 0),
			1, 0.25, true)
	local sce = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(air_spin_state)
	self.victim_goblin.CharacterBehaviour:OnEvent(sce)

	character_util.spine_deviate_local(user_party_leader, {-0.3, 0, 0}, 0.3, 0.2)
	character_util.spine_pulse_color(user_party_leader, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 0.3, 0.5)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish(user_party_leader, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.3)

	character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, {name = "hurt"})
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party_leader, {name = "damaged"})
	character_util.set_anim(self.red_hood, {name = "cast"})
	character_util.set_emotion(self.red_hood, {name = "doyagao"})

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(2))
	user_party_leader:RemoveAnimation()
	user_party_leader:RemoveEmotion()

end

	local projectile_spec = game_data_service.GetData("ProjectileData"):GetSpec(self.machinegun_bullet_name)

	local ps = CS.Oak.LuaIProjectileShooter(self, self.red_hood)
	self.shoot_helper = CS.Oak.ShootHelper(CS.Oak.Projectile.MoveType.Directional, ps, projectile_spec, patten_info, CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.EachShootWithShootOffset)

	return true
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(hit_info.target, self.elite_orc) then
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("FX_hit_projectile"):Instantiate(hit_info.target.Position)

		hit_info.target.SpineController:DamageRedPulse()
		CS.DamageNumber.ShowDamageNumber(hit_info.target, 100, unity_class.color.red, hit_info.target.Position);
	end
end

function local_class:start()

	self.controller.scene:add_callback('RedHoodStartShoot', { controller = self, func = self.red_hood_start_shoot } )
	self.controller.scene:add_callback('RedHoodStopShoot', { controller = self, func = self.red_hood_stop_shoot } )
	self.controller.scene:add_callback('DroneCrashEffect', { controller = self, func = self.drone_crash_Effect } )
	self.controller.scene:add_callback('RedHoodShootPrepare', { controller = self, func = self.red_hood_shoot_prepare } )
	self.controller.scene:add_callback('CollideWithRedHood', { controller = self, func = self.collide_with_red_hood } )

	if stage.Name == "substage_1_8" then
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.marker_name, self.quest_spec.QuestId,
				self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(25.5, 0, -28))
		quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.tracker_name1))
	elseif stage.Name == "substage_1_9" then
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.marker_name, self.quest_spec.QuestId,
		self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self.red_hood)
		quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.tracker_name1))
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	self.red_hood = nil
	self.elite_orc = nil
	self.shoot_helper = nil
	self.wild_shot = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		self:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not e.FullEnter then return end
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.red_hood_zone_name then
		if not self.see_Battle_intro then
			self.see_Battle_intro = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
					stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.start_battle, self))
		end
	end

	if zone_name == self.victim_zone_name then
		if not self.victim_intro then
			self.victim_intro = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
					stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.controller.scene.victim_talk, self.controller.scene))
		end
	end

	if not self.is_in_zone and zone_name == 's2_quest_marker_zone_1' then
		self.is_in_zone = true

		local exit_pos = vector(25.5, 0, 24.5)
		quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_point(self.marker_name, self.quest_spec.QuestId, false, exit_pos)
	end
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == self.red_hood_monster_group_name then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
				stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.defeat_red_hood, self))
	end
end

function local_class:start_battle()
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name)
	quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:fight_with_red_hood())

	local wait = true
	local branch = 0

	local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString(self.branch_name1),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Intellect,
		Callback = function()
			branch = 0
			wait = false
		end})
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString(self.branch_name2),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Forced,
		Callback = function()
			branch = 1
			wait = false
		end})
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString(self.branch_name3),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Normal,
		Callback = function()
			branch = 2
			wait = false
		end})

	ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(self.red_hood, branches)

	while wait do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if branch == 0 then
		coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:accept_red_hood())
	elseif branch == 1 then
		coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:ignore_red_hood())
	else
		coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:runaway_red_hood())
	end

	coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:battle_red_hood())

	screen_util.show_boss_title(self.boss_title_name, self.boss_subtitle_name, 2, false)
	camera_util.move(self.red_hood.Position, 1, {ignorecameragrids = true})

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1))
	music_player:PlayVoice(self.elvira_voice_id, 0, CS.Oak.CharacterVoiceType.BossBattleStart)

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1.5))

	character_util.set_anim(self.red_hood, { name = 'rifle_reload', loop = false })
	character_util.jump(self.red_hood, 0.4, 0.5)
	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1))

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.ShowBossHPEvent.Create(self.red_hood))
	self.red_hood:RemoveAnimation()
	camera_util.move(user_party_leader.Position, 1, {ignorecameragrids = true})
	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1))

	character_util.convert_to_monster(self.red_hood, self.red_hood_monster_group_name)
	self.red_hood.DamagedBehaviour.DeathType = CS.Oak.DeathType.Prostrate

	command_util.execute_monster_notice(self.red_hood, user_party_leader, "battle")

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.SNSSetEquipmentRecommendationEvent.Create(false))
	quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.tracker_name2))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create(self.battle_gate_name1))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create(self.battle_gate_name2))
	stage_camera:SetTarget(user_party_leader)
	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:defeat_red_hood()
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name)
	quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create(self.battle_gate_name1))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create(self.battle_gate_name2))
	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.5))
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	character_util.convert_to_npc(self.red_hood)
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:defeat_red_hood())
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.SNSSetEquipmentRecommendationEvent.Create(true))

	coroutine.yield(quest_util.progress_section(self.controller))
	stage_camera:SetTarget(user_party_leader)
	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:red_hood_shoot_prepare()
	character_util.set_anim(self.red_hood, {name = "rifle_shoot"})

	for i = 0, 5 do
		self:gun_shot()
	end

	self.red_hood:RemoveAnimation()
end

function local_class:red_hood_start_shoot()
	self.wild_shot = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
			stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.whild_shot, self))
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.wild_shot)
end

function local_class:whild_shot()
	while true do
		self:gun_shot()
	end
end

function local_class:gun_shot()
	self.shoot_helper:ShootFront(unity_class.vector3.zero, -1, nil, false)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.gunshoot_sfx_handle_nale)
	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.3))
end

function local_class:red_hood_stop_shoot()
	if self.wild_shot ~= nil then
		stop_coroutine(self.wild_shot)
		self.wild_shot = nil
	end
end

function local_class:collide_with_red_hood()
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.collide_sfx_handle_name)

	local red_hood_knockback_info = character_util.knockback_info("physics", true, {0, 0, 1},
	10000, 0.05, CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient)

	local player_knockback_info = character_util.knockback_info("physics", true, {0, 0, -1},
			10000, 0.05, CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient)

	local ckms1 = CS.Oak.CharacterKnockBackState.Create(self.red_hood, red_hood_knockback_info);
	self.red_hood.FieldObjectBehaviour:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(ckms1))

	local ckms2 = CS.Oak.CharacterKnockBackState.Create(user_party_leader, player_knockback_info);
	user_party_leader.FieldObjectBehaviour:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(ckms2))

	character_util.spine_pulse_color(self.red_hood, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor,
			1, 0.3, 0.5)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish(self.red_hood, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.3)
	character_util.spine_pulse_color(user_party_leader, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor,
			1, 0.3, 0.5)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish(user_party_leader, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.3)

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.7))
end

function local_class:drone_crash_Effect()
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.crash_drone_sfx_handle_name)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.butt_bounce_effect_preset):Instantiate(vector(0.5, 0, 32))
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

return local_class
